title: So buttery soft / some loose threads after a year
body: I've had this blanket for more than a year and I absolutely love it. It is super soft and buttery. It keeps me super cool through the night. It IS thick so the only time I notice Issues with keeping me cool is when I have Night sweats and it seems to trap the humidity in. The only reason I took a star away is after a year of owning, it is starting to loose the threading and I get my toes stuck in the loose threads. Overall, would recommend this blanket if you can't afford a high end one!

title: I wanted this to work so bad!
body: I have no idea how this product has such a high review average. The comforter is very soft and does feel cool to the touch, but it does not stay cool. The only reason I have been able to stay cool is because the comforter ends up on the floor, it slides off the bed due to how soft and silky it is. The quality so far seems to hold up and it's easy to use. However, it's very pricy and it does not keep you cool it seems to pull the heat from you but keeps it in the blanket itself. I was really hopeful this would work but alas its soft and cozy but not cooling after the initial touch. I took one star off for the expense and one for not staying cool. But if you are looking for a soft cozy blanket this does meet that criteria.
translation:
我不知道这个产品怎么有这么高的平均评价。被子非常柔软，摸起来确实感觉凉爽，但并不能保持凉爽。我能够保持凉爽的唯一原因是因为被子最终落在地板上，由于它的柔软和丝滑，它会从床上滑落。到目前为止，质量似乎还不错，而且很容易使用。然而，它非常昂贵，而且它不能让你保持凉爽，它似乎会带走你的热量，但会将热量保留在毯子本身中。
我真的希望这能起作用，但可惜的是，它柔软舒适，但在初次接触后并不凉爽。我因为费用而扣掉一颗星，因为不保持冷静而扣掉一颗星。但如果您正在寻找柔软舒适的毯子，这确实符合该标准。

title: Perfect for hot summer nights 🔥
body: My husband and I are in love with this comforter! We live in west Texas and our summers are HOT. Overnight Temps are usually high 70s to low 80s. I hate being hot when I sleep, but I still love/need to feel a blanket on me. This blanket is perfect. I can feel the weight of it on me at night, but I don't get overheated. It is extremely silky and actually cool to the touch. My Australian Shepherd ( who sleeps in bed with us) gets very hot and sometimes has a hard time settling at night. She actually loves this blanket as much as we do. When it's not on the bed, she looks at us crazy and lays down on the tile floor in the kitchen to cool down. The only downside is the size.  It's not really "XL" on a king sized bed.  Sometimes I find my husband and I playing tug of war with it in the middle of the night 🤣.  Other comforters that I've ordered in the past that were advertised as "oversized," were in fact quite large on our bed. This one, is not. Other than the size, my husband, my dog, and I are very happy customers!
translation:
我和我丈夫都很喜欢这款被子！我们住在德克萨斯州西部，夏天很热。夜间气温通常为 70 多度到 80 多度。我讨厌睡觉时太热，但我仍然喜欢/需要感觉有毯子盖在我身上。这条毯子很完美。晚上我能感觉到它的重量，但我不会感到过热。
它非常丝滑，触感凉爽。我的澳大利亚牧羊犬（和我们一起睡在床上）变得非常热，有时晚上很难安定下来。她实际上和我们一样喜欢这条毯子。当不在床上的时候，她会疯狂地看着我们，然后躺在厨房的瓷砖地板上冷静下来。
唯一的缺点是尺寸。特大号床上并不是真正的“XL”。有时我发现我和我丈夫在半夜和它玩拔河🤣。我过去订购的其他被子被宣传为“超大”，实际上在我们的床上相当大。这个，不是。
除了尺寸之外，我的丈夫、我的狗和我都是非常满意的顾客！

title: Just Eeeh
body: The blanket is lightweight, super soft and cooling, perfect for summer months. title: Keeps you cool at night
body: This comforter is great if you normally get hot at night. I feel the comforter is well worth the money. The comforter is true to size.
translation: 如果您通常晚上很热，这款被子非常适合。我觉得这个被子很值这个钱。被子尺寸正确。

title: Best Blanket Ever!
body: The best, softest, and cool to skin blanket ever! Even bought one for my granddaughter and she loves it! Highly recommend!
translation: 有史以来最好、最柔软、最凉爽的毯子！甚至给我的孙女买了一件，她很喜欢！强烈推荐！

title: Keeps you cool
body: I don’t know how this blanket works but it is like magic. Keeps me cool all night.
translation: 我不知道这条毯子是如何工作的，但它就像魔法一样。让我整个晚上都保持凉爽。

title: Cooling for a short time and then I sweat buckets
body: It's cooling for a short time, but then it seems to trap heat in and cause a lot of sweating and overheating making sleep uncomfortable. Unfortunately this one doesn't seem to fit my purpose was really hoping it would.
translation: 天气会短暂冷却，但随后似乎会积聚热量，导致大量出汗和过热，导致睡眠不舒服。不幸的是，这似乎不符合我真正希望的目的。

title: Is the cooling effect in the room with us?
body: This thing is HOT. When you first get in bed, the blanket is cool to the touch and amazing. But after 5-10 minutes, it gets unbearably hot. My husband and I are both hot sleepers and got this hoping it would help. We sleep with 3 fans and bamboo sheets, but this blanket traps heat. It’s awful. I would not recommend and desperately wish I could return it.  Also, the stitching is coming apart after a month.
translation:
这件事很热。当你第一次上床时，毯子摸起来很凉爽，令人惊叹。但5-10分钟后，就会变得热得难以忍受。我和我丈夫都是热睡者，希望这会有所帮助。我们睡觉时需要 3 个风扇和竹床单，但这条毯子会积聚热量。太糟糕了。我不会推荐并且非常希望我能退货。

而且，一个月后缝线就会分开。

title: The worst quality and durability ever!!!
body: Its the wirst quality and durability ever!!!!! Dont buy this garbage The stitching on the comforter is falling apart, and the threads are coming loose. Everywhere!!!!
translation:
它的质量和耐用性是有史以来最好的！！！！
别买这个垃圾
被子上的缝线已经散开，线也松动了。
到处！！！！

title: Silky soft comfort
body: These blankets are my favorites. I've purchased several now and I share them with my family. We live in the southwest U.S. where summers are wickedly hot. The blankets are silky soft and feel cool all the time, yet they keep you warm enough. They are a little heavy which is nice because they stay put. I have ordered the 50x70 inch size which is great personal size for a throw. (I have several now). I've also ordered the 60x80 which I find is the best size for a single person sleeping in bed. Recently I ordered a king size comforter as a gift for loved ones who love my blankets! I've washed mine a few times and they're still like new. Great blankets for watching tv or sleeping.
translation: 这些毯子是我的最爱。我现在已经买了几个，并与家人分享。我们生活在美国西南部，那里的夏天非常炎热。毯子如丝般柔软，始终感觉凉爽，但又能让您保持足够温暖。它们有点重，这很好，因为它们可以保持不动。我订购了 50x70 英寸的尺寸，非常适合个人携带。 （我现在有几个）。我还订购了 60x80，我发现这是一个人睡在床上的最佳尺寸。最近，我订购了一件特大号被子作为礼物送给喜爱我的毯子的亲人！我的已经洗了好几次了，还是像新的一样。非常适合看电视或睡觉的毯子。

title: Very light and cozy
body: After reading all the reviews I went ahead and bought this thinking it would be cozy and cooling. It EXCEED my already high expectations! Do yourself a favor and buy it!
translation:
读完所有评论后，我继续买了这个，认为它会舒适又凉爽。它超出了我已经很高的期望！
帮自己一个忙，买吧！

title: Just buy it!!
body: 100% recommend! Not thick at all, super cooling and great quality. We’ve been using it for a month and honestly, it’s changed our sleep. No more night sweats.
translation: 100%推荐！一点也不厚，超级凉爽，质量很好。我们已经使用它一个月了，说实话，它改变了我们的睡眠。不再盗汗。

title: Even better than described!
body: Ahhh-ma-Zing!!! Light, soft, cooling! Everything an overheated sleeper needs for comfort. Two sided, luxurious and great quality.
translation: 啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！轻、软、凉！过热睡眠者舒适所需的一切。双面，豪华且品质优良。

body: This blanket is AMAZING! I am a hot sleeper and this is a game changer! It does warm as your body heats up but one slight movement and it’s back to cool. Definitely worth the buy!
translation: 这条毯子太棒了！我是一个热睡者，这改变了游戏规则！当你的身体变热时，它确实会变暖，但只要轻轻一动，它就会恢复凉爽。绝对值得购买！

title: Great pick
body: Absolutely love it the blanket cools. I love the feel against my skin
translation: 绝对喜欢毯子凉了。我喜欢皮肤的触感

title: Great.. but not so much
body: Cooling effect is great but like others have mentioned,  the stitching comes apart.  Either use a stronger thread or smaller stitch.  It's not that difficult to turn a good product into a great one.
translation: 冷却效果很好，但就像其他人提到的那样，缝线分开了。使用更坚固的线或更小的针迹。将一款好产品变成一款出色的产品并不是那么困难。

title: Best cooling comforter!
body: A MUST!!!! Stay cool all night. I added a fan and it was a game changer.
translation: 必须的！！！整夜保持凉爽。我添加了一个风扇，它改变了游戏规则。

title: Does not help
body: This comforter was not cooling. I woke up drenched in sweat. Would not recommend.
translation: 这被子不凉爽。我醒来时浑身是汗。不会推荐。

title: Waste of money
body: This blanket is cold for the first 10 minutes then boom its hot
translation: 这条毯子前 10 分钟是冷的，然后就热起来了

title: Cool blanket
body: Love this blanket. It is light and keeps me cool at night.
translation: 喜欢这条毯子。它很轻，让我在晚上保持凉爽。

title: Nice Quality
body: Nice size and feel. The material is great quality, color is true to photos and it definitely helped my hot sleeper.
translation: 尺寸和手感都不错。材料质量很好，颜色与照片相符，这对我的热睡确实有帮助。

title: Soft, Cooling Mellow Dupe
body: This is my favorite blanket. It’s light weight, soft, and really is cooling. I use it with a fan in the summer and it helps me sleep better 100%. I wanted a dupe of the mellow comforter but, didn’t wanna pay that much, this is a great substitute. In fact, I’m buying another one!
translation: 这是我最喜欢的毯子。它重量轻、柔软，而且确实很凉爽。我在夏天将其与风扇一起使用，它可以 100% 帮助我睡得更好。我想要一个柔软的被子，但不想花那么多钱，这是一个很好的替代品。事实上，我还要再买一件！

title: Color off sleep on
body: I'm taking a star as the color in the photo is certainly not the shade of blue I received so now my room looks off BUT this blanket is everything is says it is. It's cool while still being a little heavy so you don't feel so exposed to night air.
translation: 我要一颗星星，因为照片中的颜色肯定不是我收到的蓝色阴影，所以现在我的房间看起来不太好，但这条毯子就是一切所说的。它很酷，但仍然有点重，所以你不会感觉暴露在夜间空气中。

title: So soft and light
body: Love the feel of this blanket!!
translation: 喜欢这条毯子的感觉！！

title: Great cooling blanket!
body: Absolutely amazing cooling blanket!  Beautiful color and terrific material that really does keep you cool at night, even in Arizona where it gets pretty darn hot! Highly recommend.
translation: 绝对令人惊叹的降温毯！美丽的颜色和出色的材料确实让您在晚上保持凉爽，即使在亚利桑那州天气变得非常热！强烈推荐。

title: Cool nights
body: Definitely keeps you cool’
translation: 绝对让你保持凉爽”

title: Questionable usage
body: It was great when I first got it but after a couple of months, it is no longer cooling.
translation: 当我第一次拿到它时它很棒，但几个月后，它不再冷却了。

title: Great summer blanket
body: Lightweight and soft. Love the feel of the fabric.
translation: 重量轻、柔软。喜欢面料的触感。

title: Cool and comfortable
body: I absolutely love this comforter.  It is lightweight and very cool.  Fabric is lovely.
translation: 我非常喜欢这款被子。它很轻而且非常酷。布料很可爱。

title: Seems to be of good quality and feels soft.
body: It really does stay cool to the touch. The side against your body is cooler than a regular blanket . My husband still preferred to lay on top of the sheet with just the blanket over him to keep cool
translation: 它确实保持凉爽的触感。贴着身体的一面比普通毯子凉爽。我丈夫仍然喜欢躺在床单上，只盖上毯子以保持凉爽

title: Every thing we needed in a comforter
body: Well worth the money
translation: 物有所值

title: Crowd pleaser
body: I’m always cold and my GF is always hot - somehow we both love!
translation: 我总是很冷，而我的女朋友总是很热——不知怎的，我们都喜欢！

title: Cools but not like I thought it would
body: After several nights of it not helping much I closed the bedroom door and turned the window unit cooler. Slept much better last night. Don’t expect it to cool w/o the room being cool.
translation:
几个晚上之后，这并没有多大帮助，我关上了卧室的门，并将窗户装置调冷。昨晚睡得好多了。
不要指望它会在房间凉爽的情况下冷却。

title: Obsessed
body: I love this blanket! I get super hot at night and this blanket is velvet smooth and feels like it attracts all the cool in the air and traps it. I no longer have night sweats and I sleep so much better!
translation: 我喜欢这条毯子！我晚上会变得非常热，这条毯子是天鹅绒般光滑的，感觉就像它吸引了空气中所有的凉爽并将其困住。我不再盗汗，睡得更好了！

title: Love this!
body: This blanket is a game changer! Kept me so cool at night!
translation: 这条毯子改变了游戏规则！让我晚上很凉爽！

title: LOVE This Cooling Blanket
body: This blanket is amazing.  It stayed cool all night and I was so comfortable.  I ordered the king for our bed and a twin for traveling.  LOVE LOVE LOVE it!!!!
translation: 这条毯子太棒了。整个晚上都很凉爽，我很舒服。我订了一张特大号床和一张单人床供旅行使用。爱爱爱它！！！！

title: Great quality! Cooling
body: High quality with great seams. It keeps me cooler than my other one and yet still feels like I have a cuddly blanket. It’s not too thin, which was worry of mine. It’s just what I wanted. I overheat so easy and also wanted something that still felt like a blanket.
translation: 高品质，接缝精美。它让我比其他人更凉爽，但仍然感觉我有一条可爱的毯子。不太薄，这是我的担心。这正是我想要的。我很容易过热，而且还想要一些感觉像毯子一样的东西。

title: A good option!
body: A great option for someone who has to have that blanket on them at night but is also going through those dreaded hot flashes and night sweats. Feels very light and cool However, I cannot say it actually keeps you cool for longer than a few minutes. It definitely warms up from your body temperature and you need to move it to get a cool part of the blanket again. But since it does feel really nice and cool when you move it around, I will keep it. I have yet to find anything that actually works for any long periods of time. It works better than any cooling sheets I’ve tried. Also, it definitely depends on what temperature you keep your thermostat at. Overall, happy with the purchase.
translation: 对于那些晚上必须盖上毯子但又要经历可怕的潮热和盗汗的人来说，这是一个很好的选择。感觉非常轻盈和凉爽，但是，我不能说它实际上可以让您保持凉爽超过几分钟。它肯定会因您的体温而变暖，您需要移动它才能再次获得毯子的凉爽部分。但因为当你移动它时它确实感觉非常好和酷，所以我会保留它。我还没有找到任何真正能长期有效的东西。它比我尝试过的任何冷却片都有效。此外，这绝对取决于您将恒温器保持在什么温度。总的来说，对购买感到满意。

title: Absolute Sorcery
body: I am a hot sleeper and always have been. I was incredibly skeptical about this comforter but OMG. Whatever *science* allows this to stay cool, I’m here for it. I’d be a spokesperson for this product if I could. Add to cart immediately.
translation: 我是一个热睡者，而且一直都是。我对这个被子非常怀疑，但是天啊。无论*科学*如何让它保持冷静，我都是为了它。如果可以的话，我想成为这个产品的代言人。立即添加到购物车。

title: Works but has poor stitching
body: I bought 2 of these. I absolutely love the feel of them and they've been great for helping feel cooler while sleeping. I'm giving 3 stars though for the stitching. The thread is super thin and has come apart on both blankets that we have. This doesn't stop them from working, but does make them unattractive, so I have to place another blanket on top if I want my bed to look presentable.
translation: 我买了 2 个。我非常喜欢它们的感觉，它们非常适合帮助您在睡眠时感觉凉爽。不过对于缝合我还是给3星。线非常细，我们的两条毯子上的线都裂开了。这并不会阻止它们工作，但确实会让它们失去吸引力，所以如果我想让我的床看起来像样，我就必须在上面再放一条毯子。

title: Luxury Wrapped Around You
body: OMG I’m in love with this cooling blanket. I feel rich using it. It’s so soft and cool. I have sent the link to my kids. I can’t say enough about how luxurious this is. Feel rich on a small budget.
translation: 天哪，我爱上了这条冷却毯。使用它我感觉很富有。它是如此柔软和凉爽。我已将链接发送给我的孩子。我无法形容这是多么豪华。用小预算感受富裕。

title: Absolute must for hot sleepers!
body: Was willing to try anything before purchasing one of those expensive water filled mattress toppers and I'm glad I did. If you are a hot sleeper, I absolutely recommend this comforter. This comforter stays very cool to the touch. No comparison to my other "summer designated" comforter. Even after a period of time when the parts touching your skin start to warm up, a move of just a couple of inches gets you back to a cool area. We actually started sleeping with the ceiling fan on medium and low speeds in the more mild months.Big difference with this comforter and other standard comforters is the Cozy Bliss settles around you and hugs your body. It doesn't have the structure of normal comforters. At times you can get wrapped up in it when turning from side to side. Its also very light in weight, so if you are someone who needs a heavier comforter, this is not for you.Overall, I highly recommend if you are a hot sleeper.
translation:
在购买那些昂贵的充水床垫罩之前愿意尝试任何事情，我很高兴我这么做了。如果你是一个热睡者，我绝对推荐这款被子。这款被子摸起来非常凉爽。无法与我的其他“夏季指定”被子相比。即使在一段时间后，接触皮肤的部分开始变暖，只需移动几英寸即可让您回到凉爽的区域。事实上，在气候温和的月份里，我们开始用中低速的吊扇睡觉。

这款被子与其他标准被子的最大区别在于 Cozy Bliss 围绕您并拥抱您的身体。它没有普通被子的结构。有时，当您从一侧转向另一侧时，您可能会陷入其中。它的重量也很轻，所以如果您需要较重的被子，那么这不适合您。

总的来说，如果你是一个热睡者，我强烈推荐。

title: Sleeps Cool 😎
body: Comes as advertised. Stays cool and breathable. It does not smell funky coming out of the box which is a plus.
translation: 正如广告所言。保持凉爽透气。从盒子里拿出来时没有奇怪的味道，这是一个优点。

title: Smelly
body: Feels soft and cool but came smelling of chemicals like paint. I had to wash right away.
translation: 感觉柔软凉爽，但闻起来有油漆等化学物质的味道。我得赶紧去洗。

title: Works - Happy with Purchase
body: This is a comfy and cooling blanket. Very happy with this purchase
translation: 这是一条舒适且凉爽的毯子。对这次购买非常满意

title: Just what I needed
body: This is just what I needed for night sweats.  My daughter is ordering one for herself after she stole mine and I had to steal it back from her.
translation: 这正是我盗汗所需要的。我女儿偷了我的东西后，她为自己订购了一件，我不得不从她那里偷回来。

title: Great blanket
body: Soft, cooling, perfect blanket.  Very happy with this purchase.
translation: 柔软、凉爽、完美的毯子。对这次购买非常满意。

title: Really soft and good quality
body: As a hot sleeper, I really needed a cooling blanket and I’m really glad I got this one. The blanket is super soft and fits on my bed pretty well (twin). The cooling factor really only works when it’s exposed to the air and doesn’t exactly cool off under blankets, but when it is exposed to air it cools off really nicely. The quality is really nice and doesn’t seem to get damaged easily.
translation: 作为一个热睡者，我真的需要一条降温毯，我很高兴我得到了这个。毯子超级柔软，非常适合我的床上（双人床）。冷却系数实际上只有在暴露在空气中时才起作用，并且在毯子下并不能完全冷却，但当它暴露在空气中时，冷却效果非常好。质量真的很好，看起来不容易损坏。

title: Able to change thermostat from 69 to 70-71
body: I’m a hot sleeper and wish I had bought this years ago! Last summer we had our thermostat set to 69 at night, but I wished it could be lower because I’d still wake up hot. This summer we set it to 70-71, and I’ve even been a little chilly some nights. Love it!
translation: 我是一个热睡者，希望我几年前就买了这个！去年夏天，我们晚上把恒温器设置为 69 度，但我希望温度能低一些，因为我醒来时仍然很热。今年夏天我们把它设置为70-71，有些晚上我什至有点冷。爱它！

title: Great quality for the price.
body: Looks great. Perfect for these hot summer months. I’m in Seattle so no air conditioning can’t justify the price for the few weeks a year I’d need it. Put the down comforter away and took a chance on this one. I ordered the grey.
translation: 看起来很棒。非常适合炎热的夏季。我在西雅图，所以没有空调无法证明一年中我需要它的几周的价格。把羽绒被收起来，试试这个。我订的是灰色的。

title: It’s definitely a cooling blanket!!!!!
body: I was a hot sleeper. Wake up sweating, this blanket is almost too cooling, now I’m about to freeze!!!
translation: 我睡得很热。醒来一身大汗，这毯子太凉了，我都快冻死了！！！

title: More flash cool effect then truly cooling
body: It's lightweight and cool to the touch for the first 5 seconds. After 5 seconds it just reflects your own body heat back and becomes more of a self heating blanket. I am a hot sleeper so this was not impressive.
translation: 它重量轻，前 5 秒触感凉爽。 5 秒钟后，它就会反射回您自己的体温，变得更像是一条自热毯。我是一个热睡者，所以这并不令人印象深刻。

title: Worth it!
body: It’s so soft and lightweight, and unlike some others I’ve tried, it stays perfectly cool all night! Thought it wouldn’t really be cool at this price point but it has surprised me! I need to stock up!
translation: 它是如此柔软和轻盈，与我尝试过的其他一些产品不同，它整晚都保持凉爽！本来以为在这个价位上它不会很酷，但它让我感到惊讶！我需要囤货！

title: Love it
body: Love it. Pretty cool but tends to get warm like reviews said but I wear top sheet too so could be reason. Threads came loose on too bummer love it too. Can't return now for another cant stitch either
translation:
喜欢。挺酷的，但像评论说的那样容易变热，不过我也穿上床单，可能是原因之一。螺纹松了，太可惜了，我也很喜欢。现在也不能再回去缝一个不能缝的针
了

title: Not cool at all
body: Theee is nothing cool about this cooling blanket. Yes, the fabric feels cool to the touch. However I’m currently laying in bed with bare legs, this blanket on me, and I am toasty warm. I should be feeling cool. I got this thing at the end of April, and have not had a good night of cool sleep yet. I have to find something else, as I’m tired of being hot all night.
translation: 这条冷却毯一点也不酷。是的，这种面料摸起来很凉爽。然而我现在光着腿躺在床上，身上盖着这条毯子，感觉很暖和。我应该感觉很酷。我是四月底拿到这个东西的，至今还没有睡过一个好觉。我必须找点别的事，因为我厌倦了整夜的炎热。

title: Love it but it's like sleeping in basketball shorts
body: I really like this but at the same time it reminds me of basketball shorts which is really throwing me
translation: 我真的很喜欢这个，但同时它让我想起了篮球短裤，这真的让我很震惊

title: Stitching came apart after two washes per instructions
body: Washed and dried as instructed. Stitching coming apart after two washes.
translation: 按照说明清洗并干燥。两次洗涤后缝线会分开。

title: Very nice cooling comforter!
body: Absolutely LOVE this comforter! Keeps me nice and cool while sleeping and looks great!
translation: 我非常喜欢这条被子！睡觉时保持凉爽，看起来也很棒！

title: Super lightweight & cozy
body: These are the best! I have ordered 3 blankets now & we all love them!
translation: 这些是最棒的！我已经订了3条毯子，我们都很喜欢！

title: Well worth it...👍
body: It does keep a person cool and it is easy to launder...👍
translation: 它确实让人凉快，而且洗衣服也很容易......👍

title: Get it!
body: Love it!! Stays cool!!
translation: 太喜欢了！！保持凉爽！！

title: Great purchase!
body: The comfort and quality are excellent!
translation: 舒适度和质量都非常出色！

title: Cozy and cool
body: Love this blanket!! It’s cool and perfect weight and feel!!
translation: 太喜欢这条毯子了！！它很酷，重量和手感都恰到好处！！

title: Great Budget Option

There is something very cozy and comforting about cuddling up in a blanket, no matter how hot it is. This is the solution and it is a life saver!!! Now - if I can only find a blanket that takes off 20 pounds!!
translation: 我非常喜欢这条毯子！！！在过去 9 个月左右的时间里，我一直遭受盗汗/潮热/失眠的困扰。我真的买了六条毯子，每一条都让我整夜出汗！我把暖气调低，把风扇开大，但仍然醒来时浑身是汗，而且因脱水而头晕！这是第一条摸起来凉爽且不会升高体温的毯子。没有毯子或只有床单睡觉不是很舒服。无论天气多热，依偎在毯子里都会让人感到非常舒适和安慰。这就是解决方案，它是一个救星！现在——如果我能找到一条能减轻 20 磅体重的毯子就好了！

title: It really is cool!!!
body: Amazing!!! We have a king but comforter too warm plus bf keeps stealing my side! So I got this in a twin and it really is cooling to the touch!! In warmer weather it does warm comfortably to your body. It’s so silky smooth w satin feel. No need to buy sleep.com stuff. This works!!
translation: 惊人的！！！我们有一张特大号床，但被子太暖和了，而且男朋友总是偷我的身边！所以我买了一个双胞胎，摸起来真的很凉！！在温暖的天气里，它确实能让您的身体感到舒适温暖。它是如此丝般光滑，有缎子般的感觉。无需购买 sleep.com 的东西。这有效！

title: As advertised
body: Awesome comforter. Cool to the touch, yet warms you like a regular comforter.
translation: 很棒的被子。触感凉爽，但像普通被子一样温暖。

title: Love it need another
body: Okay, I’m obsessed with this cover! It absolutely keeps me cool all night long, and I was so impressed with how soft it is. As a person who produces heat at night, this is the ideal gift. My family keeps asking where to buy it because they love it so much too. My only downside is that the stitching starts to come apart, but it’s a great purchase, and I would still love to purchase another one.
translation: 好吧，我已经被这个封面迷住了！它绝对让我整夜保持凉爽，而且它的柔软程度给我留下了深刻的印象。对于一个在夜间产生热量的人来说，这是一个理想的礼物。我的家人一直问在哪里买它，因为他们也非常喜欢它。我唯一的缺点是缝线开始分开，但这是一次很棒的购买，我仍然愿意购买另一件。

title: Rip off price.
body: Considering the price I paid its more of a throw towel than a blanket. Could have provided some girth instead of this flimsy tea towel. Iv experienced much better products than this. Good scam.
translation: 考虑到我付的价格，它更像是一条毛巾，而不是一条毯子。可以提供一些周长而不是这条脆弱的茶巾。我体验过比这更好的产品。好骗局。

title: Good but too small
body: It’s nice and light, but it is too small for our king bed. The comforter basically doesn’t cover the entire bed and easily pulls off from one side to the other.
translation: 它既漂亮又轻便，但对于我们的特大号床来说太小了。被子基本上不会覆盖整个床，很容易从一侧拉到另一侧。

title: Perfect weight, super soft and keeps you nice and cool.
body: I absolutely love this blanket. I’m an extremely hot sleeper, I keep my air at 68 while I sleep, keep a ceiling fan on and a standing fan and I was still waking up drenched in sweat. This blanket has kept me so much cooler and has helped me get the best sleep I’ve had in years. I highly recommend.
translation: 我非常喜欢这条毯子。我是一个非常热的睡眠者，睡觉时我将空气温度保持在 68 度，开着吊扇和立式风扇，但我醒来时仍然浑身是汗。这条毯子让我保持凉爽，并帮助我获得了多年来最好的睡眠。我强烈推荐。

title: Best brand, full stop!
body: Cozy Bliss brand is THE best, hands down. Our go to for the house and as gifts. Everyone loves them.
translation: Cosy Bliss 品牌是最好的，毫无疑问。我们去买房子和作为礼物。每个人都爱他们。

title: Blue Color Fades!!
body: It’s perfect for hot sleepers. But the color immediately started fading into white spots all over the blanket. Would have been a 5/5 if the color of the blanket would not have faded.
translation: 它非常适合热睡者。但颜色立即开始褪色，变成遍布毯子的白点。如果毯子的颜色没有褪色的话，应该是 5/5。

title: Brand new & stained
body: I ordered a new cooling blanket and this one seems to have already been used… There was a huge stain in the top of the blanket.
translation: 我订购了一条新的冷却毯，这个似乎已经被使用过……毯子顶部有一个巨大的污渍。

title: blanket absorbs body heat.
body: The blanket absorbs your body heat so it actually gets hot next to your skin where the top stays cold.  If I want to cool off I use it as a blanket to hug and it works great for me that way.
translation: 毯子会吸收您的身体热量，因此它实际上会在您的皮肤附近变热，而顶部则保持寒冷。如果我想冷静下来，我会用它作为毯子来拥抱，这对我来说非常有用。

title: Cool to the touch, always!
body: Wonderful! Stays cool even after washing. I love it!
translation: 精彩的！即使清洗后也能保持凉爽。我喜欢它！

title: Cool sleep
body: Great product
translation: 很棒的产品

title: AMAZING
body: This comforter is creamy smooth, definitely stays cool and is all around great! I do wish it were a bit heavier but whatever it keeps this perimenopausal woman chilled! Only downer (not the comforters fault) my puppy chewed two spots! The cotton inside is so soft it’s insane! I will be buying more. They have a blanket option and a comforter and honestly I do not see a difference at all. Such a great product.
translation: 这款被子呈奶油般光滑，绝对保持凉爽，而且一切都很棒！我确实希望它重一点，但无论如何它都能让这个围绝经期的女人感到寒冷！唯一令人沮丧的是（不是被子的错），我的小狗咬了两块！里面的棉花太软了，太疯狂了！我会买更多。他们有毯子和被子可供选择，老实说我根本看不出有什么区别。这么棒的产品。

title: Poorly made, coming apart in multiple places
body: I liked the blanket for a while. It's comfy and cooling but now all the stitching is coming loose from the baffles. And I'm not talking one or two spots. The stitching is coming apart at like 20+ spots n the blanket. My fingers and toes get tangled in the loose stitching while using the blanket. I never write reviews but this has annoyed me enough to spur me to write this one. Poor quality, poorly made.
translation: 我有一段时间喜欢这条毯子。它既舒适又凉爽，但现在所有的缝线都从挡板上松脱了。我说的不是一两个地方。毯子上大约 20 多个地方的缝线都裂开了。使用毯子时，我的手指和脚趾被松散的缝线缠住。我从来不写评论，但这件事让我很恼火，促使我写这篇评论。质量差，做工不好。

title: Cool&soft
body: I love this blanket! The best one I've had so far! It really does keep you cooler and my cat loves it too, lol!
translation: 我喜欢这条毯子！迄今为止我吃过的最好的一个！它确实能让你保持凉爽，我的猫也喜欢它，哈哈！

title: Game Changer for Hot Sleepers
body: I recently upgraded to a Tempur-Pedic bed. While it is super comfy, it does not breathe well. I found myself sweating at night like I was running laps in my sleep. Then I found this comforter and thought, why not give it a shot?  Let me tell you, I slept cold. Gloriously cold. My fiancé and I each sleep with our own blankets, and when he touched mine in the morning, he could not believe how cool it felt. He ordered one immediately with same day delivery. It is already in the wash and ready for tonight.  I even sent the link to my mom. For the price, this comforter is a steal. Cool, comfy, and totally worth it.
translation:
我最近升级到了 Tempur-Pedic 床。虽然超级舒服，但呼吸不太顺畅。我发现自己晚上出汗，就像在睡梦中跑几圈一样。然后我找到了这条被子，心想，为什么不试一试呢？

告诉你吧，我睡得很冷。光荣的寒冷。我和我的未婚夫都用自己的毯子睡觉，早上当他摸着我的毯子时，他简直不敢相信感觉有多凉。他立即订购了一件，并当天送货。它已经洗好了，准备今晚使用。

我什至把链接发给了我妈妈。就价格而言，这款被子很便宜。凉爽、舒适，而且完全值得。

title: Very good product
body: By far the best thing ive bought for my new bed
translation: 到目前为止我为我的新床买的最好的东西

title: Love it
body: Love this blanket super great for sweaters
translation: 喜欢这条毯子，超级适合毛衣

title: Don’t think it kept cool at night
body: Blanket has some weight to it which I liked but did not feel it did what it claimed to keep cool during sleep.  Seems like a durable blanket.
translation: 毯子有一定的重量，我喜欢，但感觉它没有达到其声称的在睡眠时保持凉爽的效果。看起来像一条耐用的毯子。

title: Cold as ice
body: Keeps you cool all night!
translation: 让你整夜保持凉爽！

title: Great Value
body: Fantastic!
translation: 极好的！

title: Agradable
body: Agradable
translation: 令人愉快的

title: Amazing cooling Blanket for hot sleepers.
body: Feels amazing against your skin. Worth the money and it’s a great Blanket for hot sleepers ❤️🙌
translation: 肌肤触感美妙。物有所值，对于热睡者来说这是一条很棒的毯子❤️🙌

title: Perfect!
body: Very soft and nice. Not heavy and very cooling! I have tried other cooling blankets but this one by far is the best!
translation: 非常柔软又漂亮。不重而且很凉爽！我尝试过其他冷却毯，但这是迄今为止最好的！

title: Works great!
body: I usually have to have my ac set down to 68. I am always warm. This has helped me alot to cool down
translation: 我通常必须把空调调到 68。我总是很温暖。这帮助我冷静下来

title: Does the job!
body: Great blanket. My son loves it.
translation: 很棒的毯子。我儿子喜欢它。

title: Not sure about quality
body: While it does feel cool at night, the stitches come undone so easily when I move. And this is the only blanket I have that does it
translation: 虽然晚上确实感觉很凉，但当我移动时，缝线很容易松开。这是我唯一能做到这一点的毯子

title: The best!
body: My favorite cooling blanket!! They’re super light without being thin, and the yellow is akin to a pale banana color that’s creamy rather than just being off-white. I got a twin and its size works for the bed. They pick up cooling really quickly, I put it in the fridge for terribly hot nights (100+ F) but usually just having a fan over it makes it worth it. Very soft and comfortable, but there’s no friction, which means your bed doesn’t generally stay made but I can live with that. I buy one for everyone I care about and recommend it to anyone who struggles with being a hot sleeper.
translation: 我最喜欢的降温毯！！它们超轻而不薄，黄色类似于淡香蕉色，呈奶油色，而不仅仅是灰白色。我有一张单人床，它的尺寸适合床。它们很快就能冷却，我把它放在冰箱里度过炎热的夜晚（100华氏度以上），但通常只要在上面放一个风扇就值得了。非常柔软舒适，但没有摩擦，这意味着你的床通常不会保持整齐，但我可以忍受。我为我关心的每个人都买了一个，并将其推荐给那些为热睡而苦苦挣扎的人。

title: Very cooling
body: Lightweight but thick enough. Very cooling and the color is great. It fits the bed perfectly and it is very durable for washing. Very good price for a great comforter.
translation: 重量轻但足够厚。非常凉爽，颜色也很棒。它与床完美贴合，而且非常耐洗。非常好的价格，非常好的被子。

title: You get your moneys worth with this product
body: I bought this for my girlfriend since she runs really hot whenever shes over at my place. She’s also complained she’s always waking up sweating since the ac doesn’t run in her room. Ever since I bought her this she’s always praised the product saying she doesn’t run hot anymore and that this actually makes her feel cold in the morning. Definitely buy this product 10/10.
translation: 我给我女朋友买了这个，因为每当她来我家时，她都会感到很热。她还抱怨说，由于房间里没有空调，她总是醒来时出汗。自从我给她买了这个产品后，她总是称赞这个产品，说她不再发热了，而且这实际上让她早上感觉很冷。绝对购买该产品 10/10。

title: Warm and Cozy
body: My daughter was very pleased with this gift and loves it.
translation: 我的女儿对这份礼物非常满意并且非常喜欢。

title: Not a Rest Value comforter
body: Bought this for my sister whose diabetic. Constantly wakes up with night sweats. This didn't help cool her off or control body temp
translation: 为患有糖尿病的姐姐买了这个。经常因盗汗而醒来。这无助于让她冷静下来或控制体温

title: Like the cool side of the pillow
body: Love my cooling blanket. I’m a woman of a certain age and I get hot at night. This blanket is like the cool side of the pillow all the time. In the winter I use it on top of my comforter so I am warm but coolness is right there. Highly recommend for warm sleepers.
translation: 喜欢我的降温毯。我是一个到了一定年龄的女人，晚上就会感到很热。这条毯子一直就像枕头凉爽的一面。冬天我把它放在被子上，这样我既温暖又凉爽。强烈推荐给温暖的睡眠者。

title: Best purchase I’ve ever made
body: I run really hot and got this after seeing my sisters, I used to live in a house with no AC (in Utah, in the summer, YIKES!) and this helped me not feel like I was dying at night! It definitely heats up with time you’re under it because of body heat but it’s still great!
translation: 我跑得很热，在看到我的姐妹们后得到了这个，我曾经住在一个没有空调的房子里（在犹他州，在夏天，呀！）这让我不觉得自己在晚上要死了！由于身体的热量，随着你在它下面的时间的推移，它肯定会变热，但它仍然很棒！

title: Very nice wrinkle free coiol bed cover.
body: Lovely, light weight blanket.
translation: 可爱、轻质的毯子。

title: Best blanket ever!
body: My all time favorite blanket. It fit my bed perfectly and is extremely soft. The quality is perfect and I know it will hold up well for a long time.
translation: 我一直以来最喜欢的毯子。它非常适合我的床，而且非常柔软。质量非常完美，我知道它能保持很长时间。

title: great comforter
body: great cooling comforter
translation: 很棒的凉爽被子

title: Pretty cool blanket
body: Pun intended, love it. Keeps me cool, I’m a hot sleeper and really appreciate this. We have three now in the family and love them.
translation: 双关语有意，喜欢它。让我保持凉爽，我睡得很热，真的很感激这一点。我们家里现在有三个人并且爱他们。

title: Comfy
body: Great light weight comforter and super soft
translation: 超轻的被子，超级柔软

title: La vuelvo a comprar
body: Es muy fresca,  su textura muy suave,  la calidad muy buena.  Muy recomendable.
translation: 非常新鲜，质地非常柔软，质量非常好。强烈推荐。

title: Way better than I expected. Highly Recommend!
body: I bought this as a Christmas gift for my husband because he’s a hot sleeper, and I thought it would be perfect for him. The fabric feels amazing, very soft and smooth. My husband loves it, and our dog does too. They actually fight over it, which is pretty cute!
translation: 我买了这个作为送给我丈夫的圣诞礼物，因为他睡得很热，我认为这对他来说是完美的。面料触感极佳，非常柔软、光滑。我丈夫喜欢它，我们的狗也喜欢。他们竟然为了这个而打架，真是太可爱了！

title: Its Just Ok
body: Sleeps hot after awhile Initially it's a cool blast, but that doesn't last long
translation:
睡一会儿就热了
最初是一阵凉爽的爆炸，但这不会持续很长时间

title: Stays Cool
body: Perfect cooling blanket and stays cool all night.  I'm not using a comforter, only the blanket.  Haven't had night sweats since using this blanket.
translation: 完美的降温毯，整夜保持凉爽。我没有用被子，只用毯子。自从用了这条被子之后，就没有再盗汗过。

title: Nice material and feels really expensive
body: Wow I loveedddd this comforter. I wasn’t expecting the material that is is—it’s like a bathing suit kind of material. It moves like a liquid. Definitely cooling but still keeps you warm. It feels like it’s really expensive and looks very well made—like the seems and sewing looks well made. Seems more expensive than it is.
translation: 哇，我喜欢这个被子。我没想到这种材料是这样的——它就像泳衣一样的材料。它像液体一样移动。绝对凉爽，但仍能让您保持温暖。感觉它真的很贵，而且看起来做工非常好——就像看起来和缝纫看起来做工都很好一样。看起来比实际更贵。

title: It’s a yes for me
body: It’s so good! It feels so soft and cold!! It’s got a very nice weight to it and it looks like a regular old school comforter
translation: 太好了！感觉又软又冷！！它的重量非常好，看起来就像普通的老式被子

title: Works as advertised
body: This is a great comforter. I got a king for a smaller bed, and that allows me to move it around to a cool spot once it has started to absorb heat. It doesn't get five stars because the stitching has started to come undone, so sometimes I'll get my foot caught in the thread.
translation: 这是一个很棒的被子。我买了一张特大号床，床较小，一旦它开始吸热，我就可以把它移到凉爽的地方。它没有得到五颗星，因为缝合已经开始松开，所以有时我的脚会被线缠住。

title: Get you one
body: I almost never leave reviews, but had to give these blankets a quick 5 stars. I bought one and it is the most comfortable blanket to sleep with. Husband bought a second one out of pure jealousy because i dont like to share blankets.
translation: 我几乎从不留下评论，但不得不给这些毯子一个快速的 5 颗星。我买了一条，这是睡起来最舒服的毯子。丈夫纯粹出于嫉妒而买了第二条，因为我不喜欢共用毯子。

title: For the people who are always hot before they sleep
body: This blanket is perfect for those who feel hot in the night before falling a sleep. But it does keep the body heat after a while. Not a great option for summer but any other season is perfect
translation: 这条毯子非常适合那些在晚上入睡前感到热的人。但一段时间后它确实可以保持身体的热量。夏天不是一个好选择，但任何其他季节都是完美的

title: Cools!
body: It really is cooling. The weight is good for such a thin blanket. It is a little slippery but I love it. Perfect for hot sleepers. I even use it in the winter with an electric throw which heats it up nicely. So it can do both heat and cool as needed.
translation: 确实很凉爽。对于这么薄的毯子来说，重量很合适。它有点滑，但我喜欢它。非常适合热睡者。我什至在冬天使用它，并配有电热毯，可以很好地加热它。因此它可以根据需要进行加热和冷却。

title: Perfect quilt!
body: Love this quilt!! Bought a second in case they became unavailable! Cool but warm. Not to heavy but hugs you! Perfect in any weather!
translation:
喜欢这个被子！！
买了第二个，以防万一它们不可用！
凉爽但温暖。不重但拥抱你！
适合任何天气！

title: My menopausal mamas, BUY IT NOW!
body: Best purchase I ever made, I can never live with out again! It’s so cooling and if it ever doesn’t feel cool I just shake it and immediately it’s cool again. I get hot flashes and this has been AMAZING
translation: 我买过的最好的东西，我再也不能离开了！它是如此凉爽，如果感觉不凉爽，我只需摇晃它，立即又凉爽了。我感到潮热，这太棒了

title: Changed my sleep experience!
body: This blanket is a game changer!  I have had disturbed sleep every night for over a year. Blankets on and off all night because I get so hot and then I’m cold. I’m tossing and turning constantly and have our ceiling fan on even when it’s freezing cold outside. I changed our bedding yesterday and put this blanket on and had the best night sleep in as long as I can remember. It is perfect. I was cold for a minute or two when I got in bed but once I got settled I was very comfortable. I highly recommend this if you struggle with being hot while sleeping.
translation: 这条毯子改变了游戏规则！一年多以来，我每晚都睡眠不安。毯子整夜都被打开和关闭，因为我变得很热，然后又冷了。即使外面很冷，我也经常翻来覆去，还开着吊扇。昨天我换了床上用品，盖上毯子，睡了一个有记忆以来最好的一觉。这是完美的。当我上床时有一两分钟很冷，但一旦安顿下来，我就非常舒服了。如果你在睡觉时感到很热，我强烈推荐这个。

title: If your hot at night to sleep this is for you
body: If you’re a hot sleeper then this is for you!! It’s even cool when you touch the material. Best thing I’ve bought in a long time, washes good, dryer good. I couldn’t ask for anything more except wish they had darker colors because my dog sleeps in bed and I bought the one that is reversable. Light grey on one side and pale pink on the other.
translation: 如果您是一个热睡者，那么这适合您！当你触摸这种材料时，甚至感觉很凉爽。很久以来买过的最好的东西，洗涤效果好，烘干效果好。我不能要求更多，除了希望它们有更深的颜色，因为我的狗睡在床上，而我买了可翻转的。一侧为浅灰色，另一侧为浅粉色。

title: Muy refrescante
body: Súper bueno el producto, cumplió con mis expectativas.
translation: 超级好的产品，它满足了我的期望。

title: It is the softest blanket I have and keeps me cool and comfortable
body: Wonderful product. Love it so much!
translation: 很棒的产品。非常喜欢它！

title: Very comfortable
body: Love the feel of this. I still get warm at night sometimes but nothing like I used to. Has washed well.
translation: 喜欢这种感觉。有时晚上我还是会发热，但已经不像以前那样了。已经洗好了。

title: Silky smooth and works perfectly
body: I have used several different cooling blankets over the years, and this is by far my favorite. It’s silky smooth, cools me off fast, and is large enough that I have no issues with my feet popping out the bottom. Love it!!
translation: 多年来我使用过几种不同的冷却毯，这是迄今为止我最喜欢的。它如丝般光滑，让我很快冷却下来，而且足够大，我的脚从底部伸出来没有任何问题。爱它！！

title: Cozy is a good name
body: Love this blanket. It’s buttery and cool to the touch but also keeps me warm. It’s lightweight, not breathable, but great for keeping my house at 68 degrees with the fans on and keeping me the perfect temperature. I have bamboo sheets under them from Sam’s club and it’s a wonderful combination.
translation: 喜欢这条毯子。它是黄油状的，摸起来很凉爽，但也让我保持温暖。它很轻，不透气，但非常适合在风扇打开的情况下将我的房子保持在 68 度，让我保持完美的温度。我在下面铺了山姆俱乐部的竹床单，这是一个美妙的组合。

title: Cools indeed
body: Blanket does an amazing job keeping me cool at night. I do question longevity as the thread stitching is coming undone. Ive only had it about 3 months of use. Light blue also showing signs of discoloration in areas.
translation: 毯子的作用非常出色，让我在晚上保持凉爽。我确实怀疑它的寿命，因为缝线即将松开。我只使用了大约 3 个月。浅蓝色的区域也显示出变色的迹象。

title: Nice, but will it last?
body: Overall I love the blanket, it does exactly what. Easy to wash, helps cool me down but all of the stitching is coming loose. Not too happy with that and don't see it being long term durable. Hope I'm wrong, but only had for 6 months.
translation: 总的来说，我喜欢这条毯子，它的作用正是如此。易于清洗，有助于让我冷静下来，但所有的缝线都松动了。对此不太满意，并且认为它不会长期耐用。希望我错了，但只用了六个月。

title: Too light

translation: 太轻从床上滑落 难以继续

title: this was a gift
body: This was a gift for a friend, but I am told it is amazing.
translation: 这是送给朋友的礼物，但我听说它太棒了。

title: Highly recommended
body: This is the “coolest” blanket ever! Literally!!! It’s like magic. I washed it according to instructions before using, and I am not disappointed. The fabric feels silky-soft. Highly recommend

这是有史以来“最酷”的毯子！字面上地！！！
这就像魔法一样。使用前我按照说明清洗了它，并没有让我失望。面料摸起来如丝般柔软。
强烈推荐

title: Great blanket for many reasons!
body: Soft, cooling, and feels great overall. On the thinner side. Perfect for people who sleep hot and also for anyone looking for a blanket that doesn’t attract too much hair for pets.
translation: 柔软、凉爽，整体感觉很棒。在较薄的一侧。非常适合睡热的人以及正在寻找不会吸引太多宠物毛发的毯子的人。

title: Great Quality and a Perfect Affordable Cooling Option
body: I bought this Cozy Bliss cooling comforter for my guest room, and I am so happy with it! On my own bed I use a Rest Evercool comforter and absolutely love it, but that brand is a little pricey for guest room purposes. After doing a lot of research on more affordable cooling alternatives, I decided to try this one, and it was a great choice.  The pale blue color is soft and pretty, and it blends in easily with different room styles. The comforter has a smooth, silky feel and is lightweight while still providing a comfortable amount of coverage. It does a nice job of staying cool, which is exactly what I was hoping for.  One helpful tip is to plan ahead when you buy it. Right out of the package it is very wrinkly, and as you can see in my photo, those wrinkles do not hide easily. A quick tumble in the dryer on low or no heat makes a big difference and helps the fabric relax.  If you are looking for an affordable alternative to the Rest Evercool collection, this comforter is a great pick! I would definitely recommend it!
translation:
我为我的客房购买了这款 Cosy Bliss 凉爽被子，我对它非常满意！在我自己的床上，我使用 Rest Evercool 被子，非常喜欢它，但该品牌对于客房来说有点贵。在对更实惠的冷却替代方案进行了大量研究之后，我决定尝试这个，这是一个不错的选择。

淡蓝色的色调柔和俏丽，很容易与不同的房间风格融为一体。这款被子具有光滑、丝滑的触感，重量轻，同时仍提供舒适的覆盖范围。它在保持凉爽方面做得很好，这正是我所希望的。

一个有用的提示是购买时提前计划。从包装中取出后，它非常皱，正如您在我的照片中看到的那样，这些皱纹不容易隐藏。在低热或无热的情况下在烘干机中快速翻滚会产生很大的差异，并有助于织物松弛。

如果您正在寻找 Rest Evercool 系列的实惠替代品，这款被子是不错的选择！我绝对会推荐它！

title: Works pretty well
body: It really does help keep me cool at night.  It’s slippery so it moves around a lot at night and falls off the bed.
translation: 它确实有助于让我在晚上保持凉爽。它很滑，所以它在晚上移动很多并且从床上掉下来。

title: Cheaply made, falls apart & stains easily
body: This comforter is so soft and cooling; however, the threading on it rips so easily. I've washed this comforter 3 times since I purchased it, and its always tearing. Additionally, it bunches up in weird places. It's almost like how when you have a comforter inside a duvet and it bunches up -- except this isn't a duvet. On top of all of that, it stains so easily in the washing machine. I think because of the material its made of, the laundry soap or other items you put it in the wash with leave marks. I promise I am not one to eat and drink beverages on my bed, so I'm never getting food or drink stains on it. Somehow these stain keep appearing simply from the laundry cycles. I never see stains like this on my clothes or on my previous comforters/duvets. I'm super disappointed of how this sits on my bed.
translation: 这被子是如此柔软和凉爽；然而，它的螺纹很容易撕裂。自从买了这条被子以来，我已经洗了 3 次了，它总是撕裂。此外，它还聚集在奇怪的地方。这几乎就像你在羽绒被里放了一条被子，它会聚成一团——只不过这不是羽绒被。最重要的是，它很容易在洗衣机中弄脏。我认为是因为它的材质、洗衣皂或其他物品，你把它放在洗衣机里会留下痕迹。我保证我不会在床上吃喝饮料，所以我的床上永远不会留下食物或饮料的污渍。不知何故，这些污渍只是在洗衣过程中不断出现。我的衣服或以前的被子/羽绒被上从未见过这样的污渍。我对它放在我床上的样子感到非常失望。

title: Nice blanket…with some special needs
body: This is a very nice blanket.  I love the fact that it is machine washable.  I do have to be careful when I use lotion or anything along those lines, since it will leave marks behind, but it all has come out in the wash.  I also have two cats, so I have to be careful that they don’t leave claw marks.
translation: 这是一条非常好的毯子。我喜欢它可以机洗的事实。当我使用乳液或类似的东西时，我确实必须小心，因为它会留下痕迹，但一切都会在洗涤中消失。我也有两只猫，所以我必须小心它们不要留下爪痕。

title: I don’t know how or why, but it keeps cool!

translation: 我不知道如何或为什么，但它保持凉爽！它很轻，但很重，感觉就像盖了一条厚实的毯子一样！我喜欢它

我一个月大概洗两三次。我用了一年多了，没有任何反应。太棒了。

title: LOVE LOVE LOVE

body: This thing is simply amazing. A bit on the pricey side, but it's worth every penny. Haven't had a bad night's sleep since I purchased it. Would definitely buy another one.

title: Buy it!!!
body: Nothing was stopping my night sweats and I haven’t had one sleepless sweaty night since I bought this.
translation: 没有什么可以阻止我盗汗，自从买了这个以来，我还没有经历过一个不眠之夜。

title: Definitely not worth the price.
body: I have waited a few months to make this review. I was so excited to receive this item as I am an extremely hot sleeper. I have to sleep with the AC down low, with the fan on and a really thin blanket and still most nights I have to kick a leg out to cool back down. When I first cover up with this blanket, its amazing but its extremely short lived. After about 45 minutes or so I am burning up more than ever. I touch the blanket and the spot that was on my body is so warm, extremely warm. I'll wake up in a sweat. Then ill have to turn the blanket to find a spot that wasn't touching me. I shouldn't have kept trying it because now I can't return it but I wanted it to work so badly.  Now, its pretty much decorative or sometimes ill use it to cool down for 10 minutes or so then kick it off and go back to my original method. Hoping it will work better in the winter but not going to hold my breath. Shouldn't have wasted the money trying to save a buck and should have went ahead and bought the REST one.
translation: 我等了几个月才做出这篇评论。我很高兴收到这个物品，因为我睡得非常热。我睡觉时必须把空调开得很低，开着风扇，盖上一条很薄的毯子，但大多数晚上我还是得把腿踢开才能冷静下来。当我第一次盖上这条毯子时，它很神奇，但它的寿命非常短暂。大约 45 分钟后，我比以往任何时候都更加燃烧。我摸了摸毯子，身上的地方很温暖，非常温暖。我会满头大汗地醒来。然后我必须翻动毯子才能找到一个不碰我的地方。我不应该继续尝试，因为现在我无法退货，但我非常希望它能正常工作。现在，它几乎是装饰性的，或者有时会用它来冷却 10 分钟左右，然后开始它并回到我原来的方法。希望它在冬天能更好地工作，但不会屏住呼吸。不应该为了省钱而浪费钱，应该继续购买其余的。

title: Truly cool to the touch
body: These are amazing after I put them on the bed, they instantly felt cool and remain cool to the touch. I have 2 queen beds and they are sized right, I ordered queen size.
translation: 当我把它们放在床上后，它们立即感觉凉爽并且触感凉爽。我有 2 张大床，尺寸合适，我订的是大号床。

translation: 我曾经拥有过的最好的冷却床单......价值 $ 并且非常舒适......👍

title: Amazing Blanket
body: This blanket is amazing.  Going through menopause is no joke and this blanket has been a lifesaver.  It’s amazing how it truly stays cool.  Highly recommend.
translation: 这条毯子太棒了。经历更年期可不是闹着玩的，这条毯子成了我的救星。令人惊奇的是它如何真正保持凉爽。强烈推荐。

title: I love it!

I got the mint and white color and the green is so light that u can hardly tell its not white as well- very pastel. 5 stars!

translation: 我受到 TikTok 上一段视频的影响，尝试了这条毯子，哇——我们喜欢它！它让您保持凉爽，同时又温暖，非常轻便。喜欢它的双面——一面是白色，另一面是薄荷色。总的来说，我们每天都使用的很棒的毯子，因此它是值得的。我也有荨麻疹爆发的问题，这导致我晚上变得非常温暖，这对处理这些问题有很大帮助。

body: I honestly didn’t believe this comforter would actually work when I bought it, but wow—I was wrong! I used it last night for the first time and it really does keep you cool. title: Keeps You Cool but Still Cozy
body: I bought this blanket for my wife, who recently started experiencing peri-menopause hot flashes that made it hard for her to sleep. A comforter that once felt perfect suddenly became unbearable, so I went looking for something that might help—and this cooling blanket has been a great solution.  She says it definitely has a cooling effect when you move around, which helps take the edge off the heat. At the same time, it’s still cozy and warm, trapping just the right amount of body heat so she doesn’t get cold. While she still has some hot nights here and there, this blanket has made a noticeable difference in her comfort and sleep quality.  Highly recommend if you’re looking for something to help with nighttime temperature swings!
translation:
我买了这条毯子给我妻子，她最近开始经历围绝经期的潮热，导致她难以入睡。曾经感觉完美的被子突然变得难以忍受，于是我去找可能有帮助的东西——这条降温毯成了很好的解决方案。

她说活动时确实有降温效果，有助于缓解热量。同时，这里依然温暖舒适，恰到好处地捕捉到体温，避免她感到寒冷。虽然她偶尔还是会遇到一些炎热的夜晚，但这条毯子明显改善了她的舒适度和睡眠质量。

如果你想找一些帮助调节夜间温度变化的产品，强烈推荐！

如果您睡得热，这就是适合您的毯子！

body: This is the best cooling blanket I’ve tried! No more waking up multiple times a night from being too hot. It keeps me cool all night long. The fabric is silky soft and the quality is amazing. It’s a nice weight and is very easy to wash. Highly recommended!
translation: 这是我尝试过的最好的冷却毯！每晚都不会再醒来多次，因为太热了。它使我整夜很酷。织物柔滑，质量很棒。这是一个很好的重量，很容易洗涤。强烈推荐！

title: Meh...
body: This blanket does feel cool to the touch until you leave your hand or body part on it for a while, then it warms up.  If you're OK with having to move every couple of minutes, this is the blanket for you!  It is also quite weighty, almost like a weighted blanket.

translation: 当你第一次戴上它时，感觉就像你把它从冰箱里拿出来一样。在我的机器中清洗和干燥得很好。四星的唯一原因是因为它在晚上不保持凉爽。

translation: 我终于可以再次入睡了！对这个产品非常满意。不再盗汗。

title: Cost doesn’t equal durability 👎🏼
body: Love the cooling element, but for the price it shouldn’t be coming apart already. Not even a year in (and I only use it in the warmer months) and the seams are busting (see picture). I even wash on delicate and hang dry it.
translation: 喜欢冷却元件，但就价格而言，它不应该已经拆散。甚至不到一年（我只在温暖的月份使用它），接缝就破裂了（见图）。我什至会轻柔地清洗并悬挂晾干。

title: Too expensive
body: Not worth the money I spent. Feels cold for a min but after sleeping in it, it holds the heat.
translation: 不值得我花的钱。一分钟感觉很冷，但睡在里面后，它就保持了热量。

title: Barely feels cool when sleeping or to the touch and just bought it Thursdays.
body: This blanket has its ups and downs. Both my wife and I are very hot sleepers and unfortunately can not put an AC in our bedroom windows because of there design. We bought this 5 days ago and Id say the first day was the best. Right now it feels like if I was camping in a damp tent. Barely cooling now to either sleep or to the touch. Not sure if it's cause of the heat and how warm our room is but haven't been to impressed for the price, or how people hyped it up.
translation: 这条毯子有其优点和缺点。我和我的妻子都是很热的睡眠者，不幸的是，由于卧室的设计，我们无法在卧室的窗户上安装空调。我们五天前买了这个，我想说第一天是最好的。现在感觉就像我在潮湿的帐篷里露营一样。现在几乎没有冷却到睡觉或触摸。不确定这是否是炎热的原因以及我们的房间有多温暖，但对价格或人们如何炒作的印象并不深刻。

title: Staying cool

title: Satin

非常冷却...缎子

title: A truly honest review
body: This blanket is indeed cooling; however, it is still a blanket so what does a blanket do? It traps heat that radiates off of the human body. That being said, it still does a good job of finding the sweet spot between too hot and not too cold. It is very comfortable as well. It definitely has improved my sleep quality and I used this blanket all through the most recent East Coast heat wave. I am a hot sleeper, did I still wake up sweaty? Yup a couple times.  I think shoppers that interested in purchasing this blanket need to know that it is NOT an AC unit in blanket form. If you are expecting this blanket to be a game changer you will probably be disappointed. Like I said, it is cooling but it still does the job of a blanket. Its honestly nothing that AC and maybe even a fan cant fix though.  I would have given it 4 stars, BUT: 1. I was sent the wrong color. 2. Like others have said: some of the stitching has ripped only after 2 wash cycles.  I have decided to hang onto it for a bit longer before I decide to return it or not.
translation:
这条毯子确实很凉爽；然而，它仍然是一条毯子，那么毯子有什么作用呢？它捕获人体散发的热量。
话虽这么说，它仍然很好地找到了太热和不太冷之间的最佳平衡点。
它也很舒服。
它确实改善了我的睡眠质量，我在最近的东海岸热浪中一直使用这条毯子。
我睡得很热，醒来还是出汗吗？是的，有几次。

我认为有兴趣购买这款毯子的购物者需要知道它不是毯子形式的空调装置。如果您期待这条毯子能够改变游戏规则，您可能会失望。就像我说的，它很凉爽，但它仍然起到毯子的作用。
老实说，这并不是空调甚至风扇无法解决的问题。

我会给它 4 颗星，但是：
1. 我收到了错误的颜色。
2. 正如其他人所说：一些缝线仅在 2 次洗涤后才撕裂。

我决定在决定是否归还之前再保留它一段时间。

title: Didn’t work for us - slips down the bed
body: Really wanted to love this cooling blanket, especially because of the cost, but in the end, it just didn’t work out for us. The first one we received was not even properly in the packaging, so I’m thinking that was a returned item. The seller was very good and replaced the item.  Once we received a new blanket, we washed it and we’ve been using it for a little over a week. My biggest complaint is that it’s very slippery. It tends to slip down the bed throughout the night, so we end up with just the top sheet around our upper body.  It is definitely cool to the touch, but when we have another blanket on top of it, it almost seems to retain heat as much as it retains coolness. Can’t say I wouldn’t recommend it, but it just didn’t work for us.
translation:
真的很想喜欢这个冷却毯，特别是因为它的成本，但最终，它对我们来说并没有成功。我们收到的第一个商品甚至包装都不正确，所以我认为这是退货的商品。卖家人很好，还给换了东西。

title: Soft and cooling but stitching rips easily
body: This blanket does what it says. It is very cooling. If you wake up in the night hot, just moving the blanket will give you the coolness you need. 我真的很希望我能喜欢它，摸起来很酷，但在它下面很快就失去了凉爽，你必须重新洗牌才能再次激活凉爽。我喜欢这个颜色。虽然有点滑，但只要把它放在床底下就没事了。
