So now I'm sort of left looking towards other brands. I had hoped that spending what I did on this original purchase that it would be something I would have for a long time, never seen this before with a blanket, but here we are.
translation: 正如其他评论家所说，从我睡在这条毯子的第一晚起就爱上了它。但几个月后，也许是为了清洗周期，它的缝线开始变得非常松散。脚和脚趾经常被松散的线缠住，似乎它注定要拥有我所期望的从毯子里得到的充实生活。我不能说我以前用被子或毯子经历过这种情况。我喜欢再拥有一个，但只是假设它会在短时间内做同样的事情。我确实从这家公司购买了另一种款式，它有不同的缝线，重量不一样，也没有那么冷的感觉。所以现在我有点转向其他品牌。我本来希望花我在这件最初购买的东西上所做的事情，它会是我会拥有很长一段时间的东西，以前从来没有见过这样的毯子，但我们来了。

title: So Much Better Than I'd Expected!
body: I absolutely adore this blanket. I am the kind of person who can not sleep without a blanket, which can end up being really uncomfortable and too warm. This blanket is so silky and so soft and cool, it feels like the the cool side of your pillow. I've used this blanket every single night since I got it. I will be getting more of these in the future and will recommend to every person I know  whether or not they've asked for one!
translation: 我绝对喜欢这个毯子。我是那种不能没有毯子睡觉的人，最终可能会感到非常不舒服和温暖。这条毯子是如此的丝滑，如此柔软，凉爽，感觉就像枕头的凉爽一面。自从我得到它以来，我每天晚上都用这套毯子。将来我会得到更多这些，并将推荐我认识的每个人，他们是否要求一个！

title: Surprising find
body: Honestly love it. I was a little worried when I opened it and it was very thin. However laying on it is like laying on silk. My boyfriend didn’t like sleeping with me sometimes because he would get too hot with me, I’m a hot sleeper, now he sleeps with me. It keeps me warm yet anytime I move I get a nice cooling feeling. I would say definitely a lucky find and worth it for the price.
translation: 老实说。当我打开它时，我有点担心，而且非常薄。但是躺在上面就像躺在丝绸上。我的男朋友有时不喜欢和我一起睡觉，因为他会和我太热，我是个卧铺，现在他和我一起睡了。它会让我保持温暖，但每当我移动时，我都会得到一种很好的冷却感觉。我肯定会说一个幸运的发现，值得以价格。

title: So fresh
body: I love this cooling blanket, it feels so fresh to the touch and soft too. I like that I can use both sides
translation: 我喜欢这个冷却毯，感觉很新鲜，而且柔软。我喜欢我可以用双方

title: So soft and cooling to the touch!
body: The white is definitely more of a cream so I was disappointed about that but it serves its purpose in keeping me cool (hot sleeper). I upgraded to the king size but for some reason, I feel like the grey queen one I previously had (for a while) felt more cooling-IDK. I would still recommend though.
translation: 白色肯定更像是一种奶油，所以我对此感到失望，但它的目的是让我保持凉爽（热睡）。我升级到了特大号床，但出于某种原因，我觉得我之前（有一段时间）的灰色大号床感觉更凉爽——IDK。但我仍然会推荐。

title: So goooood
body: This blanket is incredible. I was getting so hot at night and it was miserable. I got this cooling blanket and it changed how I slept, it's soft, light, still super cozy and the color is gorgeous but very faint mint color. It's also very large!
translation: 这条毯子令人难以置信。我晚上变得如此热，这很痛苦。我得到了这个冷却的毯子，它改变了我睡觉的方式，它柔软，轻巧，仍然超级舒适，颜色很漂亮，但薄荷非常微弱。它也很大！

title: Somewhat works
body: I am a very hot sleeper so a purchased this to try and keep my sweat at bay. It work pretty good. I just don't like that it sticks to my dry skin. I ha e texture issues but I put a top sheet under it and I've been able to enjoy it more. Still can't give it a 5 star rating.
translation: 我是一个非常热的睡眠者，所以买了这个来试图防止我出汗。它工作得很好。我只是不喜欢它粘在我干燥的皮肤上。我有纹理问题，但我在它下面放了一张顶纸，我已经能够更享受它了。仍然不能给它5星评级。

title: a cooling blanket is delux
body: I have never owned a cooling blanket but this feels fantastic when you're a hot sleeper or especially during the summer months
translation: 我从来没有拥有冷却的毯子，但是当您是热门卧铺时，尤其是在夏季的几个月中，这感觉很棒

title: Perfect cooling blanket
body: My second one I’ve bought! I think I’ve become addicted to these blankets! They are so cozy to cuddle up in, I love them!
translation: 我买了第二个！我想我已经沉迷于这些毯子！他们非常舒适，可以拥抱，我爱他们！

title: AMAZING
body: If you are a perimenopausal/menopausal lady or sweaty hot sleeper kinda guy…..cannot recommend this comforter enough! Stays cool all night! I do not use sheets….just this blanket & pillowcases. Sleep has improved immensely after receiving as gift from my husband! Material soft too & great for hair, like silk! Nice simple design. Good quality for price!
translation: 如果您是绝经中/绝经的女士或汗湿的卧铺人……库纳特（Cannot）足够推荐这个床罩！整夜保持凉爽！我不使用床单……只是这个毯子和枕套。从我丈夫那里得到礼物后，睡眠得到了极大的改善！材料柔软，也很适合头发，例如丝绸！漂亮的简单设计。价格优质！

title: Best Night Sleep Ever!
body: The Cozy Bliss Cooling Comfortable is everything is claims to be! I was nervous that it would be too cold but the blanket is cool to the touch and helps regulate body heat. Laying down after a long day this blanket has such a luxurious feel and is so refreshing. My husband sweats every night but not with this one! We both slept like babies.
translation: 舒适的幸福冷却舒适是一切都声称的！我很紧张它太冷了，但是毯子很酷，有助于调节体内的热量。漫长的一天后放下毛毯的感觉如此奢华，令人耳目一新。我丈夫每天晚上都在汗水，但不要这样！我们俩都像婴儿一样睡觉。

title: The most comfortable blanket
body: I live in Texas and it gets hot here.  I now have (3) of these blankets.  They are so soft.  Washed in cold water with gentle detergent.  The best blanket I own
translation: 我住在德克萨斯州，这里很热。我现在有（3）个毯子。他们是如此柔软。用温和的洗涤剂在冷水中洗涤。我拥有的最好的毯子

title: Perfection!
body: My husband and I run hot at night so we decided to buy this for ourselves. The best thing we have ever bought! It keeps us nice and cool but just warm enough so we are not freezing. We now sleep like babies.
translation: 我和我的丈夫晚上奔跑，所以我们决定为自己购买。我们买过的最好的东西！它使我们保持良好和凉爽，但温暖得足够温暖，因此我们不冻结。我们现在像婴儿一样睡觉。

title: Coolest blanket ever!
body: I bought this blanket in March 2024, after trying a lot of different ways to stay cool at night.  This is the only thing that works!  I love it and I'm buying another one to use when I travel.
translation: 我在2024年3月尝试了许多不同的方法来在晚上保持凉爽之后，我买了这毯子。这是唯一有效的东西！我喜欢它，我在旅行时要购买另一个要使用的东西。

title: Amazing!
body: This cover is unlike anything I've ever experienced. It's lightweight, warm, and breathable, so I never get too hot. The quality of the material is exceptional. We have two cats who love to scratch at our covers, but despite their best efforts, this one has held up perfectly—not a single tear or even a small hole. I'm already planning to buy a few more in different colors!
translation: 这个封面与我经历过的任何东西都不一样。它轻巧，温暖和透气，所以我永远不会太热。材料的质量非常出色。我们有两只猫喜欢在我们的封面上刮擦，但是尽管他们尽了最大的努力，但这只猫已经完美地抓住了 - 不是一个撕裂，甚至是一个小孔。我已经打算再购买几种不同的颜色了！

title: What in the Westeros is this blanket!?
body: Winter is coming and I am ready! Finally a blanket that keeps me warm but cool at the same time! Most “cooling” comforters are actually created for keeping heat in; this blanket pulls heat away. It is also slightly weighted which makes it feel like a giant hug. I have been sleeping like my cat - after a long, exhausting day of judgement and sun naps.  Get one, get 2 because this will be the most sought after blankie in the house. Insider tip: I removed the top sheet because just that extra layer made the bed too hot and I could not feel the cooling. Without it - heaven- cooling abounds!  Great value for the money. Very soft; great quality, excellent smoothness.
translation:
冬天来了，我已经准备好了！终于有了一条既能让我温暖又凉爽的毯子！大多数“凉爽”被子实际上是为了保持热量而设计的。这条毯子可以带走热量。它也有轻微的重量，让人感觉像是一个巨大的拥抱。经过漫长而疲惫的一天的判断和日光小睡后，我一直像我的猫一样睡觉。

买一个，买两个，因为这将是家里最受欢迎的毯子。知情者提示：我取下了最上面的床单，因为那一层额外的床单让床太热了，我感觉不到凉爽。没有它——天堂般的清凉无处不在！

物超所值。非常柔软；品质优良，光滑度极佳。

title: Definitely cooling but cozy!!
body: The Cozy Bliss Cooling Comforter is a game-changer! It’s incredibly soft and lightweight, yet still provides the perfect amount of coziness. The cooling effect is amazing—I no longer wake up feeling overheated, even on warm nights. The material feels luxurious against the skin, and the quality is outstanding. It’s also easy to care for, which is a huge bonus. This comforter has completely transformed my sleep experience, and I can’t recommend it enough to anyone looking for ultimate comfort! I00% recommend. Worth every penny. I already own 3 and planning on a fourth.
translation: 舒适的幸福冷却床罩是改变游戏规则的！它非常柔软且轻巧，但仍然提供了完美的舒适感。冷却效果令人惊讶 - 即使在温暖的夜晚，我也不再醒来感到过热。这种材料对皮肤感到豪华，质量非常出色。这也很容易照顾，这是一个巨大的好处。这位床罩完全改变了我的睡眠体验，我不能向任何寻求最终舒适的人推荐它！ i00％推荐。值得每一分钱。我已经拥有3，并计划第四。

title: Love this!!
body: I got tired of waking up in the middle of the night burning up and I am the type of person who has to be covered in order to sleep. This blanket is super lightweight and buttery soft and I haven’t waken up burning up yet!
translation: 我已经厌倦了在深夜醒来的燃烧，我就是那种必须覆盖才能入睡的人。这条毯子超级轻巧且黄油柔软，我还没有醒来燃烧！

title: Amazing blanket
body: Wonderful cool blanket. Keeps me cool and warm at the same time. It has a very unique feel to it as well that I like. I like that it is machine washable.
translation: 很棒的凉爽毯子。让我同时保持凉爽和温暖。它也有一种非常独特的感觉，我喜欢。我喜欢它可以机洗。

title: Nice looking but not cooling
body: This works as just a regular comforter, it looks nice but it doesn’t cool.
translation: 这只是一个普通的被子，看起来不错，但并不酷。

title: Love it
body: I love this blanket. It helps my body temperature regulate in the hot summer nights
translation: 我爱这个毯子。它可以帮助我的体温调节在炎热的夏日之夜
sku: Color: Tie Dye Denim Blue|Size: Twin(60"*90")

title: Recommend for hot sleepers!
body: I get hot very easily and this is perfect for my bed! It keeps me cool, very comfortable, great design and very durable. Big, thick, and helps me to sleep.
translation: 我很容易变热，这非常适合我的床！它使我保持凉爽，非常舒适，设计精美且非常耐用。大，厚，可以帮助我入睡。

title: Great customer service from Cozy Bliss
body: I love a company that stands behind their products. I highly recommend this blanket. It keeps your body temperature regulated and it helps you sleep better.
translation: 我喜欢一家站在他们产品后面的公司。我强烈建议您使用此毯子。它可以使您的体温保持调节，并可以帮助您更好地入睡。

title: Not a cooling blanket
body: I purchased this because I am a hot sleeper and very disappointed. I wake up in the middle of the night having to kick it off because it gets so hot. It is very soft and it is very cool when you first put it on, but it doesn’t keep you cool. Very disappointing.
translation: 我买这个是因为我睡得很热而且非常失望。我半夜醒来，不得不把它踢掉，因为天气太热了。它非常柔软，刚穿上的时候非常凉爽，但它并不能让你保持凉爽。非常令人失望。

title: Love it
body: I love this blanket.  It keeps me SO cool..........no more waking up sweating.  I sleep so sound through the night, it startles me when the alarm goes off  LOL.  Totally a keeper in my opinion.  I recommend buying this........  You won't regret it !!!!
translation: 我喜欢这条毯子。 它让我很凉爽..........不再醒来时出汗。 我整晚都睡得很香，当闹钟响起时，我吓了一跳，哈哈。 在我看来，完全是一个守门员。 我建议买这个........ 你不会后悔的!!!

title: Worth the buy!
body: This is by far my favorite blanket I bought one in queen size and it is worth it. It keeps cool but if your under it it warms you up. This is great if your someone who’s hot at night and sweats. The material is so soft and feel luxurious and it washes well. Will buy more for the kids beds. I purchased queen size in the charcoal grey.
translation: 这是迄今为止我最喜欢的毯子，我买了一条大号的毯子，它是值得的。它保持凉爽，但如果你在它下面，它会让你暖和起来。如果您的人晚上很热并且出汗，这非常有用。这种材料非常柔软，感觉奢华，而且耐洗。会多买一些儿童床。我买了大号的炭灰色。

title: Great for hot flashes
body: I am a hot sleeper and get hot flashes. This blanket is a life saver.
translation: 我是一个热睡者并且会出现潮热。这条毯子是救星。

title: The silky cover is what makes it work
body: Don’t buy the cotton one!
translation: 不要买棉花！

title: Good in theory
body: It feels nice and cool to the touch.. so nice it almost slips off your body. However the thread/stitching that makes the pattern comes apart with every wash (even with following thorough washing directions). After a year most of the thread has fallen apart or I've had to cut it off. I almost wish it didnt have that extra stitching. Other than that it was a decent purchase.
translation: 摸起来感觉很好很凉……太好了，几乎从你的身上滑下来。然而，每次洗涤时，构成图案的线/缝线都会分开（即使遵循彻底的洗涤说明）。一年后，大部分线都散了，或者我不得不把它剪掉。我几乎希望它没有多余的缝线。除此之外，这是一次不错的购买。

title: Not as happy the second time around.
body: I gor the light blue and gray sometime at the beginning of the year as a gift and eventually the threads all started tearing on the quilting but thw blanket still worked fantastic. I never got hot at night. But I just got the dark gray light gray for my birthday and this thing is never cold. It doesn't work at all. I'm very disappointed.
translation:
今年年初的某个时候，我选择了浅蓝色和灰色作为礼物，最终所有的线都开始在绗缝上撕裂，但毯子仍然效果很好。我晚上从来不热。
但我生日那天刚买了深灰色浅灰色，这东西从来不冷。它根本不起作用。我很失望。

title: Cool gift
body: I bought this as a gift for a friend who sleeps hot. They have one at home and will be coming to visit. What better gift than comfort?
translation: 我买了这个作为礼物送给睡得很热的朋友。他们家里有一个，会来拜访。还有什么比舒适更好的礼物呢？

title: SUPER SOFT
body: this has to be the softest blanket I’ve ever felt! So excited to see how well it keeps me cool tonight!
translation: 这一定是我感觉过的最柔软的毯子！很高兴看到它今晚让我保持凉爽！

title: It's cooling and so soft
body: I was skeptical  since some of the reviews were  not very positive.  I  washed the blanket immediately.  The blanket had no issue with stitching and looked beautiful on my bed.  After few days of use, I  must say...it does the job.  I  lay on top of the blanket when I get hot and cools me down immediately.  It's also pretty cozy and warm in the inside, but the outer layer stays cool.  Great to put my leg over it when I sleep.
translation: 我持怀疑态度，因为一些评论不是很积极。我立即洗了毯子。毯子没有缝线问题，在我的床上看起来很漂亮。使用了几天后，我必须说...它可以完成工作。当我变热时，我躺在毯子的顶部，然后立即冷却我。内部也很舒适和温暖，但外层保持凉爽。我睡觉时很高兴将腿放在上面。

title: Stitches falling apart
body: Was happy with the product but after 3 months of purchase the stitches are falling apart.
translation: 对产品很满意，但购买 3 个月后，缝线就散开了。

title: Love this product!
body: This blanket is so nice, comfy, soft and cozy.  My husband is a “hot sleeper” and I am a “cold sleeper” and we both are comfortable.  I have bought a couple of these for my family members as well.  Highly Recommended!!
translation: 这条毯子非常漂亮，舒适，柔软和舒适。我的丈夫是一个“热门的卧铺”，我是一个“冷卧铺”，我们俩都很舒服。我也为我的家人买了几个。强烈推荐！！

title: Great, but temporary cooling effect
body: I really liked the weight and feel of the fabric. Very uniquely cool. It just doesn’t stay cool because it’ll eventually pick up your body heat. However you can turn it to the other side once the cooling effect tapers off. My kids liked it so much they stole it from me so I’ll have to buy another one. Haven’t had the chance to wash it yet so we’ll see how that goes.
translation: 我真的很喜欢这种面料的重量和触感。非常独特酷。它只是不能保持凉爽，因为它最终会吸收你的体温。但是，一旦冷却效果逐渐减弱，您可以将其转向另一侧。我的孩子们非常喜欢它，他们从我这里偷了它，所以我不得不再买一个。还没有机会洗，所以我们看看情况如何。

title: LOVE!!!
body: I don’t know what kind of magic this is and i  don’t care. This blanket is the best. I refused to pay the higher prices some of the other ‘cooling’ blankets were asking so I worried this might not do the job but it does the job magnificently. It really is cool to the touch and on a warm night when I still need a blanket to get to sleep, this baby is the blanket I want and the one you should want too. I can’t say enough good things about it. Buy it!
translation: 我不知道这是什么魔术，我不在乎。这个毯子是最好的。我拒绝支付更高的价格，其他一些“冷却”毯子在问，所以我担心这可能没有工作，但它可以很好地完成这项工作。触摸确实很酷，在一个温暖的夜晚，当我仍然需要毯子睡觉时，这个婴儿是我想要的毯子，也是您应该想要的毯子。我不能对此说足够的好话。买！

title: Not cooling
body: Hello. This is a nice blanket. It is soft & comfortable.. BUT i feel like i sweat more with it. Wake up drenched. Hasn't helped at all.
translation: 你好。这是一条漂亮的毯子。它柔软舒适。但我觉得我用它出汗更多。醒来浑身湿透。根本没有帮助。

title: Cool to the touch!
body: I love this blanket ! It’s very nice! the blanket is soft and cool to the touch. Now I can sleep at night without feeling so hot.
translation: 我爱这个毯子！很好！毯子柔软而凉爽。现在我可以在晚上睡觉而不会感到很热。

title: Cool for those sweaty nights
body: Great blanket for the hot sleeper. Love the two-tone grey color. It’s thinner than a comforter but comfortable. Always cool to the touch but keeps you warm at the same time if that makes any sense. My boyfriend still has sweaty nights with the blanket and there is a little snag that was on a seam but that is my only complaint and why I deducted a star. No smell out of the packaging and I think it’s comparable to the rest blanket and less expensive. Will update the review after I wash it. Have had it for over a month.
translation: 非常适合热睡者的毯子。喜欢双色调的灰色。它比被子薄但很舒服。触感始终凉爽，但同时又能让您保持温暖（如果有道理的话）。我的男朋友仍然会在晚上用毯子出汗，接缝处有一个小障碍，但这是我唯一的抱怨，也是我扣一颗星的原因。包装上没有气味，我认为它与其他毯子相当，而且更便宜。洗完之后再更新评论。已经吃了一个多月了。

title: Cooling comforter
body: I have a full bed and I use the twin size across my bed.  It is wonderful material that stays cool. I use it on top of my flat sheet and love to touch this cool blanket with my hands
translation: 我有一张床，我在床上使用双胞胎尺寸。这是很棒的材料。我在平板上使用它，喜欢用双手触摸这个凉爽的毯子

title: As advertised
body: This is perfect. Keep in mind these comforters are not designed to stay freezing all night. If you get warm just adjust your position
translation: 这是完美的。请记住，这些床罩的设计并非整夜保持冻结。如果您感到温暖，请调整您的位置

title: The blanket is amazing..but....
body: The material, feel are amazing. It's light weight, beautiful and the color is perfect. I've never felt material quite like this before. The inside of the blanket does heat up, but not as much as other blankets. The outside stays very very cool to the touch and I often flip the blanket while sleeping to put the cooler side on me.. The one gripe I have is that after about a month a few threads in the middle of the blanket came free in the middle, causing a string 'loop' that was still stitched on either side.. My feet or a hand will get snagged in them while I sleep now. The company offered that I could return it and get 'some of my money back' since it was over a month. I opted to just keep it since I really do love the blanket. I just wish the stitching would have kept better.
translation: 材质、手感都很棒。它重量轻、美观、颜色完美。我以前从未有过这样的物质感受。毯子内部确实会升温，但不像其他毯子那么热。外面摸起来非常凉爽，我经常在睡觉时翻转毯子，把凉爽的一面放在我身上。我有一个抱怨是，大约一个月后，毯子中间的几根线在中间松脱，导致两侧仍然缝着的绳子“环”。我现在睡觉时，我的脚或手会被它们缠住。该公司表示我可以退货并拿回“部分钱”，因为已经过去了一个多月了。我选择保留它，因为我真的很喜欢这条毯子。我只是希望缝合能保持得更好。

title: Does what it advertises
body: Love love this blanket!  I used to spend each night on top of the covers due to hot flashes. Now I stay under this awesome cool blanket!  It really does help with hot flashes!!
translation: 爱这个毯子！由于闪烁，我曾经每天晚上都在封面上度过。现在我呆在这个很棒的毛毯下！它确实有助于潮热！！

title: Nice blanket, poor customer support
body: The blanket is cozy and adds some light coolness at night. They sent the wrong color and said I could only return it in its original packaging, which was destroyed in order to remove it. I contacted customer support but got no response!
translation: 毯子很舒适，在晚上增添了一些凉爽。他们发错了颜色，并说我只能用原包装退回，为了取出它，原包装被毁掉了。我联系了客户支持，但没有得到回复！

title: Cool and warm at the same time.
body: It is light and cool but warm at the same time.
translation: 它是轻便而凉爽但同时温暖的。

title: Helps keep you cool at night!
body: We got this during a heat wave in SoCal and we don't have AC. The fan was not enough, so I checked for a cooling blanket. This worked well! The only issue I have with it, is that the stitches on it popped fairly easily on the quilting. So far it's good though. What helps also is to lay it on the bed and sleep on top of it.
translation: 我们在南加州热浪期间得到了这个，而且我们没有空调。风扇不够用，所以我检查了冷却毯。这效果很好！我遇到的唯一问题是，它的缝线很容易在绗缝上弹出。到目前为止还不错。还有一个帮助就是将它放在床上并睡在上面。

title: It doesn't keep me cool
body: It feels like a normal comforter to me. I write this review a day after waking up in a sweaty mess with both a ceiling fan and floor fan running on high while sleeping in this so-called cooling comforter.
translation: 对我来说，这感觉就像一个普通的被子。我在写这篇评论的一天后，在浑身是汗的情况下醒来，吊扇和落地扇都开得很高，而我睡在这个所谓的凉爽被子里。

title: Breaks apart
body: After about 2 months the stitching is coming undone. Also, my bed was itchy, so I think it has fiberglass in it. It does get really cold but that only last for about 5 mins. Not worth the money
translation: 大约 2 个月后，缝合处即将解开。另外，我的床很痒，所以我觉得里面有玻璃纤维。它确实变得非常冷，但只持续大约 5 分钟。不值钱

title: Blanket was used
body: I received my package and when I opened it the bag the blanket was in had already been ripped opened. After examining the blanket it’s self, it was not the color that I ordered. I also found multiple stains and was definitely used. 10/10 would not recommend 👎🏻
translation: 我收到了包裹，当我打开它时，毯子所在的袋子已经被撕开。检查完毯子本身后，发现它不是我订购的颜色。我还发现了多个污渍并且肯定被使用过。 10/10 不推荐👎🏻

title: Low quality
body: I purchased this blanket for its cooling properties, and while it does provide some breathability, the cooling effect is quite subtle. It’s comfortable, but not as cool as I was hoping for.  One area that could be improved is the stitching. After a few uses, I noticed some of the seams starting to come undone, which is a bit disappointing. Overall, it’s a decent blanket, but I think there’s room for improvement in terms of both durability and cooling performance.
translation:
我购买这条毯子是因为它具有冷却性能，虽然它确实提供了一定的透气性，但冷却效果相当微妙。它很舒服，但没有我希望的那么酷。

可以改进的一个地方是缝合。使用几次后，我注意到一些接缝开始松开，这有点令人失望。总的来说，这是一条不错的毯子，但我认为在耐用性和冷却性能方面还有改进的空间。

title: It’s cooling with just the right amount of weight.
body: My favorite blanket!
translation: 我最喜欢的毯子！

title: Blanket.
body: Great, cool, but it’s more of a blanket and not a comforter.
translation: 太好了，很酷，但它更像是毯子，而不是床罩。
sku: Color: Tie Dye Denim Blue|Size: Queen(90"*90")

title: actually cools
body: im an avid sweaty sleeper and this saved my life. definitely recommend
translation: 我是一个狂热的汗流浃背的睡眠者，这救了我的命。绝对推荐

title: Meh
body: It worked ok for a little while. Cheap stitching came undone pretty quickly, doesn’t really cool as much anymore either. The material also stains realllly easily.  Got another brand as a spare and that one works much better.
translation: 有一段时间效果还不错。便宜的缝线很快就被拆开了，也不再那么酷了。这种材料也很容易弄脏。买了另一个品牌作为备用，那个效果更好。

title: My favorite blanket!
body: This is the 3rd cooling blanket I purchased in my attempt to find a perfect one.  This is it.  It's supersoft, lightweight and really is cooling.  I love this so much I've bought 5 others so far too share with family and friends,  and do far all have agreed with me.
translation:
这是我购买的第三个冷却毯，试图找到一个完美的毯子。就是这样。

它是超级轻巧的，而且确实很冷。我非常喜欢这一点，我已经买了5个其他人，到目前为止，我也与家人和朋友分享了，并且远远与我同意。

title: Feels like stocking nylon, very hot
body: Not the right blanket. My partner and I were sweating from it and the material feels like thick stocking nylon that could snag very easily. Not worth the $75 for us since it is not breathable and cooling, as advertised. Will be returning and buying a different blanket.
translation: 不是合适的毯子。我和我的搭档都在出汗，这种材料感觉就像厚袜子尼龙，很容易被钩住。对我们来说，75 美元不值得，因为它不透气、不凉爽，正如广告上所说的那样。将返回并购买不同的毯子。

title: Hot flashes and night sweats
body: Love this blanket keeps you feeling cool. Washable, lightweight, soft love the color I would buy this again.
translation:
爱这个毯子会让您感到凉爽。
可洗，轻巧，柔软的爱颜色
我会再次购买。

title: The best cooling comforter ever!
body: We have bought two so far! My son is 13 and just sleeps hot. He loves that is soft and cooling. Everyone that comes over asked where we got it- this would be nice to sell in a kohls! Easy to clean as well.
translation: 到目前为止，我们已经买了两个！我的儿子13岁，睡得很热。他喜欢柔软而冷却的。每个人都问我们从哪里得到的人 - 在Kohls中出售这将是一个不错的选择！也易于清洁。

title: It does feel cool, but
body: The blanket feels very soft and it’s thin & not bulky. It’s not nice enough to use it as the bedding. It does feel super cool. Bought this a month ago and all the stitching is already unraveling.
translation: 毯子感觉很柔软，很薄且不笨重。将其用作床上用品还不够好。确实感觉超级酷。一个月前购买了它，所有缝线都已经拆开了。

title: Great cooling blanket
body: If you get hot at night yet still want a blanket, this is the one for you. So soft and cool to the touch. Nice quality as well. Love it!
translation:
如果您晚上很热但仍然想要毯子，这就是适合您的。如此柔软而凉爽。
质量也不错。爱它！

title: Poor quality
body: I waited awhile before posting a review. I like to actually use a product and see how it holds up. This one was very disappointing. This blanket is made with very poor quality. The stitching came apart quickly and it is lumpy.
translation: 我等了一会儿才发表评论。我喜欢实际使用产品并看看它的效果如何。这一个非常令人失望。这条毯子的质量很差。缝线很快就分开了，而且很粗糙。

title: It really works
body: I love my cooling blanket. I can believe it really keeps me cool.
translation: 我喜欢我的降温毯。我相信它确实让我保持冷静。

title: BUY, BUY, BUY AIN’T NO LIE
body: Y’all, I recommend this to any of my peeps out there who sleep hot or going through menopause or whatever! Men can sleep hot too this is the real deal! I bought another  blanket from somewhere else first that said it was a cooling blanket, NO- it was a joke! This is the real deal! So worth the money! I washed it and let it dry all by itself, it does have washing instructions follow them
translation: 大家，我建议我的任何一个偷看的人都睡得很热或经历更年期或其他任何东西！男人也可以很热，这是真正的交易！我首先从其他地方买了另一个毯子，说那是一条冷却的毯子，没有 - 这是个玩笑！这是真正的交易！值得钱！我洗了它，让它独自干燥，它确实有洗涤说明

title: It really is cool 😎
body: I like this blanket a lot. I’m run hot and being too hot makes me wake up. So to be comfortable I need to be not too hot and not too cold like Goldilocks and the 3 Bears! I chose this blue color which is nice and neutral for both genders I think. I like the stitching but more importantly I like the weight and feel of the blanket. This one is a winner!
translation: 我非常喜欢这个毯子。我奔跑热，太热会让我醒来。因此，为了舒适，我需要不要太热，不要像Goldilocks和3只熊那样冷！我选择了这种蓝色，对于我认为的两个性别而言，它都很好且中立。我喜欢缝线，但更重要的是，我喜欢毯子的重量和感觉。这是赢家！

title: So soft and cool feeling
body: This blanket is light weight and super soft and cool to the touch. If it gets warm you just find another area to snuggle up with and it’s cool. I have two. One in the guest bedroom and one in the master bedroom.
translation: 这条毯子重量轻，超级柔软，触摸。如果变暖，您只会找到另一个可以依ugg的区域，而且很酷。我有两个。一个在客人卧室，一间在主卧室。

title: Would give 10 stars if I could
body: Bought one for me and it is so awesome had to get one for my granddaughter
translation: 为我买了一个，真是太棒了，必须为我的孙女买一个
sku: Color: Tie Dye Denim Blue|Size: Twin(60"*90")

title: Cooling and soft, king-size pillows r hard and not cooling
body: I wish the three pillows I ordered were a lot more comfortable and soft for my head and my neck. I’m very disappointed two of them. I don’t use it all and the one is used when I’m sitting up in bed and not sleeping. I would very much like to return the other two, but I have opened them all to put in pillowcases to use and sleep with! Please let me know if there’s anyway I can return the other two for full credit as they are in excellent almost unused condition. Thank you.
translation: 我希望我订购的三个枕头对我的头部和颈部来说更加舒适和柔软。我对他们两个非常失望。我不会全部使用它，只有当我坐在床上不睡觉时才使用它。我非常想退回另外两个，但我已经将它们全部打开并放入枕套中使用和睡觉！请告诉我是否有办法退回另外两件以获得全额积分，因为它们状况良好，几乎未使用。谢谢。

title: It actually works!
body: Does exactly what it says. Didn’t think it would actually work, but I was wrong. I love this thing!
translation: 完全按照它所说的去做。我没想到它真的会奏效，但我错了。我喜欢这个东西！

title: Great cooling blanket
body: I’ve been using this comforter on top of my sheets for a few weeks now and love it! I love the cooling feature, and it’s so smooth and cozy! My dog loves it too! Great quality.
translation: 我已经在床单上使用了这个床罩了几个星期，喜欢它！我喜欢冷却功能，它是如此流畅和舒适！我的狗也喜欢它！高质量。

title: Love it!
body: I’ve been pregnant the entire summer and still dealing with hot days as we speak and I needed a new blanket to sleep under. I was looking for an affordable cooling blanket and this one has been in my cart for MONTHS! Once I saw the sale and the queen being only $67 I had to buy it. It’s cooling, comfortable and the material is soft. I washed it in cold water and air dried it in the dryer and it had no issues.
translation: 整个夏天，我都怀孕了，在我们讲话时仍在处理炎热的日子，我需要一条新的毯子才能睡觉。我一直在寻找负担得起的冷却毯子，这层在我的购物车上已经好几个月了！一旦我看到销售，女王只有67美元，我就必须购买。它是冷却，舒适的，材料柔软。我在冷水中洗涤它，并在干衣机中将其干燥，没有问题。

title: It actually cools you down
body: My husband loves how cool this blanket is. He runs hot and always has a fan on himself to cool down at night. This blanket really helps cool you down. Great buy!
translation: 我丈夫喜欢这毯子多么酷。他奔跑热，总是有风扇在晚上冷却。这条毯子确实可以使您冷静下来。太好了！

title: Very cool all nite
body: I was very skeptical.  But totally surprised.  I love the coolness. The thin blanket has weight to it. Just how I like my blankets. I needed help sleeping.  Nite sweating sucks. So glad at 65 years old I found this.
translation: 我非常怀疑。但完全感到惊讶。我喜欢冷静。薄毯子有重量。我的毯子如何。我需要帮助睡觉。黑夜出汗很烂。在65岁的时候，我很高兴找到了这个。

title: Cool to touch
body: Cool to touch, medium weight, durable material, good value for the price.
translation: 触感凉爽，中等重量，耐用的材料，物有所值。

title: Super soft
body: I love this comforter! It’s super soft and cool to the touch. Very cozy; I might get another color 🙌🏻
translation: 我喜欢这个被子！它超级柔软，摸起来很凉爽。非常舒适;我可能会得到另一种颜色 🙌🏻

title: Most amazing blanket ever
body: This blanket is so lightweight yet keeps you warm and cool at the same time. I can’t explain it. The fabric feels like butter and I can’t wait every night to get into bed because it is so cozy. I just love it.  I get hot very easily and this keeps me nice and cool with or without a sheet underneath. Highly recommend as I’ve had other supposed cooling blankets for my bed and nothing else is compared to this
translation: 这条毯子是如此轻巧，但可以使您同时保持温暖和凉爽。我无法解释。织物感觉就像黄油一样，我迫不及待地等待着上床睡觉，因为它是如此舒适。我只是喜欢它。我很容易变得很热，这使我保持友善和凉爽，无论下面是否没有一张床单。强烈推荐，因为我有其他假定的冷却毯子，我的床也没有其他比较

title: Excellent!
body: Super soft, silky-like material. Much thinner than a regular comforter. Keeps me cool at night. LOVE!
translation: 超柔软的丝般般的材料。比普通的床罩更薄。让我晚上保持凉爽。爱！

title: So Cool!
body: This blanket is so nice and cool!  Love it!  Got the twin size to use on the couch.
translation: 这条毯子真是太酷了！爱它！在沙发上使用了双重大小。

title: SUPER SOFT AND COZZY
body: Not only do I love it...my husky wraps himself up in it... seriously gives you the cold but warm soft cuddle feeling before you had to wake up for school in the morning when you were young feeling... only way to describe it... so happy it was on sale... absolutely more than worth the money
translation: 我不仅喜欢它...我的沙哑人把自己包裹在里面...认真地给您冷酷而温暖的拥抱感觉，然后您不得不在您年轻的感觉到早晨醒来上学...只是形容它的唯一方法...很高兴它在销售...绝对值得一提的钱

title: It really works!
body: I love this blanket, it actually works to help keep you cool, and also the perfect thickness to keep you warm. Feels verrry soft and comfortable.  I haven’t washed it yet but overall so far, I love it!
translation: 我喜欢这个毯子，它实际上可以帮助您保持凉爽，也可以使您保持温暖的完美厚度。感觉柔软舒适。我还没有洗过它，但是总的来说，我喜欢它！

title: Awesome
body: I love the color, feel, softness, and coolness.
translation: 我喜欢颜色，感觉，柔软和凉爽。
sku: Color: Tie Dye Denim Blue|Size: Queen(90"*90")

title: Cool breeze
body: This is crazy on how good it is. Love it.
translation: 这对它的表现很疯狂。爱它。

title: Worth the purchase
body: Color, coolness, quality are GREAT. They are wrinkly but that’s the least of my concerns. Kept my 19 year old son cool Worth purchasing
translation:
颜色，凉爽，质量很棒。它们皱纹，但这是我最不关心的问题。让我19岁的儿子很酷
值得购买

title: So soft
body: This product is so great I will buy for all my rooms
translation: 这个产品太棒了，我会为我所有的房间购买
sku: Color: Tie Dye Denim Blue|Size: Queen(90"*90")

title: We will try a new blanket
body: I received the blanket today 9-16-24 I can’t say much about it like if it made us sweat or not I took pictures of how it came the quality looks and feels fantastic. 9-17-24 We tried it already and just think that this amazing blanket it’s different than any other blanket I sweated a little not like the other blanket I had. I bought other one I really! liked it a lot good great quality blanket and sky blue was in special price the other ones are more expensive. %100
translation: 我今天收到了9-16-24的毯子，我不能说太多，如果让我们汗水，我都没有拍照，我为质量外观和感觉很棒拍照。 9-17-24我们已经尝试过它，只是认为这件惊人的毯子与我有点不像其他毯子的其他毯子不同。我真的买了另一个！喜欢它的优质毯子，而天蓝色的特殊价格更为昂贵。 ％100

title: Love this product
body: This is by far the best blanket I have bought from Amazon. The cooling actually works and it’s very soft to touch (which I personally love). I love the color I chose, gray, and the price was worth it to me. We have a split king and it fit our bed perfectly! Very happy with this purchase!
translation: 这是我从亚马逊购买的最好的毯子。冷却实际上有效，触摸非常柔软（我个人喜欢）。我喜欢我选择的颜色，灰色，价格对我来说是值得的。我们有一个分裂的国王，它非常适合我们的床！这次购买非常满意！

title: Amazzziinnggg and I need more
body: Best sleep I’ve gotten in YEARSSSS… I’ve already bought a 2nd blanket, and 2 different pillow case sets… Cozy bliss can y’all make a bottom sheet?? I’m a hooottt sleeper, keep my AC on 60, sleep with my ceiling fan on high, a box fan on high, and a portable desk fan on my night stand directly blowing in my face and still get too hot (until I got this comforter lol) but now I need a bottom sheet too 😅😅 and clothes,,, can yall also start making clothes?? Whatever this material is I need it for everything in life… k thanks!! ❤️❤️
translation: 我已经在几年里得到了最好的睡眠……我已经买了第二个毯子，还有2个不同的枕头套装……舒适的幸福可以做一个底部纸吗？我是一个hoottt卧铺，让我的AC保持在60岁，与吊扇高高睡觉，高高的盒子风扇，以及我的夜床上的便携式桌子风扇直接在我的脸上吹来，并且仍然太热（直到我得到了这个床头大声笑），但是现在我需要一个底部的床单，也可以穿上衣服，并且可以开始制作衣服了吗？无论这些材料是什么，我都需要生活中的一切……k谢谢！ ❤️❤️

title: La solución perfecta
body: Este edredón solucionó mi problema de taparme por la noche con algo ligero, pero que pese. El edredón es fresco y suave. Desde que lo tengo duermo mucho mejor porque no me despierto acalorada.
translation: 这张照片解决了我的问题，可以在晚上用轻亮，但称重。舒适既新鲜又柔软。因为我睡得好多了，因为我不会醒来。

title: Cozy blanket
body: It's awesome!!!
translation: 太棒了！！！

title: WOW! Softest blanket I’ve ever had!
body: This blanket far supersedes my expectations. It is definitely a cooling blanket. It is soft and thin and cuddly. Yet warm enough. I’m actually going to buy one in blue so I have two to rotate. I highly recommend this blanket if you’re looking for a soft, comfortable cooling blanket for the summer.
translation: 这个毯子远远超过了我的期望。绝对是冷却毯。它柔软而薄而可爱。还足够温暖。我实际上要以蓝色购买一个，所以我有两个要旋转。如果您正在寻找夏季柔软，舒适的冷却毯子，我强烈建议您使用此毯子。

title: Really does stay cool
body: Was pleasantly surprised at how cool this blanket actually stays. Super soft and silky.
translation: 这层毯子的实际凉爽感到非常惊喜。超柔软和丝滑。

title: Actually does cool you and it's so soft, it's like touching satin
body: This blanket is fantastic. If you get hot at night or if it's just hot in your house. This blanket really is cooling, not to mention that it is so soft.  I can't take a picture of the blanket to show it to you. Because my 14-year-old son has already stolen it. My husband just bought me another one.I will make a video when that one comes in!
translation: 这条毯子很棒。如果您晚上很热，或者只是在房子里很热。这个毯子真的很冷，更不用说它是如此柔软。我不能给毯子的照片显示给您。因为我14岁的儿子已经偷走了它。我丈夫刚刚给我买了一个。我会在那张视频时制作一个视频！

title: I think I received a used blanket
body: The blanket was not in plastic nor did it have a bow or ribbon, it came partially folded and partially squished in a brown box . I’m not sure I’ll keep this used blanket . I just received it today so don’t know if it works but I’m definitely unhappy about the way it was delivered.
translation: 毯子不是塑料的，也没有蝴蝶结或丝带，部分折叠，部分被挤压在棕色盒子里。我不确定我会不会留着这条用过的毯子。我今天刚收到，不知道能不能用，但我对送货方式确实很不满意。

title: Does NOT cool as advertized
body: It is a thin comforter, with a satin cover. Feels cool (room temp) for about 3 seconds until it reaches your body temperature, then it is just as hot as any other thin comforter. I guess it you move every 2 seconds you would get the sensation of coolness. Way over priced for a simple, not down, cover.
translation: 这是一种薄被，上面有缎面。感觉凉爽（室温）约 3 秒，直至达到您的体温，然后与其他薄被一样热。我想如果你每2秒移动一下，你就会有凉爽的感觉。对于一个简单的、非羽绒的封面来说，价格太高了。

title: Really works
body: This is amazing and really works so comfy!
translation: 这真是太神奇了，真的很舒适！

title: Great Blanket
body: I love the quality of this blanket. Soft and cool on top. It is the best spring, summer, fall blanket I have ever had. Highly recommend.
translation: 我喜欢这个毯子的质量。柔软而凉爽。这是我有史以来最好的春季，夏季，秋季毯子。强烈推荐。

title: Best cooling blanket
body: My fiancé suffers from night sweats and this was his life saver!! I’ve been looking for the longs time for a nice and affordable cooling blanket and this one did not disappoint.
translation: 我的未婚夫患有夜汗，这是他的救生员！我一直在寻找漫长的时间，以提供一条漂亮且负担得起的冷却毯，这并不令人失望。

title: Works as says-comfy and cooling
body: Purchased this for my daughter as a birthday gift & she loves it so much I got one for myself! Eases my menopausal heat strokes like a charm!!!
translation: 为我的女儿买了这个生日礼物，她非常喜欢我，我为自己买了一个礼物！像魅力一样轻松地减轻了我的更年期中风！！！

title: Cooling blanket
body: Start with my positive: light weight for sleeping, like the feel My negative: does not stay cool for long, which was the only reason for purchasing.
translation:
从我的积极方面开始：重量轻，适合睡眠，喜欢这种感觉
我的缺点：不能长时间保持凉爽，这是购买的唯一原因。

title: Actually Really Amazing!
body: I recently had surgery and have been struggling to sleep. Waking up covered in sweat. I didn't have a ton of hope for this but it was on sale. It's kind of amazing! Feels cool to the touch and stays that way throughout the night. Really helped me sleep cooler. You can't use a top sheet or anything, it needs to be right on your skin. I followed the washing directions and it washed well. Very happy!
translation: 我最近接受了手术，一直在努力入睡。醒来被汗水覆盖。我对此没有很大的希望，但它正在销售。有点太神奇了！感觉很酷，整夜保持这种状态。真的帮助我睡得更酷。您不能使用顶层或任何东西，它需要在您的皮肤上。我遵循洗涤指示，洗净得很好。很高兴！

title: Great material, but poor stitching quality. Falling apart.
body: I love the feeling of this material, definitely cooling. BUT, this comforter is VERY poorly made. Within 1 wash, the stitching was falling apart. Almost all of the pleats are gone and it looks very cheap. Still comfy, so if you don't care about the aesthetics then I'd still recommend.
translation: 我喜欢这种材料的感觉，绝对凉爽。但是，这个被子做工很差。洗涤 1 次后，缝线就脱落了。几乎所有的褶子都消失了，看起来非常廉价。还是很舒服，所以如果你不关心美观那么我仍然推荐。

title: Best Purchase EVER
body: I live in a pretty tropical, humid area that gets horribly hot during the summer. This blanket is absolutely perfect. Whatever magic they use to keep that cooling feeling is just amazing. The quality is great and the material is just so soft and comfy. Would definitely purchase again.
translation: 我住在一个非常热带潮湿的地区，夏天变得非常热。这条毯子绝对是完美的。他们用来保持冷却感觉的任何魔法真是太神奇了。质量很棒，材料是如此柔软和舒适。一定会再次购买。

title: Very soft and comfortable
body: This blanket is definitely cooling! My husband prefers to sleep on top on this blanket, with blankets on top of him. We get a good mix of warm and cool :)
translation:
这条毯子绝对是冷却的！我丈夫更喜欢睡在这条毯子上，毯子在他身上。
我们得到了温暖和凉爽的很好的混合:)

title: Does not work
body: Spend the extra money to buy the real thing this is trash not a cooling blanket
translation: 多花点钱买正品，这是垃圾，不是凉毯

title: Love!
body: Definitely soft and cooling. Perfect for me, nice value too.
translation: 绝对柔软而冷却。对我来说是完美的，也很有价值。

title: Well worth the money
body: I’ve been hot underneath my comforter every night waking up throughout the night to remove the comforter. This cover changed that completely. I can sleep through the night without sweating and waking up from being hot.
translation: 我每天晚上在整个晚上醒来都在床下一直很热，以卸下床罩。这个封面完全改变了。我可以整夜入睡，而不会出汗和醒来。

title: Stitching is terrible
body: The blanket itself is comfortable, cooling, and has a nice weight, but for the money, I would have expected the stitching to MUCH better. We’ve had it under a month and the stitching is literally falling apart.
translation: 毯子本身很舒适、凉爽，而且重量也很重，但为了钱，我希望缝线会更好。我们用了不到一个月，缝线确实已经散开了。

title: I love the feel
body: The quality is awesome and the epic sale price was amazing.  Not too thick.
translation: 质量很棒，史诗般的销售价格也很棒。不太厚。
sku: Color: Tie Dye Denim Blue|Size: Queen(90"*90")

title: Super soft and cooling blanket
body: This blanket is soft, lightweight, and incredibly cooling.  Actually feels cool to touch on a hot day.  It has become our daughter’s favorite blanket!
translation: 这条毯子柔软，轻巧且令人难以置信的冷却。实际上，在炎热的天气里接触很酷。它已成为我们女儿最喜欢的毯子！

title: Awesome product
body: This comforter is spectacular!!! Used to I’d wake up at night covered in sweat. This comforter lowers the temp by 5-10 degrees. I should have bought two of them!!! This comforter does EVERYTHING, they advertise it to do!
translation: 这个床罩很壮观！！！我曾经在晚上醒来时被汗水覆盖。该床罩将温度降低5-10度。我应该买两个！！！这个床罩会做所有事情，他们做广告要做！

title: Poor Quality
body: Just received item 12 days ago and stitching has come out with light wear. No pets. While I love the feel of it, this is extremely disappointing considering the cost. I have emailed their customer support and waiting on a response. No telephone number found.
translation: 12 天前刚刚收到商品，缝线已经出现轻微磨损。没有宠物。虽然我喜欢它的感觉，但考虑到成本，这非常令人失望。我已向他们的客户支持发送电子邮件并等待回复。没有找到电话号码。

title: Very disappointed in this
body: Basically this is just a silk blanket that heats up after 10 seconds of being in it. I still wake up drenched in sweat from being hot because the blanket isn’t cooling nor is it breathable. It only gets a 3 stars due to it being soft and cold for 10 seconds. It’s also decent quality. It’s not worth the price if you are looking for an actual cooling blanket. It looks cute and is medium thick wise.
translation: 基本上，这只是一条丝绸毯子，在里面 10 秒后就会升温。我仍然因热而醒来，浑身是汗，因为毯子既不凉爽也不透气。它只得到了 3 颗星，因为它又软又冷，持续了 10 秒。它的质量也不错。如果您正在寻找真正的冷却毯，那么它不值得这个价格。它看起来很可爱，厚度适中。

title: BEST BLANKET EVER!
body: THIS BLANKET IS PERFECT FOR HOT SLEEPERS LIKE ME. IT IS SOOOOO SOFT AND COZY AND COOLING. BUY THIS NOW, YOU WILL NOT BE DISAPPOINTED!! WELL WORTH THE MONEY.
translation: 这套毯子非常适合像我这样的热门卧铺。它是如此柔软，舒适和冷却。现在买这个，您不会失望的！值得这笔钱。

title: Best summer blanket!
body: Product provides cooling on hot nights. Perfect for a hot sleeper! Definitely worth the money in order to get a good night sleep in the summer.
translation: 产品在炎热的夜晚提供冷却。非常适合热门卧铺！绝对值得这笔钱，以便在夏天睡个好觉。

title: Silky smooth and cool
body: Great purchase. We purchased two, one for each of our children who run hot when they sleep. Both say they like coolness of the blankets. I purchased another brand that had the size and color I wanted but it just wasn’t the same.
translation: 很棒的购买。我们为每个孩子睡觉时奔跑的孩子购买了两个，一个。他们都说他们喜欢毯子的凉爽。我购买了另一个具有我想要的尺寸和颜色的品牌，但事实并非如此。

title: BEST BLANKET EVER!!
body: This blanket feels heavy but it’s not! This came in handy when the weather heat index would get up to 115+! It’s always cool! I need a couple more for when the grandkids visit!
translation:
这个毯子感觉很重，但事实并非如此！
当天气热指数达到115+时，这派上了用场！总是很酷！孙子们何时访问，我还需要几个！

title: Super soft and cool
body: This comforter is super soft and comfy cool.  I would Recommend as this item.
translation: 这个床罩超级柔软舒适。我会推荐作为这个项目。

title: Amazing! My stepmom loves it
body: I bought this for my stepmother as a gift! She was complaining about being too hot during the night and never being able to get comfortable. Nothing but good things since she’s been sleeping with it! Light, good quality and keeps you comfortable
translation: 我为我的继母买了这个礼物！她抱怨在夜间太热，永远无法舒适。自从她一直睡觉以来，别无他物！轻巧，质量高，让您舒适

title: Love the feel
body: The only one I will use on top in love so if you get one you will not go back to a different one love the texture my well, I put on the top and I cover up with this one
translation: 我唯一会在爱中使用的唯一一个，所以如果您得到一个，您不会再回到一个爱我的质地，我放在顶部，我掩盖了这个

title: Sooo soft and cold!
body: Better than I was expecting and exactly what I was hoping for. Very worth the purchase
translation: 比我期望的要好，正是我所希望的。非常值得购买

title: Just what I wanted
body: I was a bit skeptical when I received it.  It is a bit thin but it worked out perfect.  It is cool and has enough weight to be cozy.  If you wake up a little warm, just move it around a bit and it cools again.  I love it.
translation: 当我收到它时，我有点怀疑。 它有点薄，但效果很完美。 它很酷，重量足够舒适。 如果你醒来时有点暖和，只需稍微移动一下，它就会再次冷却。 我喜欢。

title: Wonderful!
body: This comforter is the best thing ever! I don't want anything else on my bed. I'm probably going to donate my other comforters. Glad I found this!
translation: 这个被子是有史以来最好的东西！我不想在我的床上放任何其他东西。我可能会捐出我的其他被子。很高兴我找到了这个！

title: Very comfy
body: I am very happy with this blanket. It is very thin but does still carry some weight to it. I am one that likes a blanket on me when sleeping for some weight. A sheet by itself is just too light. Also post menopause and sleep very hot. This has helped alleviate this issue. The blanket is very soft and comfortable. I find myself wanting to snuggle in it all night. One slight turn and the coolness resumes immediately. Also has  better weight than just a sheet. I even had to get up in the middle of the night and turn off my overhead fan. I got a little chilly! Give it a try you won't be disappointed. I added the picture with some shirts so you can et a better idea of the color. It is a very light blue. I am actually going to travel wit it this weekend I like it so much!
translation: 我对这条毯子非常满意。它非常薄，但仍然带有一些重量。我是一个喜欢在睡觉时盖上毯子的人。片材本身太轻了。也绝经后，睡得很热。这有助于缓解这个问题。毯子非常柔软舒适。我发现自己想整晚都依偎在里面。轻轻转动一下，凉爽立即恢复。也比单张纸的重量更好。我什至不得不在半夜起床并关闭我的头顶风扇。我有点冷！试一试，您不会失望的。我添加了一些衬衫的图片，以便您可以更好地了解颜色。它是一种非常浅的蓝色。我实际上打算在这个周末带着它去旅行，我非常喜欢它！

title: Good value...does cool.
body: Great cooling performance, good thickness, easy to wash in machine, comfortable.good color, neutral, durable material. Bought more after getting for family and friens.
translation: 冷却性能好，厚度好，易机洗，舒适，颜色好，中性，耐用的材料。为家人和朋友买了更多。

title: Prefer those who sleep hot
body: This blanket works great to keep us from sweating at night. I still have to have something covering me even though I’m hot. This helps keep me cooler and if it’s to warm I move the cover to a different spot and I’m cooled down right a way. Some times a fan is just not enough. And it’s light weight but yet feels like a comforter. I would recommend this to any woman starting or going through pre-menopause or menopausal. It helps.
translation: 这条毯子非常有用，可以防止我们晚上出汗。即使我很热，我仍然必须覆盖我。这有助于使我保持凉爽，如果要加热，我将盖子移到另一个位置，我会以一种方式冷却。有时候，粉丝还不够。重量轻，但感觉像一个床罩。我建议任何开始或经历绝经前或更年期的女人。它有帮助。

title: Amazing
body: I wish I had bought it sooner
translation: 我希望我早点买了

title: It met all my expectations.
body: I like the easy way to get my cooling blanket to me.  It is good quality and I recommend it to anyone.  It was easy to order and easy to get delivered.
translation: 我喜欢将冷却毯子送给我的简单方法。质量很好，我推荐给任何人。这很容易订购，很容易交付。

title: Stitching coming undone
body: Fabric and weight are nice...I've only had a few weeks at most, and the stitching is coming undone like other customers are reporting.
translation: 面料和重量都很好……我最多只用了几周，而且像其他客户报告的那样，缝合线已经松开了。

title: comfortable
body: A recommended summer product, cool and comfortable.
translation: 推荐的夏季产品，凉爽舒适。

title: It works!!
body: Beautiful... Silky... Lightweight... Soft... COOLING!!! Everything I love rolled into one... I'm never sleeping without this again... I'm in love!!!
translation: 美丽...丝滑...轻巧...柔软...冷却！！！我喜欢的一切都变成了一个...我再也没有睡觉了……我恋爱了！！！

title: No support from seller, low quality
body: Update: Seller reached out and has corrected the issue. Appears it could have been a bad batch, as others have had good reviews. I have updated rating based on them correcting it.  I reached out to seller the day it was delivered regarding being smaller than a normal King size. They never responded. We missed the 30 day return, and was forced to keep it.  Now 2 months later and the threads are coming undone, very low quality. I reached out to seller again, with no response. I then reached out to Amazon, and was told I have to just keep trying to reach out to seller. Buyer beware
translation:
更新：卖家已联系并纠正了该问题。看起来这可能是一批糟糕的批次，因为其他人的评论都很好。我根据他们的纠正更新了评级。

在交货当天，我联系了卖家，询问其尺寸小于正常的特大号床尺寸。他们从未回应。我们错过了 30 天退货，被迫保留。现在两个月过去了，线已经松开了，质量非常低。我再次联系卖家，但没有得到回复。然后我联系了亚马逊，被告知我必须继续尝试联系卖家。买家当心

title: Amazing for us hot-sleepers
body: I'm now using this basically as my bottom sheet and another brand as a top sheet.  MUCH improvement in sleep, less sweating.
translation: 我现在基本上将其用作底部纸，而另一个品牌作为顶纸。睡眠有很大改善，出汗少。

title: Cool
body: I bought the item recommended by a friend and is amazing.  I do not feel very silky and cool
translation: 我买了一个朋友推荐的物品，真是太神奇了。我感觉不太柔滑和凉爽

title: Vey soft and light but doesn’t keep coolness for more than a few seconds
body: This is a great light weight blanket. Very soft and light however I purchased because other reviews mentioned that the blanket is cold and very cooling … the cool feeling doesn’t last very long. I personally wouldn’t recommend this for a cooling blanket but would for a light soft feeling blanket.
translation: 这是一条很棒的轻质毯子。非常柔软和轻便，但我购买了，因为其他评论提到毯子很冷而且非常凉爽……凉爽的感觉不会持续很长时间。我个人不推荐将此用于冷却毯，但会推荐用于轻柔感觉的毯子。

title: Very helpful
body: I bought it for my daughter who is having hot flashes and it really does help her.  It's very lightweight.
translation: 我为我的女儿买了它，她的女儿确实对她有帮助。这很轻巧。

title: So cold!
body: This blanket actually stays cool. I love it so much.. it’s not super thin, a little stretchy kinda like spandex and has weight to it in a way that is so comfortable. Perfect size, it washes great too- very versatile, since it folds and compacts easy, love this blanket more than anything. It doesn’t stay as cool if you lay in the same spot all night- but it doesn’t get warm or hot. And if you move at night you will always.. have a cold blanket. Feels like it’s fresh from the freezer- colder than the other side of the pillow. It was even cold when I opened the package when it was in the sun. It’s also so silky I never want to leave my bed anymore, it can slip around the bed a little though.. and all my cats LOVE IT. (Cat hair comes off sure easy.) Best sleep quality in months- California summer is no joke.
translation: 这个毯子实际上保持凉爽。我非常喜欢它..它不是超级薄，有点像氨纶，有点像氨纶，并且以一种非常舒适的方式对它具有重量。完美的尺寸，它的清洗效果很好 - 非常多功能，因为它可以轻松折叠和紧凑，喜欢这个毯子，比任何东西都更喜欢毯子。如果您整夜躺在同一地点，但不会变得温暖或热，它不会保持凉爽。如果您晚上移动，您将永远..有一个冷毯。感觉就像是从冰箱里新鲜的 - 比枕头的另一侧更冷。当我在阳光下打开包裹时，这甚至很冷。它也是如此的丝滑，我再也不想离开床了，虽然可以在床上滑动一点。而且我所有的猫都喜欢它。 （猫的头发肯定很容易。）几个月来最好的睡眠质量 - 加利福尼亚夏天不是开玩笑。

title: Nice and silkey
body: Love love slept like a baby it kept me cool while sleeping woke up twice  throughout the night
translation: 爱情像婴儿一样睡着了，睡觉时让我很酷，整夜醒了两次

title: Better than Rest
body: I purchased the same product but through the brand Rest. It seems exactly the same, but a fraction of the cost. To me, this is a better value compared to Rest. I ended up returning my other purchase because how can you beat a $50 cooling comforter Compared to the other they is over $200. It is so light, but it keeps me warm and comfortable at night. This comforter looks More high-end then Rest And feels exactly the same to me! I love this product so much, I will be buying more In other colors!
translation: 我通过 Rest 品牌购买了相同的产品。看起来完全一样，但成本却只有一小部分。对我来说，与休息相比，这是一个更好的价值。我最终退回了我购买的另一件商品，因为你怎么能打败 50 美元的凉爽被子呢？与另一件相比，它们的价格超过 200 美元。它很轻，但它让我在晚上保持温暖和舒适。这款被子看起来比休息更高端，而且对我来说感觉完全一样！我非常喜欢这个产品，我会购买更多其他颜色的！

title: Love it
body: I bought a king size. So worth the money. Its so light and cool when you need it and where you need it. Will buy again.
translation: 我买了一个特大号的。所以值得花这个钱。无论何时何地，它都如此轻盈、凉爽。会再次购买。

title: Does the OPPOSITE of cool!
body: I’ve been looking at cooling blankets for years. Finally decided to purchase this one based on good reviews. Upon putting it on my bed, I noticed how soft it was! Like silky soft. First night sleeping with it, I didn’t notice much of a difference. I sleep EXTREMELY hot. Like I mean EXTREMELY. Well, night after night I noticed nothing had changed. In fact, I was waking up drenched in sweat. This thing traps body heat almost as well as a down comforter. To put it plainly- it’s cool TO THE TOUCH. But it does not KEEP you cool. It warms up within literal seconds. The only redeeming quality about this blanket is how soft it is. Unfortunately the cooling properties of this blanket are just a gimmick. And my hunt for cooling down at night continues.
translation:
多年来我一直在研究降温毯。最后看了好评才决定买这个。当我把它放在床上时，我发现它有多软！如丝般柔软。第一个晚上和它一起睡觉，我没有注意到太大的差异。我睡得很热。就像我的意思是“极端”。好吧，一夜又一夜，我发现一切都没有改变。事实上，我醒来时已经满身大汗了。这个东西几乎可以像羽绒被一样锁住身体的热量。
说白了——触感很酷。但这并不能让你保持冷静。它在几秒钟之内就会变暖。这条毯子的唯一可取之处就是它有多柔软。不幸的是，这条毯子的冷却性能只是一个噱头。我对夜间降温的追求仍在继续。

title: Goodbye night sweats!
body: Love it!
translation: 爱它！

title: Product arrived stained
body: It feels cool to the touch but once I decided to spread it out I found several stains on the blanket. Reached out to the manufacturer but have yet to hear back from them.
translation: 摸起来很凉，但当我决定把它铺开时，我发现毯子上有几处污渍。已联系制造商，但尚未收到回复。

title: Love this blanket
body: The first night I used it, I slept better than I have in a long time.  I have night sweats and this blanket definitely helped!

title: Like sleeping in a cloud….
body: I was scheduled to have back surgery, so I wanted to treat myself to some new bedding, since I’d be spending a lot of time in bed for my recovery. I had a nice fluffy, white comforter, but my main complaint was that I felt too warm underneath it. I was a bit skeptical when I read about the cooling effect of this Cozy Bliss comforter, but decided to give it a try. OMG! As soon as I got under it, I immediately felt how cool, soft and silky and lightweight this comforter was! It feels so luxurious — it exceeded my expectations! My husband and I have nicknamed it “the cloud” because honestly it makes you feel like you are in heaven….highly recommend!
translation: 我计划进行背部手术，所以我想给自己买一些新床上用品，因为我会花很多时间躺在床上进行康复。我有一条漂亮的蓬松的白色被子，但我主要的抱怨是我觉得它下面太热了。当我读到这款 Cosy Bliss 被子的冷却效果时，我有点怀疑，但决定尝试一下。我的天啊！一钻到它下面，我立刻感觉到这被子是多么凉爽、柔软、丝滑、轻盈！感觉太豪华了——超出了我的预期！我和我丈夫给它起了个绰号“云”，因为说实话，它让你感觉就像在天堂......强烈推荐！

title: Relief finally
body: I get very warm when I sleep and over heat often.  Having this on me at night is great.  It does get very warm from my body heat so I do have to switch to another part of the blanket to cool down. But it is very cooling which I love and need.  I tried several of the other cooling blankets, nothing.  Worth the purchase!!!
translation: 我睡觉时会感到很热，而且经常过热。晚上戴在身上真是太棒了。我的体温确实会变得非常热，所以我必须换到毯子的另一部分来降温。但它非常凉爽，这是我喜欢和需要的。我尝试了其他几条降温毯，但没有效果。值得购买！！！

title: Cozy and comfortable
body: Good quality the queen size fit good I think it is priced a little high but, decided to keep it anyway. I like the feel of it.

title: Cooling and soft.
body: I bought this because my husband always feels hot, and I have night sweats. It's very nice and truly cooling. Easy to wash and dry, and it gets cool again a few minutes after you take it out of the dryer. We like it so much that we just bought a second one.
translation: 我买这个是因为我老公总是感觉热，我也盗汗。它非常好而且非常凉爽。易于清洗和干燥，从烘干机中取出几分钟后，它会再次变凉。我们非常喜欢它，所以我们刚刚买了第二个。

title: Best blanket ever
body: My husband bought this for me and at first I wasn't sure about it. When I unfolded it for the first time it had a weird chemical smell. However, after a couple days I tried it again and I absolutely love this blanket. I tend to over heat at night - this blanket keeps me warm from my cold room while also keeping me nice and cool. Quite ironic, I know, but living in the Las Vegas heat I like to keep cool. I like to have my own blanket at night and this queen sized blanket is perfect. We've had it for less than a week and it is soft and durable.
translation:
我丈夫给我买了这个，起初我不确定。当我第一次展开它时，它有一种奇怪的化学气味。然而，几天后我又试了一次，我非常喜欢这条毯子。我晚上往往会过热 - 这条毯子让我在寒冷的房间里保持温暖，同时也能让我保持凉爽。我知道这很讽刺，但生活在拉斯维加斯的炎热中，我喜欢保持凉爽。
我喜欢在晚上拥有自己的毯子，这款大号毯子非常完美。我们用了不到一周，它又软又耐用。

title: Just wow!
body: I am in the stage a of a hot sleeper, I was not sleeping well at night because I would spend the night covering and uncovering myself with my thin blanket. Someone asked me to try a cooling blanket and I am glad I did! It’s so soft, cool to the touch, I don’t use a  sheet to cover me anymore, just this blanket, I absolutely love it, I sleep through the whole night now. Been using it for a week. It’s a good price in compare to some others, I washed it once o got it. The only thing is ( it’s not white ) it has a yellowish tint to it. Gladly I don’t use as decorative bedding, I just use it to sleep. Best purchase! I will buy again to have a spare one.
translation:
我处于热睡者的阶段，晚上睡得不好，因为我整晚都用薄毯子盖住和暴露自己。
有人让我尝试一下降温毯，我很高兴我做到了！
它非常柔软，触感凉爽，我不再用床单盖住我，只有这条毯子，我非常喜欢它，我现在整晚都睡着了。
已经用了一个星期了。
与其他一些相比，这是一个不错的价格，我买了一次就洗了。
唯一的问题是（它不是白色的）它有淡黄色的色调。
很高兴我不用作装饰性床上用品，我只是用它来睡觉。
最优惠的购买！我会再次购买以备有空的。

title: Super comfy, perfect summer comforter
body: Love this blanket. 4.5 stars. Now its not as cooling as I had hoped (reason for not 5 stars) but it was my first experience w/ this kind of product. Every time I lay on it is cool to the touch & relaxing as well as super comfy material, but it absorbs body heat w/in a minute or too. However if you do wake up in the night feeling warm you can just move the blanket over a bit & feel the coolness & I fall back asleep. Sometimes after coming inside on the hot summer day I'll just go & lay on it for a minute cause it just feels like magic that a blanket can be cool like that. :)  It's also a good alternative to a normal comforter as it is a lighter material blanket. Yet the weight of is comparable to a normal comforter weight, almost like its a very light weighted blanket.  I got the queen size & it cover the whole top of my California king mattress as well as hangs over the sides abt .5 in and cover the pillows too.  So far the material is not getting caught on dry skin, which I was concerned abt, but it's not winter dry skin yet so time will tell more. I do not let the dog on it as I don't want to risk the material being scratched.  It washes & drys well in the laundry machines, I make sure to follow the directions on the label. Washability was a main decision in choosing this product.  I bought it on sale and as someone who normally buys bedding @ discount stores, it was still expensive to me. Yet, to be able to have a good night's sleep in the summer, it was very worth the investment. Good sleep is essential to overall good health & this blanket helps to provide that.  As someone who loves a comfy blanket, this is my favorite, but alas it's held in such high reguard it has to stay on my bed & not be used on the couch by the whole family. It would be fun if they could add patterns in the future. :)
translation:
喜欢这条毯子。 4.5 星。现在它并不像我希望的那么凉爽（不是 5 星的原因），但这是我第一次体验这种产品。每次我躺在上面时，它的触感都很凉爽，令人放松，而且材质超级舒适，但它会在一分钟内吸收身体热量。然而，如果你晚上醒来感觉温暖，你可以把毯子移开一点，感受凉爽，我就会重新睡着。有时在炎热的夏日进屋后，我会在上面躺一会儿，因为毯子可以像这样凉爽，感觉就像魔法一样。 :)

它也是普通被子的一个很好的替代品，因为它是一种较轻的材料毯子。然而，它的重量与普通被子的重量相当，几乎就像它是一条非常轻的毯子。

我买的是大号双人床，它覆盖了我的加州特大号床垫的整个顶部，并悬挂在两侧约 0.5 英寸处，还覆盖了枕头。

到目前为止，这种材料还没有粘在干燥的皮肤上，这是我担心的，但它还不是冬季干燥的皮肤，所以时间会告诉我们更多。
我不会让狗踩在上面，因为我不想冒材料被刮伤的风险。

它可以在洗衣机中很好地清洗和烘干，我一定要遵循标签上的说明。耐洗性是选择该产品的一个主要决定。

我是在打折时买的，作为一个通常在折扣店购买床上用品的人，它对我来说仍然很贵。不过，能够在夏天睡个好觉，还是很值得的。良好的睡眠对于整体健康至关重要，这款毯子有助于实现这一点。

作为一个喜欢舒适毯子的人，这是我的最爱，但可惜的是，它受到如此高的重视，它必须留在我的床上，而不是全家人在沙发上使用。如果他们将来可以添加模式，那就很有趣了。 :)

title: So soft!
body: I NEVER write reviews, but I love this blanket so much and I searched and searched for a while. I really wanted a cooling blanket for my bf and I because we both run pretty hot and the summers in southern CA (and AZ summers where I’m from) are brutal. I looked at probably hundreds of different cooling blankets in all different price range and I just couldn’t pick one because all of them had kind of mixed reviews! Mostly good reviews but then would have one or two people saying they didn’t understand why people keep saying it keeps them cool lol finally I decided this one was a really good price, the reviews were pretty good and if I had to I could return it. You guys…. This blanket is so nice, soft and light  it literally almost feels like/reminds me of cashmere but without the itchy/scratchy feel. Side note, right before I bought this I bought some Tencel Lyocell sheets from Target that are also the softest sheets I’ve ever owned (I’m a sheet snob) and they were cooling also, the fabric always stays cool. When I opened the box to this blanket… you could literally feel the how cold the blanket was to the touch and I compared it to my new Lyocell sheets and this blanket blew those out of The water in terms of how cold to the touch it was. Best purchase I’ve ever made, even my bf agrees after he got mad at me first for buying it lol but after he felt it and laid down on it he said it’s the best purchase I’ve ever made. I use this and my Tencel Lyocell sheets together, and I’m mad that I never knew about these two things before a few months ago! My bed is so soft and so cool, I’m in love and I had to write a review so everyone knew, just buy this! I PROMISE you will NOT regret it!
translation:
我从不写评论，但我非常喜欢这条毯子，我搜索了又搜索了一段时间。我真的想要为我和我的男朋友准备一条凉爽的毯子，因为我们都非常热，而且加利福尼亚州南部的夏天（以及我来自的亚利桑那州的夏天）非常残酷。我看了可能有数百种不同价格范围的不同冷却毯，但我就是无法选择一种，因为它们的评论都褒贬不一！大部分评论都很好，但随后会有一两个人说他们不明白为什么人们一直说它让他们保持冷静哈哈最后我认为这是一个非常好的价格，评论相当不错，如果我必须的话我可以回来它。你们……这条毯子非常漂亮、柔软、轻盈，几乎感觉就像/让我想起羊绒，但没有发痒/刮擦的感觉。旁注，就在我买这个之前，我从 Target 买了一些 Tencel Lyocell 床单，这也是我拥有过的最柔软的床单（我是一个床单势利小人），它们也很凉爽，织物总是保持凉爽。当我打开这条毯子的盒子时……你真的可以感觉到毯子摸起来有多冷，我将它与我的新莱赛尔床单进行了比较，这条毯子把它们吹走了
水的触感有多冷。我买过的最好的东西，连我男朋友都同意了，因为他一开始因为我买了它而对我生气，哈哈，但当他感觉到它并放下它后，他说这是我买过的最好的东西。我将它和我的 Tencel Lyocell 床单一起使用，我很生气几个月前我从来不知道这两件事！我的床是如此柔软和凉爽，我爱上了，我必须写一篇评论，以便每个人都知道，就买这个吧！我保证你不会后悔！

title: No more night sweats!!

I am so impressed. My Grandson is begging for one now. The stitching appears good quality.  Light weight , soft and cool on my skin. Comes in several colors

哇。豪华！凉爽的！！

title: Light and cooling
body: This product is definitely light, cooling, and soft. I wish it were a bit fluffier, but it still provides a comfortable feel. It does get a bit warmer over time, but I just move around to find a cool spot, similar to what we do with our pillows.
translation: 该产品绝对轻便、凉爽、柔软。我希望它更蓬松一点，但它仍然提供舒适的感觉。随着时间的推移，天气确实会变暖一些，但我只是四处走动，寻找一个凉爽的地方，就像我们对枕头所做的那样。

title: Great summer blanket
body: Cool and light. Great summer cover for a person that prefers covers even in warm weather.

title: AMAZING
body: This is the most amazing comforter ever! Very luxurious and it does what it says! It keeps you cool and fresh all night. The soft silk like fabric is always cool to the touch. It is lightweight but is substantial enough to keep you comfortable. If you sleep hot this is for you!
translation: 这是有史以来最神奇的被子！非常豪华，正如它所说的那样！它让您整夜保持凉爽和清新。柔软的丝绸般的面料摸起来总是凉爽的。它重量轻，但足够坚固，让您感到舒适。如果你睡得很热，这就是为你准备的！

title: This is the softest and coolest blanket I've ever owned
body: I got the twin/full one and it just goes over each side and probably 6 inches down the bottom once it isn't where my head goes.  The two exceptions to keeping me comfortly cool are 1. if I get into bed warm it feels too warm and I put most of it off me until my A/C cools me off then put it back over me, and 2. if I cover myself totaly from toes to my neck, my own body heat will make me take some or all of it off until I'm cooler. I don't cover myself like I would during cold months. Another difference is that it did't say to use  a top sheet between my body and the blanket, so I only use a bottm one.  I have washed it once and nothing bad happened. Cold water, delicate cycle. I may put it on low in the dryer, because I can't air dry it, then take it out before it's fully dry and let it finish drying on my bed. Thrilled, but will only use in summer, which is what I bought it for.
translation: 我买了双/全的，一旦它不是我的头所在的地方，它就会越过每一侧，并且可能会从底部向下 6 英寸。让我保持舒适凉爽的两个例外是 1. 如果我温暖地躺在床上，感觉太热了，我会把大部分衣服脱下来，直到我的空调冷却下来，然后再把它放回我身上，以及 2. 如果我盖上被子我自己从脚趾到脖子都完全脱掉，我自己的体温会让我脱掉部分或全部，直到我感觉凉爽为止。我不会像在寒冷的月份那样遮盖自己。另一个区别是，它没有说在我的身体和毯子之间使用顶层床单，所以我只使用底层床单。我洗过一次，没有什么不好的事情发生。冷水，细腻循环。我可能会把它放在烘干机的低处，因为我无法风干它，然后在它完全干燥之前将其取出，让它在我的床上完成干燥。兴奋，但只在夏天使用，这就是我买它的目的。

title: No more night sweats!! ❤️❤️
body: Menopause sucks. I've bought countless products to try to ease the horrible hot flashes and night sweats. As a breast cancer survivor, I'm very limited on taking any kind of medications and/or supplements to ease the hot flashes. But THIS BLANKET...OMG, it's a game-changer! You do have to get used to sleeping without a flat sheet on your bed (so the cool blanket makes contact with your skin), but if you're already using cooling sheets like I was, it should be a pretty easy adjustment. I'm finally sleeping through the night without waking up drenched in sweat and I'm getting much higher-quality sleep.  My teenage son who sleeps hot loved mine so much that I had to buy him one, too. I think he'd probably fight anyone who tried to take his new Cosy Bliss cooling blanket. We both rate these blankets 10 out of 10.  Bottom line: This is the very best item I've bought to help ease my menopause symptoms. If you suffer from the same, buy this blanket now!
translation:
更年期很糟糕。我买了无数的产品来试图缓解可怕的潮热和盗汗。作为一名乳腺癌幸存者，我在服用任何药物和/或补充剂来缓解潮热方面都非常有限。但是这条毯子......天啊，它改变了游戏规则！你确实必须习惯在床上没有床单的情况下睡觉（这样凉爽的毯子会接触你的皮肤），但如果你已经像我一样使用凉爽的床单，这应该是一个非常容易的调整。我终于可以睡整夜了，醒来时不会被汗水湿透，而且睡眠质量也更高。

我十几岁的儿子睡得很香，他非常喜欢我的儿子，所以我也不得不给他买一个。我想他可能会与任何试图抢走他的新 Cozy Bliss 降温毯的人打架。我们对这些毯子的评价都是 10 分（满分 10 分）。

所以我已经使用这个被子几个月了，我不得不说它不是很好。虽然它确实提供了一些冷却效果，但制作得并不好。里面的材料在各个部分都聚集在一起，视觉上真的一点也不令人愉悦。
如果我能把它寄回来，我会的。不推荐购买此产品

title: Perfect comforter for summer climates!
body: If you are a hot sleeper, but still like a comforter, this is definitely for you. My wife and I love it and will use it all summer long! It is always cool to the touch, so much so that I had to add a light blanket between the sheet and comforter—yet it’s still much cooler than our regular comforter.
translation: 如果你是一个热睡者，但仍然像一个被子，这绝对是为你准备的。我和我的妻子喜欢它，并且会在整个夏天使用它！它摸起来总是很凉爽，以至于我不得不在床单和被子之间加一条轻毯子——但它仍然比我们的普通被子凉爽得多。

title: Actually works!
body: I haven’t had the blanket for too long. However, it’s made a difference in the short amount of time. It’s definitely cooling. I used to wave up sweaty but this blanket really is cool to the touch. Lightweight but also weighted at the same time. It’s a weird combination. But for me, it’s been very helpful in cooling me at night.
translation: 我已经太久没有毯子了。然而，它在短时间内就产生了影响。这绝对是凉爽的。我以前经常汗流浃背，但这条毯子摸起来真的很凉爽。重量轻，但同时也重量重。这是一个奇怪的组合。但对我来说，它对让我在晚上降温非常有帮助。

title: Buttery Soft and Cool
body: Thank you lighting deal! I was looking for a cooling blanket and sheets for my parents. I saw the deal and put one in my cart for them and another one for me. I got both for less than the original price of one. They are so soft and cool. I don't know what kind of magic is in the material, but you want this in your life!
translation: 谢谢照明交易！我一直在为我的父母寻找凉爽的毯子和床单。我看到了这笔交易，把一个放在我的购物车里给他们，另一个给我。我以低于一个的原价的价格得到了两个。它们是如此柔软和凉爽。我不知道材料里有什么样的魔力，但你想要这个出现在你的生活中！

title: Highly recommend
body: Fit great! Quality is perfect! lil bit smells like a new material…
translation: 合身，很棒！质量完美！Lil Bit闻起来像一种新材料......

title: Super soft and cool
body: My wife loves it!
translation: 我的妻子喜欢它！

title: It’s cool…for a blanket
body: I’ve only used one night so far and it’s definitely soft and cool to the touch. I would say it helped me fall asleep faster, not having to move positions as often to cool off. As far as cooling me off during the night, if you use it on top your body it still holds in some heat. I found myself throwing it off me within a couple hours after falling asleep because I was hot. :(
translation: 到目前为止我只用了一晚，摸起来绝对柔软凉爽。我想说它帮助我更快入睡，而不必经常改变姿势来冷静下来。至于晚上给我降温，如果你把它用在身上，它仍然会保持一些热量。我发现自己在睡着后几个小时内就把它扔掉了，因为我很热。 :(

title: Love it
body: My son is always hot and love to use this blanket. Keeps him cool and is very soft
translation: 我儿子总是很热，喜欢用这条毯子。让他保持凉爽，非常柔软

title: 2 important things to consider
body: Overall this is a comfortable comforter that definitely is cool to the touch. There are 2 things you should definitely consider when buying though  1. If you are an extremely warm sleeper, this blanket will still get hot. Yes when you first get into bed it will feel nice and cold, but after a while if you are hot it will be hot  2. The biggest problem I have is that this comforter retains a lot of moisture. If it is humid at all or I have the ac going the blanket feels damp. I end up having to throw it in the dryer every night before bed in the summer  Other than that, the quality is good.
translation:
总的来说，这是一款舒适的被子，触感绝对凉爽。购买时有两件事你绝对应该考虑

1. 如果您的睡眠温度非常高，这条毯子仍然会​​很热。是的，当你第一次上床睡觉时，会感觉很舒服，很冷，但过了一会儿，如果你很热，就会很热

2.我遇到的最大问题是这款被子保留了大量水分。如果天气很潮湿或者我开着空调，毯子就会感觉潮湿。夏天我每天晚上睡觉前都得把它扔进烘干机

除此之外，质量很好。

title: Misleading, color doesn’t show
body: I got the green cooling blanket. It works but the sheet looks completely white. The green is so faint and is only seen in the sun. Disappointed by the lack of color, but since it works as supposed to by keeping me cool in the summertime, I’ll tie-dye it.
translation: 我买了绿色的降温毯。它有效，但纸张看起来完全是白色的。绿色很淡，只有在阳光下才能看到。对缺乏颜色感到失望，但由于它可以让我在夏天保持凉爽，所以我会把它扎染。

title: Cooling blanket
body: Love this blanket!
translation: 喜欢这条毯子！

translation: 这是一个非常简洁的产品。不过超级滑。令人惊奇的是它如何提供凉爽的感觉。而且可以机洗。唯一的缺点是我第一次就无法弄清楚如何将它正确地放在我的特大号床上。但是，这是必须具备的。

title: Soft and amazing to the touch is a good start
body: This is the softest smoothest most comfortable blanket I've ever had!  It is cooling for the first 15 minutes...then your body heat takes over mostly.  HOWever when I wake up in the late hours feeling warm...I peel back the sheet underneath it and cheat!  it's always cool to the touch...and always comforting.  When this one wears out we will buy another.

title: Love the cooling fabric!
body: The fabric is amazing, cool, soft and not heavy, although warm enough to sleep well in a cool room. This was a fabulous purchase for a week of 100 degree weather and high humidity. However, on a chilly night, it was the perfect layer btween a sheet and a heavier quilt. It washed well with ca old water cycle and low, cool dryer. I purchased 2 of these.
translation: 面料很棒，凉爽，柔软，不重，但足够温暖，可以在凉爽的房间里睡个好觉。对于一周 100 度的天气和高湿度来说，这是一个很棒的购买。然而，在寒冷的夜晚，它是床单和较重的被子之间的完美层。用旧的水循环和低温、凉爽的烘干机可以很好地清洗它。我购买了其中 2 个。

title: Quality

title: cool

title: Does what it says

title: Awesome

title: Amazing!
body: Bought this cooling blanket in the hopes that it would keep me cool and help with my hot flashes at night.  By far has it met my expectations!  My dog has been living on it during the day while I’m at work in this 90 degree weather we have been having.  So I would say human and puppy approved!!!!!

title: Encantador

translation: 非常柔软和新鲜我推荐它

title: Very cool (literally!)
body: This blanket is light and cool, exactly what us people who run hot need. It’s washable which we love since our dog loves it too.  Note for those with sensory issues like me: if you have dry or cracked feet, this fabric does run against it in a way that I can’t stand unless I’m wearing socks. Same with dry skin on hands. Otherwise it is nice and soft!

这条毯子既轻又凉爽，正是我们这些热气腾腾的人所需要的。它是可清洗的，我们喜欢它，因为我们的狗也喜欢它。

对于那些像我一样有感官问题的人请注意：如果您的脚干燥或干裂，这种织物确实会以一种我无法忍受的方式摩擦，除非我穿袜子。与手部干燥皮肤相同。否则它又漂亮又柔软！

title: Threading already broken

translation: 已经一个月了，洗一次后，线就撕裂了。材料很好，但质量有点问题。

title: Skeptical at first
body: I received this as a gift after my kids got sick and tired of hearing me debate the attributes of different cooling comforters and just ordered this one for me.  I have been skeptical of the cooling ability of these comforters having read reviews that said they don't cool for very long and in some cases can be quite hot.  Now after a few nights sleeping under this comforter I have my answer, for me, because as I have learned this is really more about your personal views of comfort, hot/cold and usefulness.  So what I found truly pertains to me but maybe can shed some light on the discussion of cooling or no cooling.  For me the verdict is yes but a qualified yes.  When first getting under the comforter (no top sheet) you do feel a  chill.  It is cool to the touch as you stretch your legs out but soon warms up to a comfortable temperature.  During the night if I touch the underside of the comforter it is indeed warm, in fact warmer than my body.  Could it really be absorbing the heat coming off my skin?  Seems like it.  What I can say is that I have slept through the night, every night in comfort since using the Cozy Bliss.  While I used to wake up feeling a bit "clammy", I now wake up pleasantly warm but not sweating.  So my conclusion, yes there is some cooling going on, yes there is some wicking of emitted humidity going on and yes despite it being a densely woven fabric, there appears to some "breathability" going on.  In addition to all this, it is amazingly soft and though thin, it is not like a sheet.  It definitely has some fill which fluffed up nicely once we washed and dried it per instructions..  It is a very "cuddly" comforter.  I wake up all wound up in the comforter.  So after all the research and debate and reading innumerable reviews, my kids landed on a great product and we highly recommend you give this one a try.  With the deals that come and go on this product, you can get a quality comforter at a very reasonable price.
translation: 在我的孩子们厌倦了听我争论不同的凉爽被子的属性之后，我收到了这个作为礼物，并为我订购了这个。我一直对这些被子的冷却能力持怀疑态度，因为我读过一些评论，说它们不能冷却很长时间，而且在某些情况下可能会很热。现在，在这条被子下睡了几个晚上之后，我有了自己的答案，因为据我所知，这实际上更多的是关于您对舒适度、热/冷和实用性的个人看法。因此，我发现的内容确实适合我，但也许可以为有关冷却或不冷却的讨论提供一些启发。对我来说，结论是肯定的，但是是有条件的。当第一次钻到被子下面（没有顶床单）时，您确实会感到寒冷。当您伸展双腿时​​，摸起来很凉，但很快就会升温到舒适的温度。晚上，如果我触摸被子的底面，它确实很温暖，实际上比我的身体还温暖。它真的能吸收我皮肤发出的热量吗？好像是这样。我能说的是，自从使用 Cosy Bliss 以来，我每晚都睡得很舒服。虽然我过去醒来时感觉有点“湿冷”，但现在我醒来时感觉温暖但不出汗。所以我的结论是，是的，正在进行一些冷却，是的，正在进行一些散发的湿气的排汗，是的，尽管它是一种致密的编织织物，但似乎存在一些“透气性”。除此之外，它非常柔软，虽然很薄，但不像床单。它肯定有一些填充物，一旦我们按照说明清洗和干燥它，它就会很好地蓬松起来。这是一个非常“可爱”的被子。我醒来时全身都在被子里。因此，经过所有的研究、辩论和阅读无数的评论后，我的孩子们找到了一款很棒的产品，我们强烈建议您尝试一下。通过该产品的不断优惠，您可以以非常合理的价格获得优质的被子。

title: A plus for menopause ladies
body: This blanket stays so nice and cool! It’s so soft and cozy. I am very pleased with it.
translation: 这条毯子保持凉爽！它是如此的柔软和舒适。我对此非常满意。

title: Most amazing blanket I have ever bought!!!!!
body: If you are a hot sleeper, you need to buy this blanket ASAP!  I love it!
translation: 如果您是热睡者，您需要尽快购买这条毯子！我喜欢它！

title: True to its description!
body: As advertised. Comfortable and cooling.
translation: 正如广告所宣传的那样。舒适又凉爽。

title: Finally a cold night's sleep!
body: I bought a twin size mint green and queen size blue/gray blanket. I am a night sweater when I sleep and just naturally get hot easily. I have been looking for cooling blanket for about 5 years now and this is the only one I've found that is cool to the touch and stays cool the entire time. It is extremely soft and light weight. I can finally sleep comfortably throughout the night. I've been using this ever since I got it and have yet to wake up in the morning sweaty. I have not had any issues with wrinkles.  There was no smell when taking it out of the package and the quality seems high. So I had no qualms with buying a second one, especially when there were great deals!  The only downside I have is that the color is not as bright as in the pictures, it's quite muted to the point where I could barely tell which side was mint green versus white. The blue/gray combo is slightly better. I just wish the colors were as prominent in person as the pictures described.
translation:
我买了一张双人薄荷绿毯子和一张大号蓝色/灰色毯子。我睡觉时穿的是睡衣，很容易自然发热。我寻找降温毯已经有大约 5 年了，这是我发现的唯一一种摸起来凉爽并且始终保持凉爽的毯子。它非常柔软且重量轻。我终于可以舒舒服服地睡一整晚了。自从收到它以来，我一直在使用它，早上醒来还没有出汗。我没有遇到任何皱纹问题。

从包装中拿出来没有任何气味，质量看起来很高。所以我毫不犹豫地购买了第二个，尤其是当有超值优惠的时候！

唯一的缺点是颜色不像图片中那么明亮，它非常柔和，以至于我几乎无法分辨哪一面是薄荷绿还是白色。蓝色/灰色组合稍微好一些。我只是希望颜色与图片描述的一样突出。

title: Great for the awful Night sweats
body: I bought this for my poor boyfriend who has to deal with my hot flashes, but really I take it over.  Stays cool and is so refreshing!  Highly recommend!
translation: 我为我可怜的男朋友买了这个，他必须应对我的潮热问题，但实际上我接管了它。保持凉爽，令人耳目一新！强烈推荐！

title: Very cool and comfortable

title: So nice

title: Feels great

title: Impressive cold sheets

title: Silky Soft
body: This comforter is exactly what I have been looking for.  It is lightweight and is perfect for summer sleeping, keeps me cool all night  The cooling technology is brilliant.  Soft, cushiony pillows of cooling comfort.  I definitely recommend this comforter for hot sleepers!
translation: 这款被子正是我一直在寻找的。 它重量轻，非常适合夏季睡眠，让我整夜保持凉爽。冷却技术非常出色。 柔软舒适的枕头，凉爽舒适。 我绝对向热睡者推荐这款被子！

title: Cool and cozy
body: I love it. It keeps me cool at night when I go to sleep it’s very soft and silky. This is definitely what I was looking for. Thank you quality is excellent and so is the fit for my bed.
translation: 我喜欢它。 当我晚上入睡时，它让我保持凉爽，它非常柔软、丝滑。 这绝对是我一直在寻找的东西。 谢谢，质量非常好，非常适合我的床。

title: WISH I WOULD'VE BOUGHT SOONER!!
body: I absolutely love this cooling comforter! I had been eyeing them for a while because I'm a hot sleeper, but man.....once I received this one I was mad I hadn't bought one sooner! I was lucky to catch this one on sale with an additional coupon so I got a really good price. But it's so worth it I would buy it again at full price. The soft and smooth feel of the fabric is amazing on your skin especially if you sleep au naturalle lol hot sleepers you can relate! And the cooling technology in the comforter actually make it feel cold to the touch its so cool. It will over time as you're sleeping start to absorb your heat, but I just toss around and find another cool part of the blanket. The only drawback to this comforter is the stitching. It is VERY fine and comes undone so easily. If you are wrapped in the blanket and twist around, the stitching will come undone. I still give it five stars 🌟 but if they improved the stitching it would be perfect.
translation: 我非常喜欢这款凉爽的被子！ 我已经关注它们有一段时间了，因为我是一个热睡者，但是天哪......一旦我收到这个，我很生气我没有早点买一个！ 我很幸运地发现这款产品正在打折，并附有一张额外的优惠券，所以我得到了一个非常优惠的价格。 但它非常值得，我会以全价再次购买。 织物的柔软光滑的感觉对您的皮肤来说是令人惊叹的，特别是如果您睡得很自然，哈哈，热睡者您可以体会到！ 而且被子中的冷却技术实际上使其摸起来感觉很冷，非常凉爽。 随着时间的推移，当你睡觉时，它会开始吸收你的热量，但我只是翻来覆去，找到了毯子的另一个凉爽的部分。 这款被子的唯一缺点是缝线。 它非常好，而且很容易拆开。 如果你裹在毯子里并扭转，缝合线就会松开。 我仍然给它五颗星🌟但如果他们改进缝合那就更完美了。

title: Looking for this my whole life
body: For years I've been looking for a blanket that's cold to the touch but keeps you warm this is it it's so silky cool great. The quality of the stitching is very good too.
translation: 多年来，我一直在寻找一条摸起来冰凉但能让你保持温暖的毯子，就是它，它是如此丝滑，凉爽极了。 缝合质量也非常好。

title: Very comfortable and cool, but threads unraveling after a month and two washes.
body: It’s soooo comfortable for both me (a hot sleeper) and my husband (not a hot sleeper). The only thing I don’t like is how easily the threads unravel along the quilted seams.  Added 7/24/2024: I contacted the company a week ago to show them the unraveling quilting seams and the lumpy batting. Still haven’t heard back.  Added 8/9/2024: The company reached out over email and offered a 50 percent partial refund or an exchange. I’m very satisfied with their customer service.
translation:
这对我（热睡者）和我丈夫（不是热睡者）来说都非常舒服。我唯一不喜欢的是线很容易沿着绗缝接缝散开。

2024 年 7 月 24 日添加：我一周前联系了该公司，向他们展示了散开的绗缝接缝和块状的棉絮。仍然没有收到回音。

2024 年 8 月 9 日添加：该公司通过电子邮件联系并提供 50% 的部分退款或换货。我对他们的客户服务非常满意。

title: Keeps you cool!!
body: I am an extremely HOT sleeper, I sleep with an ac unit and a fan, I keep the fan on even during new england winters. Last night was my first night sleeping with this blanket and it's the first spring/summer night that I did not wake up drenched in sweat!! This my new favorite thing I own PERIOD.
translation: 我是一个非常热的睡眠者，我用空调和风扇睡觉，即使在新英格兰的冬天，我也会保持风扇开着。昨晚是我第一次用这条毯子睡觉，这是我第一次没有醒来被汗水浸透的春夏之夜！！这是我拥有 PERIOD 的最爱。

title: Gamechanger!
body: I was skeptical but after one night I was hooked.  This blanket is so comfortable and helped me get back to sleep after waking in the night.
translation: 我对此持怀疑态度，但一夜之后，我就被迷住了。 这条毯子非常舒适，帮助我在夜间醒来后重新入睡。

title: Cooling and so soft!
body: This blanket has been a life-saver for me.  I'm in menopause and I've been struggling with feeling overheated for hours at a time at night.  It got so bad that I started having "fever" dreams and waking up panting and sweating and being unable to fall back to sleep.  I'm someone that needs a little bit of weight on me to be able to sleep, so thin blankets do not work.  I also like to cocoon up to my neck and I was unable to do that, either.  So my sleep went out the window.  This blanket is cool to the touch and very soft and silky.  Like sleeping in a cloud.  When I move my leg under the blanket I get these wonderful little pockets of coolness.  And I'm able to snuggle up to my neck now...at least for longer periods than I could before.  My husband got jealous when he felt the fabric (he is hot natured), and now I got him one for an early  Father's Day gift.  We're both loving it!
translation:
这条毯子是我的救命稻草。 我正处于更年期，我一直在与晚上一次过热的感觉作斗争。 情况变得如此糟糕，以至于我开始做“发烧”的梦，醒来时气喘吁吁，汗流浃背，无法再次入睡。 我是一个需要一点重量才能入睡的人，所以薄毯子是行不通的。 我也喜欢茧到我的脖子上，但我也做不到。 于是我的睡意就消失了。

这条毯子摸起来很凉爽，非常柔软丝滑。 就像睡在云中一样。 当我把腿移到毯子下面时，我会得到这些美妙的小凉爽。 我现在能依偎在我的脖子上了......至少比以前更长的时间。

我丈夫一摸到布料就嫉妒了（他性格火辣），现在我给他买了一个作为父亲节的礼物。 我们俩都很喜欢它！

title: Heaven in a blanket!
body: This blanket is no joke! It's comfy, cool, light as a feather. It was over 100 °f when I got home from work and found my package on the front porch. So I'm taking the blanket out of all the nice packaging. It was packed very well. The box was super hot. I finally got the blanket out of the plastic inner packaging. It was cool!!!  My boyfriend was pouring the kitten, so he was beg over on the floor. I took the blanket and threw it ain't his neck and back. He stays yelling " Get it off of me! Get it off of me!" Lol, he's sensitive to anything cold on his neck. I sleep with this last night. Like sleeping in perfection. Me and my kitten Echo don't even want to get out of bed now! It's perfect! The lining around the edges is very nice, and I love the cool blue color. This is a MUST have blanket. Worth double what I paid!
translation: 这条毯子可不是开玩笑的！它舒适，凉爽，像羽毛一样轻。当我下班回家时，温度超过 100 °F，在前廊上发现了我的包裹。所以我把毯子从所有漂亮的包装中拿出来。它包装得很好。盒子超级热。我终于把毯子从塑料内包装里拿出来了。这很酷!! 我的男朋友正在给小猫倒酒，所以他被乞倒在地板上。我拿起毯子，把它扔到他的脖子和背部。他不停地大喊：“把它从我身上拿下来！把它从我身上拿下来！哈哈，他对脖子上任何冰冷的东西都很敏感。我昨晚睡着了这个。就像睡在完美的环境中一样。我和我的小猫 Echo 现在甚至不想起床！太完美了！边缘周围的衬里非常好，我喜欢凉爽的蓝色。这是必须拥有的毯子。价值是我支付的两倍！

title: Best blanket ever

It's cool against your skin and soft and silky. When I made the bed this morning, it was cold to the touch. Highly recommend.
translation: 我是一个中年女性，所以我正处于潮热中。我每天晚上醒来都会烤几次。我昨天把它放在床上，没有开玩笑。.我睡了一整晚。它对你的皮肤很凉爽，柔软丝滑。今天早上我整理床铺时，摸起来很冷。强烈推荐。
