I ended up taking it off my bed and using it to nap, and when you use it on its own, it does keep you cool. Disappointed it doesn't work well as a comforter which is why I gave it 3 starts, but it does keep you cool when used on its own.
translation: 我买了这个来代替我的被子，因为我晚上会潮热。这条毯子非常光滑，所以每天晚上我都会阻止毯子和我的床单之间的争吵，因为它们很容易缠结。我的睡眠受到影响。我最终把它从床上取下来，用它来小睡，当你单独使用它时，它确实能让你保持凉爽。令人失望的是，它作为被子的效果不太好，这就是为什么我给了它 3 次，但它单独使用时确实能让你保持凉爽。

title: Silky soft
body: There are other less expensive blankets out there claiming to do the same thing as Cozy Bliss but I chose this one because it was true to size, can put in the dryer, stitching around the sides seemed more durable and I liked the tie dyed color option. I ordered the king size for my queen size bed. It sits 2 feet off the ground. See posted pics to see that it still does not touch the ground but gives plenty of blanket for two people sharing it. The blanket material feels like a light weight sleeping bag. It has a silky smooth feel and is lightweight except after washing, it is very heavy. It feels cool to the touch but after being under it for a while, I do wake up hot and sometimes sweating. After removing it for a while and then putting it back on helps. My boyfriend doesnt like it. He says he gets too hot with it on. Oh well, it is a personal choice and all depends on how hot you run. Overall, it is a nice, soft, smooth feeling blanket that holds its color and size after washing and drying on low. It may not keep you cool the entire night but does feel cool initially after not being under it for a few hours or so.
translation:
还有其他更便宜的毯子声称可以做与 Cozy Bliss 相同的事情，但我选择了这个，因为它尺寸合适，可以放入烘干机，两侧的缝线看起来更耐用，而且我喜欢扎染颜色选项。
我为我的大号床订购了特大号床。它距离地面 2 英尺。查看发布的图片，可以看到它仍然没有接触地面，但为两个人分享提供了足够的毯子。
毯子材料感觉就像一个轻质睡袋。它具有丝般光滑的手感，重量轻，但洗涤后非常重。摸起来感觉很凉，但在它下面一段时间后，我确实会醒来，有时会出汗。取下一段时间后重新戴上会有帮助。我男朋友不喜欢。他说戴上它后他会感到太热。哦，好吧，这是个人选择，一切都取决于你跑得有多热。
总的来说，它是一款漂亮、柔软、光滑的毯子，在洗涤和低温干燥后保持其颜色和尺寸。它可能无法让您整晚保持凉爽，但在几个小时左右不戴它之后，最初确实会感觉凉爽。

translation: 我睡得很热，总是潮热。 我尝试过很多降温毯，但没有一个有效，直到这个。 我非常喜欢它的柔软度和它给你带来的凉爽。

translation: 到目前为止，颜色和质量都非常好。 这条毯子也很好，因为它有一定的重量，所以感觉就像你还有一条毯子一样舒适。 它是为我的儿子购买的，他的睡眠很热。 当我在睡觉前把毯子递给我 14 岁的孩子时，他立即微笑了。 我非常感激这个发现，所以我刚刚为全家又订购了 3 个。

body: I am so incredibly happy I bought this blanket. It is like always having the cool side of the pillow but wrapped around your body. I was the perfect temperature all night. The blanket feels soft and silky. The only negative and it's a minimal negative is when washing it, it is tumble dry low and our dryer takes forever on that setting so it took like 3+ hours to dry. body: I burn up at night and this is the only blanket that I’ve ever found that rebalanced the temperature as soon as my temperature changed. I don’t know what kind of magic they used but I’d like more of it.
translation: 我晚上会烧起来，这是我发现的唯一一条在我的体温变化后立即重新平衡温度的毯子。 我不知道他们使用了什么魔法，但我想要更多。

title: Cooling and soft
body: I’ve had this for about a year and I love it. It is very cooling, it’s soft and comfy, and it washes and dries well (I tumble dry low). I use it in the summer and spring. I have the light gray and I’m considering getting a second one in another color. A great value.

title: So soft!
body: I was worried this blanket would be too thin and have no weight to it, but it’s the perfect summer blanket. It’s extremely soft and cozy! I normally get too warm and throw my blanket off in the night but I stayed wrapped up in this one all night with no sweat. Highly recommend!

title: Best Purchase
body: I was debating about this purchase for a log time. When I saw it was on sale I bought one and I do not regret it. Its perfect. Now everyone in my family wants one. Its lightweight, cooling, but also very plush. I dont have to use my ceiling fan at all anymore.

title: Love this blanket
body: I can't praise this blanket enough; it is even better than I expected.  My husband likes heavy, warm blankets (although he throws them off in the middle of the night), while I prefer lightweight blankets because I can easily become overheated.  This blanket satisfies both of us, at least for the summer.  It insulates the part of the body covered, quickly warming that part with body heat, while remaining light enough to cast aside easily while I'm asleep.  I'm thinking of buying of another for my daughter.
translation: 我对这条毯子赞不绝口； 它甚至比我预期的还要好。 我丈夫喜欢厚重、温暖的毯子（尽管他会在半夜把它们扔掉），而我更喜欢轻薄的毯子，因为我很容易变得过热。 这条毯子让我们俩都满意，至少在夏天是这样。 它可以隔离身体被覆盖的部分，用体温快速加热该部分，同时保持足够的重量，以便在我睡觉时轻松地抛开。 我正在考虑给我女儿再买一件。

title: Best Comforter Ever!
body: This is my all time favorite comforter! It’s soft, well made, down alternative, and the cooling fabric doesn’t make my psoriasis flare. This comforter really does keep you both warm and cool. It’s well worth the money.

title: Almost good.
body: So I was very excited to try this seeing as someone had said it was very close Rest duvet dupe, and even ordered some as gifts for people when there was a lightning deal. Unfortunately, I just used mine for the first time last night, and while it was DELICIOUS when first getting into bed, it was apparent that it was not good at maintaining its coolness on hotter areas of the body (ex. upper legs) and kind of held the warmth there. I tried shifting the blanket around so maybe new cool sections could rest on the warmer areas, but it didn’t seem to make a difference. Any part of the body that did not produce significant heat to begin with was fine. And I did have the air conditioner running at 67° so it’s not like the environment wasn’t conducive to maintaining cool temperatures. I don’t usually consider myself a hot sleeper, but knowing the people I wanted to give these to ARE hot sleepers—if it doesn’t entirely work on me, it’s not going to work on them. So I will likely send the gifts back, and I’m not sure what to do about mine. I hate returning stuff just because an item didn’t quite do what it was advertised to do, but also, even for copycats, these duvets were kind of expensive so it feels like a bit of a loss. If they work for other people, that’s wonderful! But I wish it worked for me.
translation: 所以我很高兴尝试这个，因为有人说它非常接近休息羽绒被骗局，甚至在闪电交易时订购了一些作为送给人们的礼物。不幸的是，我昨晚才第一次使用我的，虽然第一次上床时它很美味，但很明显它不擅长在身体较热的部位（例如大腿）保持凉爽，并且有点保持那里的温暖。我尝试移动毯子，这样也许新的凉爽部分可以放在温暖的区域，但这似乎没有什么区别。身体任何一开始不产生大量热量的部位都没有问题。我确实把空调开到了 67°，所以环境并不是不利于保持凉爽的温度。我通常不认为自己是一个热睡者，但我知道我想给这些人的人都是热睡者——如果它对我不完全有效，那么对他们也不起作用。所以我可能会把礼物退回去，但我不知道该怎么处理我的礼物。我讨厌仅仅因为某件商品没有完全达到其广告宣传的效果而退货，而且，即使对于山寨者来说，这些羽绒被也有点昂贵，所以感觉有点损失。如果他们为其他人工作，那就太好了！但我希望它对我有用。

title: So cool!
body: I bought two of these last year and I love them so much the price was too good to resist so I bought a new one. It's exactly the same as the ones that cost over $100 I bought both and returned the one that was expensive and save this one. There's no weird smell it's extremely soft mint color is very light and then it's white on the other side. Keeps you cool but sometimes you have to flip it over adjust it in the night because it gets warm. But it does work really well and I recommend it to anyone who sleeps hot.
translation: 我去年买了其中的两个，我非常喜欢它们，价格太优惠了，所以我买了一个新的。 和100多块的一模一样，我两个都买了，把贵的那个退回来，留这个。 没有奇怪的气味，非常柔软的薄荷色，很浅，然后另一面是白色的。 让您保持凉爽，但有时您必须将其翻过来进行调整，因为它会变热。 但它确实非常有效，我推荐给所有睡得热的人。

title: Not actually cold
body: I've had 2 fans blowing on me all night the last 2 nights sleeping with this blanket, and it definitely doesn't stay cool to the touch. The only thing it does is not retain as much heat as a blanket usually would, so if you like more weight than a sheet on you, it's a good substitute even though a little warmer than a sheet. Not sure it's worth the price.
translation: 过去两个晚上，我盖着这条毯子睡觉时，整晚都有 2 个风扇对着我吹，而且摸起来绝对不凉爽。它唯一的作用是不像毯子通常那样保留那么多的热量，所以如果你喜欢比床单更重的东西，它是一个很好的替代品，尽管比床单暖和一点。不确定是否值这个价钱。

title: Really cool’s on both sides
body: This comforter is very lightweight and so soft. It almost feels like satin. Size is good. I ordered a QUERN and you have plenty for the sides. But the cooling is the best part! Especially for the price. Very pretty Blue. Would definitely buy another

title: Good night sleep.
body: This blanket is the best during the summer time. It’s not to heavy and it really keeps you cool.

title: Wow

title: Cool and comfortable
body: This blanket is perfect for hot flashes and warm summer nights. The fabric is cool to the touch. Very lightweight and soft.

title: Definitely a 5 star blanket ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
body: Love this blanket!  Soft cool lightweight, perfect.
translation: 喜欢这条毯子！ 软凉轻盈，完美。

title: so soft!!
body: I was really skeptical about if this would be cooling like it says but omg I finally slept without waking up all sweaty. Its also SUPER soft which is a huge plus for me! my one issue is I wish it was a little bit heavier? but I think that can be solved with a throw blanket over it or even a weighted blanket
translation: 我真的很怀疑这是否会像它说的那样凉爽，但天哪，我终于睡着了，没有醒来时浑身出汗。 它也超级柔软，这对我来说是一个巨大的优势！ 我的一个问题是我希望它重一点？ 但我认为这可以通过盖上毯子甚至加重毯子来解决

title: Awesome Cool Blanket!
body: I'm really liking this blanket! As others stated, as soon as I took ot out of the package, it felt cool.  I'm unsure how a blanket can feel so cold but it does.  How do they do this? It is unbelievably soft and cool. I washed it on gentle cycle and air dried it.  Even taking it out of the dryer it was cool.  I wasn't sure that it was entirely dry because feeling it was so cool but it was dry. Sleeping was awesome. I do sleep with a top sheet, and this blanket on top. I don't think a blanket can entirely keep a person from overheating at night but this is the softest, coolest blanket that I've tried, and do love it. While sleeping, I took my leg out and laid it on this blanket and it was cool and felt great. I bought the light blue, King size.  I most definitely recommend this to anyone that is looking for some cool comfort sleeping.
translation:
我真的很喜欢这条毯子！
正如其他人所说，当我从包装中取出它时，感觉很酷。 我不确定毯子怎么会感觉这么冷，但确实如此。 他们如何做到这一点？
它令人难以置信的柔软和凉爽。
我轻柔地清洗它并风干。 即使把它从烘干机里拿出来，也很凉爽。 我不确定它是否完全干燥，因为感觉它很酷，但它是干燥的。
睡觉的感觉棒极了。 我睡觉时确实盖着床单，上面盖着毯子。
我不认为毯子可以完全防止人在晚上过热，但这是我尝试过的最柔软、最凉爽的毯子，并且非常喜欢它。
睡觉时，我把腿拿出来放在毯子上，感觉很凉爽，感觉很棒。
我买的是浅蓝色的，King size的。 我绝对推荐这个给任何正在寻找凉爽舒适睡眠的人。

title: Cool and Soft
body: I love this blanket. It’s great for hot sleepers. It keeps me cool all night and it’s very soft. I got the queen size and it fits my queen size bed perfectly.
translation: 我喜欢这条毯子。 这对于热睡者来说非常好。 它让我整夜保持凉爽，而且非常柔软。 我买的是大号床，它非常适合我的大号床。

title: Not Cool or Cooling at all.
body: I would not agree that this helps you stay cool while sleeping. It might be cool to the touch for a little while but to sleep with it all night. It's a no for me. I see why it might have been on sale. While it is very soft, silky, and lightweight, it did not help keep me or my husband cool at night. I even tried to sleep with it by myself I woke up hot and not in a great mood. I also tried to flip it over during the night to see if that would help while I was using it alone it did help for a small amount of time but then I ended up with half my body out of the comforter looking for relief from the heat. This might be a good blanket to use for a simple power nap but not for sleeping 4 plus hours. It could also be used as a great cuddle blanket for a short amount of time but I would not recommend it if you tend to be a hot-natured sleeper.
translation:
我不同意这可以帮助你在睡觉时保持凉爽。摸起来可能会有点凉，但整晚都戴着它睡觉。这对我来说是不行的。我明白为什么它可能会被出售。
虽然它非常柔软、丝滑、轻盈，但它并不能帮助我或我的丈夫在晚上保持凉爽。我什至尝试自己抱着它睡觉，但醒来时很热，心情也不好。我还试着在晚上把它翻过来，看看这是否有帮助，当我单独使用它时，它确实在一小段时间内有帮助，但后来我把半个身体从被子里拿出来寻求缓解热量。
这可能是一个很好的毯子，适合简单的小睡，但不适合睡 4 个多小时。它也可以在短时间内用作一个很棒的拥抱毯，但如果您倾向于热性睡眠，我不会推荐它。

title: Performs as said!!!
body: Beat blanket I’ve owned!! Perfect blanket for sleeping in summer & for hot sleepers as myself . Blanket does keep you cool and it’s light wgt but not paper thin the perfect amount. Feels like silk.
translation: 我拥有的击败毯子！ 非常适合夏天睡觉和像我这样热睡的人的毯子。 毯子确实能让你保持凉爽，重量轻，但不是纸薄的完美数量。 感觉像丝绸。

title: Very cooling!
body: Love the feel, has good weight and keeps you warm but not hot! Great value for price! Colors are beautiful. Great summer comforter!!! 3 cheers from my hot & sweaty sleeper partner (no more)!
translation: 喜欢这种感觉，重量适中，让您保暖但不热！ 性价比很高！ 颜色很漂亮。 很棒的夏季被子！！！ 我的热汗淋漓的睡伴为我欢呼 3 声（仅此而已）！

title: Wow
body: I love this blanket. Cold to touch. Lightweight, soft. Very comfortable. I sweat all night typically. This blanket amazingly  kept me cooler. I got the light blue. Beautiful color.
translation: 我喜欢这条毯子。 摸起来很冷。 轻质、柔软。 非常舒服。 我通常整夜出汗。 这条毯子神奇地让我保持凉爽。 我拿到的是浅蓝色的。 美丽的颜色。

title: Misleading
body: Very misleading as you expect you get the pillow cases but it's another 80 dollar for 2 pillowcases.
translation: 非常误导你，因为你期望你能得到枕套，但 2 个枕套要另外花 80 美元。

title: Changing my life.
body: I’m not kidding. I wouldn’t have waited so long to purchase one of these had I known. I’m a very hot sleeper, and this is actually life changing. Glad I didn’t spend $$$$ for that name brand. Sleep is my foundation, and this makes it SO much better! Highly, highly recommend.
translation: 我不是在开玩笑。 如果我知道的话，我就不会等这么久才购买其中一件。 我的睡眠很热，这实际上改变了我的生活。 很高兴我没有花$$$$购买那个名牌。 睡眠是我的基础，这让它变得更好！ 强烈，强烈推荐。

title: not a cooling blanket
body: This blanket boasts a substantial weight, but unfortunately lacks the breathability one might hope for. While the fabric initially feels pleasantly cool to the touch, it quickly loses that refreshing quality once you're wrapped up in it, turning rather warm. While it may be ideal for winter use due to its heaviness, it falls short in providing any cooling relief during warmer months. Personally, I found it uncomfortably warm, causing me to switch back to my trusty cotton down comforter in the middle of the night. I wouldn't recommend this blanket; instead, I'd suggest opting for a lighter cotton alternative with better breathability.
translation: 这条毯子重量很大，但不幸的是缺乏人们所希望的透气性。虽然这种面料最初摸起来感觉凉爽宜人，但一旦你裹在里面，它很快就会失去那种清爽的感觉，变得相当温暖。虽然由于其重量而非常适合冬季使用，但在温暖的月份中它无法提供任何降温效果。就我个人而言，我发现它温暖得令人不舒服，导致我在半夜换回我值得信赖的棉质羽绒被。我不推荐这条毯子；相反，我建议选择更轻、透气性更好的棉质替代品。

title: Absolutely LOVE this!!
body: Definitely is a cooling blanket yet doesn’t chill you to the bone. It’s absolutely perfect
translation: 绝对是一个凉爽的毯子，但不会让你冷到骨子里。 绝对是完美的

title: So soft
body: Great blanket if you sleep hot like me, light but soft n cozy and feels cool to touch
translation: 如果你像我一样睡得很热，这是很棒的毯子，轻便但柔软舒适，摸起来很凉爽

title: Cool and smooth
body: Wow I really love this blanket it’s so cool to the touch and it’s made with a smooth silky fabric.  I live in a tropical island so it gets a little warm at night so I use it as a bed topper. My dogs love it too so I’m ordering one for every bedroom in my home.  Also going to order a couple for my dog’s bedding as well.  I haven’t washed it yet so I don’t know if it washes well.
translation: 哇，我真的很喜欢这条毯子，它摸起来很凉爽，而且是用光滑的丝质面料制成的。 我住在一个热带岛屿上，所以晚上会有点热，所以我用它作为床上用品。 我的狗也喜欢它，所以我为家里的每间卧室都订购了一个。 我还要为我的狗订购一些床上用品。 我还没洗过，不知道好不好洗。

title: ITS COLD!
body: I lovvveeeddd it! Its nice and cold! I haven’t had a good sleep since I birthed my first child. Now I been sleeping like a baby! I recommend it!
translation:
我爱它！它又好又冷！
自从我生下第一个孩子以来，我就没有睡过好觉。现在我睡得像个婴儿！我推荐它！

title: Comfy Blanket
body: The satin covering on this blanket does have a cool feel when you cover up with it, and it's lightweight.  I think the term 'cooling' is a little misleading though - it's not like a fan or air conditioner that will truly cool you down.  Although it feels cool at first, it does warm up after you sit or lie under it for a time - just like you'd want a blanket to do.  So, it's great if you want a silky light-weight blanket to keep you warm.  It's also very attractive and would be a nice accent on your bed.
translation: 这条毯子上的缎面覆盖物确实有一种凉爽的感觉，而且它很轻。我认为“冷却”这个词有点误导——它不像风扇或空调那样能真正让你降温。虽然一开始感觉很凉，但当你坐或躺在它下面一段时间后，它就会变暖——就像你想要一条毯子一样。因此，如果您想要一条丝质轻薄的毯子来保暖，那就太好了。它也非常有吸引力，是您床上的一个不错的点缀。

title: Cool!
body: Light weight, cooling and comfy!
translation: 重量轻，凉爽舒适！

title: pretty disapointed
body: This blanket is very soft and cold to the touch. I am disappointed because I get hot at night when using it. I thought by cooling blanket it would be cool all night. It feels nice at 1st but I wake up in the middle of the night hot. My husband said he gets pretty hot at night too. I don't think I will be able to use it through the summer.
translation: 这条毯子非常柔软，摸起来冰凉。我很失望，因为我晚上使用它时会感到很热。我以为用凉毯一整夜都会很凉爽。一开始感觉很好，但半夜醒来感觉很热。我老公说他晚上也很热。我想我整个夏天都无法使用它。

title: Good blanket
body: It is very cool to the touch, but does warm up when in use. Just buy a large blanket so you can shift it and contact a cool part. I would not share this blanket. We each have a queen for the reason I mentioned. But it’s very silky feeling and comfortable to sleep with!
translation: 摸起来很凉，但使用时会发热。只需购买一条大毯子，这样您就可以移动它并接触凉爽的部分。我不会分享这条毯子。出于我提到的原因，我们每个人都有一个女王。但触感非常丝滑，睡起来很舒服！

title: Extremely thin fabric
body: This blanket has extremely thin fabric over the filling. I doubt if it would even hold up to a washing but definitely not to the footprints of my cat or the scratches of my own nails. I am so sorry to have purchased it since I live in an assisted care facility and can’t really return it by myself. Please do not buy this. You will be equally as insulted as I was.
translation: 这条毯子的填充物上有极薄的织物。我怀疑它是否能经得起洗涤，但绝对不能经得起我猫的脚印或我自己指甲的划痕。我很抱歉购买了它，因为我住在辅助护理机构中，无法亲自归还它。请不要购买这个。你会像我一样受到侮辱。

title: Feels great, stitching is not.
body: If you want something heavier than a sheet and lighter than a comforter, this is it. The material feels amazing! I refrained from sleeping with a sheet so I can feel the material. However, everytime I pull this blanket out from underneath me, I hear threads popping. I assume within the year all threads holding the internal parts will be separated. It will probably still function the same but my guess is after a wash, the internals will fold together.
translation: 如果您想要比床单重且比被子轻的东西，那就是它。材质感觉棒极了！我没有盖着床单睡觉，这样我就能感觉到材质。然而，每次我从身下拉出这条毯子时，我都会听到线头爆裂的声音。我假设在一年之内，所有固定内部零件的螺纹都将被分离。它的功能可能仍然相同，但我猜测清洗后，内部结构会折叠在一起。

title: Sooooo soft and cooling.
body: I was skeptical, so am pleasantly surprised. Packaging is attractive and looks expensive. Extremely soft, cooling and perfect weight. Color true to photos. A very pretty light pink and gray.
translation: 我持怀疑态度，所以感到惊喜。包装很有吸引力，看起来很贵。极其柔软、凉爽和完美的重量。色彩与照片相符。非常漂亮的浅粉色和灰色。

title: BEST COOLING Comforter LOVE Mine!
body: Makes bedtime enjoyable with this luxurious soft light comforter!  I have never had such a cooling sleep ever!  Looked on your site looking for sheets cannot find would be heavenly!  From Houston, TX
translation: 用这款豪华的柔软轻盈被子让就寝时间愉快！ 我从来没有睡过这么凉爽的觉！ 在您的网站上寻找找不到的床单将是天堂！ 出发于Houston， TX

title: Cooling
body: This is a very nice cover! I suffer from hot flashes and this is definitely calming the night sweats some! It’s well made and the color pink that I chose is pretty!
translation: 这是一个非常漂亮的封面！我患有潮热，这绝对是平息盗汗！它做工精良，我选择的粉红色很漂亮！

title: Very happy with this
body: Love this. Highly recommend!
translation: 喜欢这个。强烈推荐！

title: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Amazing!!!
body: I absolutely love this blanket! My husband is a big muscular guy and he is always hot at night. I am small and I am always cold. At night, he likes the fan on and AC down to 65, and I’m freezing!🥶 I purchased this blanket and it has been a game changer! At night, I stay warm and cozy under the blanket and he stays nice and cool & he hasn’t complained once. We live in Florida where it is hot, and he still stays cool under the blanket.  The blanket is soft and silky like actual silk! It is lightweight like silk. It does not wrinkle and that is amazing- I am sure you know what I mean if you ever had to unwrinkle a queen or king size comforter or even dry it, and it is so hard to get the wrinkles out! When you do- you wake up in the morning and it’s bunched up at the edge of the bed and wrinkled again! Not with this blanket! No matter what you do- it remains wrinkle free! It isn’t heavy, you won’t feel weighed down by a blanket, and it is cool and airy. It feels like the cold spot on a pillow, but all over. & if you stay in one spot it keeps you nice and warm but not too warm, and if you move, it feels like the cold spot on a pillow. The blanket can be laying on my bed before I make my bed and it is cool as ice but my sheets are not. I cannot say enough good things about this blanket! It is made well and doesn’t feel cheap. It has a nice piping around the edges for support. It is extra long so it doesn’t require tugging to fit around a queen bed (I have a queen and purchased queen size). You can lay on it and it feels like silk , it is so luxurious, even through your clothes! You feel like it is silky and you are going to slide off the bed. It is perfect for those who like to stay cool at night. I will be buying more- I have teenage boys who sweat easily and this is perfect!
translation:
我非常喜欢这条毯子！我丈夫是一个肌肉发达的大个子，他晚上总是很热。我很小，我总是很冷。晚上，他喜欢开着风扇，空调降到65度，我都冻僵了！ 🥶 我购买了这条毯子，它改变了游戏规则！晚上，我在毯子下保持温暖和舒适，他保持良好和凉爽，他没有抱怨过一次。我们住在佛罗里达，那里很热，他仍然在毯子下保持凉爽。

毯子柔软丝滑，就像真正的丝绸一样！它像丝绸一样轻盈。它不会起皱，这真是太棒了——我相信你明白我的意思，如果你曾经不得不解开大号或特大号被子，甚至擦干它，而且很难去除皱纹！当你这样做时，你早上醒来，它又堆在床边，又起皱了！不是用这条毯子！无论您做什么，它都保持无皱纹！它不重，你不会觉得被毯子压得喘不过气来，而且凉爽通风。感觉就像枕头上的冷点，但到处都是。如果你呆在一个地方，它会让你保持温暖和温暖，但不会太暖和，如果你移动，感觉就像枕头上的冷点。在我铺床之前，毯子可以放在我的床上，它像冰一样凉爽，但我的床单却没有。关于这条毯子，我不能说太多的好话！它做得很好，感觉不便宜。它的边缘有一个很好的管道作为支撑。它特别长，所以不需要拉扯就可以放在一张大床上（我有一个大号床，买了大号床）。你可以躺在上面，感觉就像丝绸一样，它是如此奢华，甚至隔着你的衣服！你觉得它很丝滑，你要从床上滑下来。它非常适合那些喜欢在晚上保持凉爽的人。我会买更多——我有十几岁的男孩，他们很容易出汗，这太完美了！

title: Life Changing!
body: I rarely write reviews, but I felt I needed to with this one. This is my favorite comforter I have ever owned. The silky soft feel is beyond amazing. At first I was worried it would be a little too lightweight, but it is perfect. I sleep pretty hot, so the little bit of cooling is very nice. I am very much a fan, and would buy again in a heartbeat!
translation: 我很少写评论，但我觉得我需要写这篇评论。这是我拥有过的最喜欢的被子。丝般柔软的手感令人惊叹。起初我担心它会有点太轻了，但它是完美的。我睡得很热，所以一点点的凉爽非常好。我非常喜欢，会心跳加速再次购买！

title: Absolutely incredible
body: This comforter is so perfect. I was waking up covered in sweat all the time, finally decided to pick up this blanket and oh my god, problems solved. It def works to keep you cool and it’s so incredibly soft. Highly recommended for hot sleepers
translation: 这个被子太完美了。我醒来时一直浑身是汗，终于决定拿起这条毯子，哦，天哪，问题解决了。它的作用是让你保持凉爽，而且它非常柔软。强烈推荐给热睡者

title: Cooling yes! - not colorful or warm enough
body: I was surprised to find that this comforter truly did keep us cool! It’s very soft, similar to a silky touch, and my son can sleep under the blanket all night long (he’s a heat ball). For me, I need an extra blanket on top bc while it certainly keeps me cool, it doesn’t keep “in” the heat like it says it does. Also, the mint green color is not as saturated as the picture shows, so it’s barely perceptible which is a bummer bc it mostly looks off-white.
translation: 我惊讶地发现这款被子确实让我们保持凉爽！它非常柔软，类似于丝滑的触感，我的儿子可以在毯子下睡一整夜（他是一个热球）。对我来说，我需要在上面盖一条额外的毯子，虽然它确实能让我保持凉爽，但它并不像它所说的那样保持“炎热”。此外，薄荷绿的颜色并不像图片所示那么饱和，因此几乎无法察觉，这很糟糕，因为它看起来大多是灰白色的。

title: BUY! Buy! Buy!
body: I researched and tried various cooling blankets. This one won my heart and wallet. I’m a very hot sleeper and I’m willing to pay for comfort at night.  The REST cooling blanket was also a close second and a little bit heavier.  The fabric is super cool, soft and slick— kinda like a “puffy jacket feel.” It is lightweight but has enough weight at night.  I’m so delighted with this blanket that I’ve purchased 3 in different colors.  I don’t use a top sheet- just the blanket. I have washed them on delicate and they washed beautifully.  HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!
translation:
我研究并尝试了各种降温毯。这个赢得了我的心和钱包。
我睡得很热，我愿意为晚上的舒适付出代价。 REST冷却毯也紧随其后，而且有点重。

面料超级凉爽、柔软、光滑——有点像“蓬松的夹克感觉”。它很轻，但在晚上有足够的重量。

我对这条毯子非常满意，以至于我购买了 3 条不同颜色的毯子。

我不使用床单，只使用毯子。我把它们洗得很精致，它们洗得很漂亮。

强烈推荐！！

title: So soft and cool
body: Love this blanket!
translation: 喜欢这条毯子！

title: Beautiful and good quality cooling comforter for hot sleepers
body: UPDATE: I've had this for a couple months now, and the biggest issue it has is the stitching. The stitching is not good quality, and many parts of it are already coming off. I find my arms and legs frequently getting snagged on stitches that are loose, which is inconvenient if not a little painful 😭 I've resorted to just cutting the stitches whenever I notice a piece coming off so that I don't have to deal with that. Because of this issue, I definitely don't recommend buying at full price, but overall, I am still happy I got it. ------------- Original Review: When I tell you this comforter is SOFT!!!!! It truly feels so nice on your skin. I got it in blue, size queen. It looks pretty (it was also packaged nicely), with white stitching and a white border at the edges. The queen size is large enough, though don't expect it to tuck into the mattress; it seems like it's only meant to lay on top of your bed. I think queen would be perfect for one person, otherwise, maybe get the king size. It definitely feels cool, not by a crazy difference, but enough to be noticeable and to bring relief, especially if you live in a warm/hot climate. It's thinner than expected, and there's not much filling, but that's probably what makes it better at cooling. Seems like it'll be perfect for the upcoming summer. I haven't tried washing it yet, but it's supposed to be machine washable and dryable, so we'll see how it turns out after some washes. Very happy with this purchase so far, especially since it was on sale.
translation:
更新：
我已经用了几个月了，最大的问题是缝合。缝线质量不好，很多地方都已经脱落了。我发现我的胳膊和腿经常被松散的缝线绊住，这即使不是有点痛苦，也是不方便的。 每当我发现有一块缝线脱落时，我就会把缝线剪掉，这样我就不必处理这个问题了。由于这个问题，我绝对不建议全价购买，但总的来说，我仍然很高兴我得到了它。
-------------
原评论：
当我告诉你这被子很软！！！！皮肤真的感觉非常好。我买的是蓝色的，大号的。它看起来很漂亮（包装也很好），有白色缝线，边缘有白色边框。大号床足够大，但不要指望它能塞进床垫里；看起来它只能放在你的床上。我认为大号对于一个人来说是完美的，否则，也许买特大号。它确实感觉很酷，虽然不是一个疯狂的差异，但足以引人注目并带来缓解，特别是如果你生活在温暖/炎热的气候中。它比预期的要薄，而且填充物不多，但这可能是它冷却效果更好的原因。看来它非常适合即将到来的夏天。我还没有尝试过清洗它，但它应该可以机洗和烘干，所以我们会看看几次清洗后效果如何。到目前为止，我对这次购买感到非常满意，尤其是因为它正在打折。

title: Cool to the touch but warms up
body: It s cool on the surface but just like any other fabric it does warm up from body heat. It’s not going to keep you feeling cool beyond a the first couple minutes.  You have to keep moving it around to find a new cool spot. It’s very slick and slides off the bed easily. The blue color is nice.  Also, and this is very very strange… the queen size is a square instead of the normal rectangle that you expect.  It fits on a queen mattress but looks a little odd because of the shape.
translation:
它表面很凉，但就像任何其他织物一样，它会因体热而变暖。在最初的几分钟之后，它不会让你感觉凉爽。你必须不断移动它才能找到新的酷点。它非常光滑，很容易从床上滑落。蓝色很好看。

另外，这非常非常奇怪……大号尺寸是正方形，而不是您期望的正常矩形。它适合放在大号床垫上，但由于形状而看起来有点奇怪。

title: Soft and cool, See update.
body: Update. 7/2024, While this is cooling the threading on this blanket does rip and has come apart on both sides catching my toes when pushing the blanket around at night. Got my pinky almost cut from a loop of this threading. I've contacted Cozy Bliss a few times and they will not respond to me.  So buyer beware this blanket will not stay together long and is why it's cheaper than the better options.  Now I'm disappointed in my purchase. Shame on Cozy Bliss for not responding!!
translation: 更新。 7/2024，虽然正在冷却，但这条毯子上的线确实撕裂了，并且在晚上推毯子时，两边都分开了，卡住了我的脚趾。我的小指差点被这个线环割断了。我曾多次联系 Cozy Bliss，但他们都没有回复我。因此，买家请注意，这条毯子不会长时间保持在一起，这就是为什么它比更好的选择更便宜的原因。现在我对我的购买感到失望。舒适幸福没有回应真是可耻！

title: El material es increíble 👏🏻
body: Es un blanket muy bueno y cómodo lo uso a diario y es muy fácil de lavar  y darle cuidado ciertamente lo recomiendo para el verano es muy suave y agradable al tacto.
translation: 这是一条非常好和舒适的毯子，我每天都使用它，它非常容易清洗和护理，我当然推荐它在夏天使用，它非常柔软，触感舒适。

title: Cool comforter
body: Comforter is cool and light weight as advertised.  Enjoying it this transitional spring season in FL where the temps are already climbing into the 80s.
translation: 被子像广告宣传的那样凉爽且重量轻。 在佛罗里达州的这个过渡春季享受它，那里的温度已经攀升到 80 年代。

title: Cover
body: For grandson: He loves it not heavy keeps him cool
translation: 对于孙子：他喜欢它，而不是沉重让他保持凉爽

title: Bought 2, buying more to replace all my blankets.
body: My husband and I got 2 different brands Rest Duvet, twin size for our king bed… my girls fell in love with them so I found these and they are extremely comparable for way less. We let them tumble dry no heat or hang them on our banister, but easy to wash. This fits my daughter’s full size bed easily! Highly recommend! Keeps you cool, but not too cold in the winter… even when we travel we take these with us!
translation: 我和我的丈夫有 2 个不同品牌的 Rest 羽绒被，我们的特大号床是双床......我的女儿们爱上了它们，所以我找到了它们，它们非常具有可比性。我们让它们滚筒烘干，不加热，或者把它们挂在我们的栏杆上，但很容易清洗。这很容易适合我女儿的全尺寸床！强烈推荐！让你保持凉爽，但在冬天不会太冷......即使我们旅行时，我们也会随身携带这些！

title: Unbelievable Comfort and Versatility!
body: I recently purchased the Cozy Bliss Dual-Sided Cooling Comforter in Queen size, and I can confidently say it's the most incredible blanket I've ever owned. The cooling effect is simply amazing, making it perfect for warm nights, yet it remains warm and comfortable, creating a cozy oasis for a good night's sleep.  The dual-sided design with dark grey and light grey options adds a stylish touch to my bedroom decor, and the breathable silk-smooth texture enhances the overall comfort. As someone who tends to experience night sweats, this blanket has been a game-changer. It effectively regulates temperature, keeping me cool without compromising on that snug and comforting feeling.  I was so impressed with my blue Cozy Bliss Comforter that I recently ordered a grey one. The quality is outstanding, and it's worth every penny. If you're a hot sleeper or someone who appreciates the perfect balance of warmth and coolness, don't hesitate to invest in the Cozy Bliss Dual-Sided Cooling Comforter. You won't be disappointed!
translation:
我最近购买了大号的 Cozy Bliss 双面降温被，我可以自信地说这是我拥有过的最令人难以置信的毯子。凉爽的效果简直令人惊叹，非常适合温暖的夜晚，同时又保持温暖和舒适，为一夜好眠创造了一个舒适的绿洲。

深灰色和浅灰色的双面设计为我的卧室装饰增添了时尚气息，透气的丝绸般光滑的质地增强了整体舒适度。作为一个容易出现盗汗的人，这条毯子改变了游戏规则。它有效地调节温度，让我保持凉爽，而不会影响那种舒适和舒适的感觉。

我的蓝色 Cozy Bliss 被子给我留下了深刻的印象，以至于我最近订购了一件灰色的。质量出众，每一分钱都值得。如果您是热睡者或喜欢温暖和凉爽的完美平衡的人，请不要犹豫，购买 Cozy Bliss 双面降温被。你不会失望的！

title: Stays very cool
body: The best cooling blanket very lightweight
translation: 最好的冷却毯非常轻巧

title: Very soft
body: This blanket is so soft my daughter and grandson had to purchase one. The weight is just right, not too heavy and not too light.  This is the only blanket I use on my bed. It is worth trying out.
translation: 这条毯子太软了，我的女儿和孙子不得不买一条。重量恰到好处，不太重也不太轻。 这是我在床上唯一用的毯子。值得一试。

title: Exactly as expected.
body: This is the best comforter I've ever owned. It lightweight, but I still feel like I have something covering me. It's also cool to the touch and silky soft. I've had this for a week now and have zero complaints with it's use.  I've run it through the washing machine on gentle, with cool water. I didn't put it in the dryer, but let it air dry. I haven't noticed any texture changes or damage.  So happy and highly recommend for anyone who sleeps hot. Rest well!
translation:
这是我拥有过的最好的被子。它很轻，但我仍然觉得我有东西覆盖着我。它的触感也很凉爽，如丝般柔软。我已经用了一个星期了，对它的使用没有任何抱怨。

我已经用冷水轻轻地把它放进洗衣机里。我没有把它放在烘干机里，而是让它风干。我没有注意到任何纹理变化或损坏。

太开心了，强烈推荐给睡得很热的人。好好休息！

title: Worth it!
body: It’s cool to touch and lightweight. After awhile it may warm a bit to body heat but if your a turner in your sleep like I am, you’ll get some of the cool bits of the blanket through the night and it feels amazing. Only con would be that the stitching is a little wonky but not too noticeable. This is an edited review and now 5 stars because I have loved it so far. So much so I actually went ahead and purchased another blanket that has been on my wish list for years (Rest), but to my surprise the Cozy bliss is cooler and hands down my favorite. Cozy bliss is practically the exact dupe, down to the fabrics, weight, and thickness, but stays cooler! I most definitely want to get a smaller size for my reading chair because it’s that cozy.
translation: 触感凉爽且重量轻。 过了一会儿，它可能会变暖一点，达到体温，但如果你像我一样在睡眠中翻腾，你会在整个晚上感受到毯子的一些凉爽，感觉棒极了。 唯一的缺点是缝线有点不稳定，但不太明显。 这是经过编辑的评论，现在 5 星，因为到目前为止我很喜欢它。 以至于我实际上继续购买了另一条多年来一直在我的愿望清单上的毯子（休息），但令我惊讶的是，舒适的幸福更凉爽，毫无疑问是我的最爱。 舒适的幸福实际上是完全的骗局，具体到面料、重量和厚度，但保持凉爽！ 我绝对想为我的阅读椅买一个较小尺寸的，因为它太舒服了。

title: Best blanket
body: I bought this for myself and my husky took it over.  It’s light weight it cool all night and soft and comfortable.  As for the dog it’s help him sleep better  and it’s a win in my book!
translation: 我给自己买了这个，我的哈士奇接管了它。 它重量轻，整夜凉爽，柔软舒适。 对于狗来说，这可以帮助他睡得更好，这在我看来是一个胜利！

title: Nice
body: Waiting for warmer weather
translation: 等待天气转暖

title: cooling touch
body: This is an awesome comforter, very comfortable.  It has a cooling feeling, it is lightweight, but heavy enough for a comfortable nights sleep. I would recommend, and would also buy again.
translation: 这是一个很棒的被子，非常舒服。 它具有凉爽的感觉，重量轻，但足够重，可以让您舒适地睡眠。 我会推荐，也会再次购买。

title: GAME CHANGER
body: just get it
translation: 只要得到它

title: So nice and cool
body: It kept me warm enough but if feeling too warm, just move around or kick your legs out to feel coolnesson outside and the inside. Love it!!
translation: 它让我保持足够的温暖，但如果感觉太热，只需四处走动或踢腿即可感受到外部和内部的凉爽。 爱它！！

title: Seams ripping
body: Like other reviews have said, the seams are very poor quality. They were coming apart before I washed it. Washed on gentle cycle with cool water. Dried on low. Not worth the price.
translation: 正如其他评论所说，接缝质量非常差。在我洗之前它们就分开了。用冷水轻柔洗涤。低温干燥。不值这个价钱。

title: Love this blanket!
body: For all my warm blooded, hot flash girls!  Bought the first of these blankets when I saw it on sale.  I have always run warm,and sleeping got harder as I got older. My husband would be freezing while I was overheated!  Saw this blanket as a dupe of a much more expensive one,and decided to give it a try.  Wow, what a difference it makes.  Husband is only cold for a minute or two after hopping into bed, and I could now sleep comfortably for most of the night.  Washing instructions are super easy.  Found it works better for me with no top sheet.  Loved it so much we bought a second one!
translation: 献给我所有热血、潮热的女孩们！ 当我看到它打折时，买了第一条毯子。 我一直都很热，随着年龄的增长，睡眠变得越来越困难。 当我过热时，我丈夫会冻僵！ 看到这条毯子是一条更贵的毯子的仿冒品，决定试一试。 哇，这有多么不同啊。 丈夫跳上床后只感觉冷一两分钟，现在我可以舒服地睡上大半夜了。 洗涤说明超级简单。 发现没有顶表的情况下它对我来说效果更好。 非常喜欢它，我们买了第二个！

title: Soft and cooling
body: Exactly what I was looking for! I love it
translation: 正是我一直在寻找的东西！ 我喜欢它

title: I couldn't sleeep without it
body: I originally bought this amazing "blanket" last Spring. It was soooo amazingly cool I was scared to wash it.. Finally did last month (DEC) Yikes....Was so afraid it won't come out the same so I bought another  before washing. I took the "plunge". Following the "washing instructions" it came out perfectly!.... and still is amazingly COOL!. I will keep this second order. Never want to sleep without this!
translation: 我最初是去年春天买的这条神奇的“毯子”。 它太酷了，我害怕洗它。上个月（12 月）终于洗了，哎呀......太害怕它不会一样，所以我在洗之前又买了一个。 我采取了“暴跌”。 按照“洗涤说明”，结果非常完美！......而且仍然非常酷！ 我会保留第二个订单。 没有这个就永远不想睡觉！

title: SO SOFT
body: This blanket is incredible. So silky soft and truly does cool your body. Absolutely recommend. 4/5 stars bc the threading is coming undone in a few spots
translation: 这条毯子太不可思议了。如丝般柔软，真正让您的身体凉爽。绝对推荐。 4/5 星 BC 线程在一些地方会被取消

title: Cozy Bliss for sure!
body: This is amazing for hot flashes! I bought a second 1 as well! They wash up nice and they are definitely worth the money
translation: 这对于潮热来说真是太神奇了！ 我也买了第二个1！ 它们洗起来很好而且绝对物有所值

body: At first it was much thinner and flimsier than the picture showed. But I thought we’d give it a go.  I washed it one time, out of the bag. All the stitching within the body started coming apart after a few months of use. The stitching around the piping on the edges is well done and holding up fine. But it’s a big disappointment overall.
translation:
起初它比图片上显示的要薄得多。但我想我们应该尝试一下。我洗过一次，从袋子里拿出来。使用几个月后，体内的所有缝合线都开始破裂。
边缘滚边周围的缝线做得很好，保持得很好。但总的来说，这是一个很大的失望。

title: My favorite. So soft!
body: Love this. Softest material I’ve ever felt. Bought one because it was on sale but now wished I had bought more.  They are a little expensive regular price (I have king size bed)  but as soon as they go on sale I’ll be buying a couple more.
translation: 喜欢这个。我感觉到的最柔软的材料。买了一个，因为它正在打折，但现在希望我买了更多。 它们的正常价格有点贵（我有特大号床），但一旦它们开始销售，我就会再买几张。

title: THE ABSOLUTE BEST
body: This was my favorite purchase ever! SO soft and so cooling. I'm in love!
translation: 这是我最喜欢的购买！如此柔软，如此凉爽。我恋爱了！

title: Perfect for hot sleepers
body: Great weight and texture, have slept so much better. Perfect for hot sleepers.
translation: 重量和质地都很好，睡得好多了。非常适合热睡眠者。

title: Heavier Than Expected
body: My current comforter is much lighter, but warmer. I'll update as I know more, since it's hard to fairly evaluate in winter when it's already cold.
translation: 我现在的被子轻得多，但更温暖。我会在了解更多后进行更新，因为冬天已经很冷了，很难公平地评估。

title: Amazing
body: This blanket is absolutely amazing. I bought one for my 12 year old daughter because she always sleeps so hot, this amazing blanket keeps her cool all night. The fabric is super soft. I would highly recommend.
translation: 这条毯子绝对令人惊叹。我为我 12 岁的女儿买了一条，因为她总是睡得很热，这条神奇的毯子让她整夜保持凉爽。面料超级柔软。我强烈推荐。

title: Comfort
body: Love the cool feeling very comfortable
translation: 喜欢凉爽的感觉，很舒服

title: Nice blanket
body: This is a nice blanket but i wished for cyber Monday had the king size version on sale. I have a king size bed and this blanket works but comes up a bit short. Other than that its nice
translation: 这是一条不错的毯子，但我希望网络星期一有特大号版本出售。我有一张特大号床，这条毯子可以用，但有点短。除此之外它还不错

title: Does what it says it will do!
body: It wicks away body heat, and it's comfortable,  too! It feels cool, even when the air temp is 80 degrees.  I can finally get a good night's sleep,  even when the wifey  has the thermostat  set at "broil"!
translation:
它可以吸走身体热量，而且也很舒适！
即使气温为80度，也感觉很凉爽。 我终于可以睡个好觉了，即使妻子将恒温器设置为“烤”！

title: The blanket stiches is falling apart
body: I have noticed the stiches is falling as shown on photo. I have been using it for less than 3 months with only one wash prior to using it for first time.  I have tried to call the manufacturer but the phone mailbox is full.  I am disappointed that the item did not last. I am hope the manufacturer will have a solution for this issue since my purchase is pasted returning period.
translation: 我注意到缝线正在脱落，如图所示。我已经使用了不到三个月，第一次使用前只清洗过一次。我尝试给制造商打电话，但电话邮箱已满。我很失望该物品没有持续。我希望制造商能够解决这个问题，因为我的购买已粘贴退货期。

title: Stays cool
body: Stays cool like it says. Would recommend it.
translation: 像它说的那样保持凉爽。会推荐它。

title: Stitching coming out
body: I’ve only had this blanket for 6 weeks and the stitching is already coming out. I haven’t washed it and sleep alone so there should be no reason for this except that it’s cheaply made. So disappointing. Way too expensive of a blanket to be falling apart this soon. I wish things were made to last like they used to be… 😕
translation: 我这条毯子才用了 6 周，缝线已经拆出来了。我还没洗过，还一个人睡过，所以除了它制作便宜之外，应该没有任何理由。太令人失望了。毯子太贵了，这么快就散了。我希望事情能像以前一样持久……😕

title: Love this blanket
body: I love the feel of the material. It keeps you cool but yet warm. I talked my friend into buying one and I bought another when it went on sale. Love this blanket.
translation: 我喜欢这种材料的感觉。它让你保持凉爽，但又温暖。我说服我的朋友买了一个，当它开始销售时，我又买了另一个。喜欢这条毯子。

title: So soft and cooling
body: I bought one of these for myself and then immediately bought one for my daughter once I slept with it. The blanket is so soft and cooling but it doesn’t make you cold at all. It equalizes the temperature but sliding your foot to a “cool spot” in the middle of the night is amazing! Only complaint is that I went to buy two more for family members and price had DOUBLED! It’s expensive but buy one! We fight over who gets this every night. We have to take turns🤣
translation: 我给自己买了一个，然后在我睡觉后立即给我的女儿买了一个。毯子非常柔软和凉爽，但一点也不会让你感到寒冷。它可以平衡温度，但在半夜将脚滑到“凉爽的地方”真是太棒了！唯一的抱怨是我去为家人买了两个，价格翻了一番！它很贵，但买一个！我们每天晚上都在为谁得到这个而争吵。我们必须轮流🤣

title: Great for hot sleepers
body: Without a doubt my best purchase this year!  If you sleep hot, or just like to be cool at night, you need this!  It is cool to the touch and seems to pull heat away from  your body.
translation: 毫无疑问，这是我今年最好的购买！ 如果你睡得很热，或者只是想在晚上凉爽，你需要这个！ 它摸起来很凉爽，似乎可以将热量从您的身体中带走。

title: Super silky soft and always has a cool sensation upon touch.
body: Loved how soft and silky it is, even after washing. I'm literally obsessed with touching it. I first thought it didn't work well, because it actually made me super hot and sweaty (even more than a regular comforter) for a week before I realized I can't use it with the (albeit also "cooling") sheet in between. Just have to use it alone and directly against skin. It always has this cool sensation upon initial contact, despite humid 90+ room temp, that I enjoy. A family member also liked it a lot so bought a 2nd one for them.
translation: 喜欢它的柔软和丝滑，即使在洗涤后也是如此。我真的痴迷于触摸它。我一开始认为它效果不好，因为它实际上让我超级热和出汗（甚至比普通的被子还要多），然后我意识到我不能将它与中间的床单（尽管也是“冷却”）一起使用。只需单独使用并直接用于皮肤即可。初次接触时，它总是有这种凉爽的感觉，尽管潮湿的 90+ 室温，我喜欢。一个家庭成员也非常喜欢它，所以为他们买了第二个。

title: Excellent product
body: Soft and smooth feeling, always feels chill and very spacious. We love it so much we ordered a second one ao me and my wife won't have to share.
translation: 柔软光滑的感觉，总是感觉凉爽，非常宽敞。我们非常喜欢它，我们订购了第二个，我和我的妻子不必分享。

title: If you sleep warm, or run hot this is for you
body: This blanket is amazing.  It keeps me cool all night long.  I have gotten more sleep due to not waking up being hot.  I would highly recommend.
translation: 这条毯子太棒了。 它让我整晚都保持凉爽。 由于没有醒来很热，我睡得更多了。 我强烈推荐。

title: Cool
body: This product does what it says! It feels nice and cool at night. I love it!!! This really helps with nighttime hot flashes. And actually, I’m also cold lol.
translation: 这个产品说到做到！晚上感觉很好，很凉爽。我喜欢！！！这确实有助于治疗夜间潮热。实际上，我也很冷，哈哈。

title: Wow, this really has a cold touch!
body: I bought this for my hot condo in Florida .  The feel is incredible.  Just as advertised.
translation: 我为我在佛罗里达的热门公寓买了这个。 感觉令人难以置信。 正如广告宣传的那样。

title: Only blanket my son will use now!!
body: I ordered this for my son. I had my doubts on how it could really be cooling but when I first opened it, it felt cool to the touch. It seems well made and is soft and comforting. My son said he has never slept better. He actually got a little chilly and had it to take it off. This is the only blanket he uses now. I think I might like to have one now too as I am a hot sleeper.
translation:
我为我儿子订购了这个。
我曾怀疑它如何能够真正冷却，但当我第一次打开它时，摸起来感觉很凉爽。
它看起来做工精良，柔软舒适。
我儿子说他从来没有睡得这么好过。 他实际上有点冷，不得不把它脱下来。 这是他现在唯一使用的毯子。
我想我现在也想拥有一个，因为我睡得很热。

title: Softest blanket ever!
body: The blanket is the softest I’ve ever had the pleasure of sleeping under. The fabric is light and feels cool to your skin yet provides adequate warmth for comfortable sleep. It feels good just running your hands across it and it washes like a dream. I have 2 of them and recently gifted one to a family member. They love it as much as I do.
translation: 毯子是我睡过的最柔软的毯子。面料轻盈，皮肤感觉凉爽，同时提供足够的温暖，让您睡得舒适。只是用手抚摸它感觉很好，它像梦一样洗。我有 2 个，最近送给家人一个。他们和我一样喜欢它。

title: This deserves 10 Stars!
body: I'm 65 and I sleep hot...This blanket is delitefully cool to the touch all year long!  I love it!
translation: 我 65 岁了，睡得很热...这条毯子全年摸起来都非常凉爽！ 我喜欢它！

title: Luxurious
body: I can actually say this is the best blanket I've ever had. The material is absolutely wonderful and each time I touch it the cooling is just so comfortable. In my opinion this is a great blanket.
translation: 我实际上可以说这是我拥有过的最好的毯子。 这种材料绝对很棒，每次我触摸它时，凉爽感都非常舒适。 在我看来，这是一条很棒的毯子。

title: Amazing!!
body: We love it!!
translation: 我们喜欢它！！

title: 100% ok
body: ok
translation: 好的

title: These are So Nice in Summer
body: These are lovely and silky cool.  I was really skeptical because I usually only use percale cotton sheets / pillow cases (I run hot and need cool bedding), but these feel so good in the summer time.  They're silky and cool, I don't slide off of them like one would with satin, and they do seem to breathe.  Really nice.
translation: 这些很可爱，丝般凉爽。 我真的很怀疑，因为我通常只使用密织棉床单/枕套（我很热，需要凉爽的床上用品），但这些在夏天感觉很好。 它们丝滑而凉爽，我不会像缎子那样从它们身上滑下来，而且它们看起来确实会呼吸。 非常好。

title: Nice and cool at last
body: I was very skeptical because i just didn't think anything could help my hot flashes just be bearable and make me a little less miserable. But this blanket has totally exceeded my expectations and I am forever grateful.
translation: 我非常怀疑，因为我认为没有什么可以帮助我忍受潮热，让我不那么痛苦。 但这条毯子完全超出了我的预期，我永远感激不已。

title: Lovely!
body: I was expecting this to just be 'ok' but I've really been surprised so far! I could have gotten a bigger size just to have extra room (I purchased a queen for my queen mattress). It actually feels cool and breathable! I had no issues running it through the washer and dryer either. Overall very nice comforter!
translation: 我原以为这会“还好”，但到目前为止我真的很惊讶！ 我本来可以买一个更大的尺寸，只是为了有额外的空间（我为我的大号床垫购买了一张大号床）。 确实感觉凉爽透气！ 我在洗衣机和烘干机中运行它也没有任何问题。 总的来说非常好的被子！

title: Super soft and cooling
body: Very soft, cool to touch, thin but still heavy and cozy, slightly over-sized too; definitely recommend for hot sleepers
translation: 非常柔软，触感凉爽，薄但仍然厚重舒适，尺寸也稍大； 绝对推荐给热睡者

title: MY FAVORITE PILLOW CASES
body: I AM A SUPER HOT SLEEPER SO ANYTIME I CAN FIND SHEETS, BLANKETS AND/OR PILLOWCASES TO HELP KEEP ME COOLER...I'M ALL ABOUT IT. YES, THESE ARE QUITE PRICY, BUT THEY 100% WORK! THEY ARE SO INCREDIBLY SOFT BUT I HAVE YET TO HAVE A NIGHT WHERE MY FACE, HEAD, NECK GOT HOT WHEN SLEEPING WITH THESE ON MY PILLOWS. I'VE BEEN USING THEM NOW FOR ABOUT 3-4 MONTHS AND THEY ARE STILL WORKING LIKE A CHARM. AGAIN....THEY ARE PRICY BUT OH, SO VERY WORTH IT!
translation: 我是一个超级热的睡眠者，所以我随时都能找到床单、毯子和/或枕套来帮助我保持凉爽……我很乐意。 是的，这些相当昂贵，但它们 100% 有效！ 它们非常柔软，但我还没有经历过一个晚上，当我把它们放在枕头上睡觉时，我的脸、头、脖子会变得很热。 我现在已经使用它们大约 3-4 个月了，它们仍然非常有效。 再次....它们很贵，但是哦，非常值得！

title: Great blanket
body: Best blanket ever. Feels nice and cool to the touch. 🙂
translation: 有史以来最好的毯子。 触感良好且凉爽。  🙂

title: She loved it!!
body: I ordered this for my 20 year old granddaughter who is a very hot sleeper.  She sent me a photo of her bed, and told me that it is the softest thing she has ever felt!  She loves it, and that's saying a lot:)  I just wish they made it in a king size, I would order one for myself!
translation: 我为我 20 岁的孙女订了这个，她睡得很热。 她给我发了一张她的床的照片，并告诉我这是她感受到的最柔软的东西！ 她喜欢它，这说明了很多:)我只是希望他们能做成特大号的，我会为自己订购一个！

title: OMG!
body: This has been a game changer for this peri-menopausal woman. This combined with a fan is heaven!
translation: 对于这位围绝经期女性来说，这改变了游戏规则。 加上风扇简直就是天堂！

title: Fav blanket ever
body: I have hot flashes and this stays so cold. I love it so much.
translation: 我有潮热，而且天气一直很冷。 我太喜欢了。

title: My favorite blanket!
body: I purchased this blanket in June for my boyfriend, and ended up buying myself one a few weeks later! We both love this blanket. It’s like the “cool side of the pillow” in the form of a blanket. It helps keep my body at a comfortable temperature when I sleep, and the material is soft. Easy to wash. I’ve used this blanket for 3 months and have no complaints!
translation: 我六月为我男朋友买了这条毯子，几周后我也给自己买了一条！ 我们都喜欢这条毯子。 它就像毯子形式的“枕头的冷面”。 它有助于在我睡觉时让我的身体保持在舒适的温度，而且材质柔软。 易于清洗。 我已经使用这条毯子 3 个月了，没有任何抱怨！

title: Please make a King size!!
body: When my daughter asked for this blanket for college, I thought she was crazy…then I felt it! I love it! It is somehow so cool, yet has weight to it. My husband and I really wish they made a king size so we could put one on our bed! And the price was right, we got a little discount off the list price. Thank you!
translation: 当我女儿上大学要这条毯子时，我以为她疯了……然后我感觉到了！ 我喜欢它！ 它在某种程度上很酷，但又很有分量。 我和我丈夫真的希望他们能制作一张特大号床，这样我们就可以在床上放一张！ 价格也合适，我们在标价的基础上得到了一点折扣。 谢谢你！

title: Very good
body: This is really really good. Almost identical to the famous brand. I'm glad I snatched two of those for my kids before they got expensive. It won't cool you per se, but it's  cool to the touch and incredibly soft, definitely good for those who have sensory issues. I don't think i will ever go back to 'traditional blankets.
translation: 这真的非常非常好。 与知名品牌几乎一模一样。 我很高兴在它们变得昂贵之前为我的孩子们抢到了其中的两个。 它本身不会让你感到凉爽，但摸起来很凉爽，而且非常柔软，对于那些有感官问题的人来说绝对有好处。 我不认为我会回到“传统的毯子”。

title: Doesn't work
body: Had this worked well for 1 night then it stopped working. Doesn't keep you cool and not breathable
translation: 如果这个方法用了一晚效果很好，然后就停止了。不能让你保持凉爽和不透气

title: its great for menopause and hot flashes
body: i bought it for my sister n law and I haven't heard any complaints. She did say its super soft and loves it.
translation: 我为我的嫂子买的，我没有听到任何抱怨。 她确实说它超级柔软并且喜欢它。

title: For the hot sleepers
body: These pillow cases are great and have permanently replaced all the ones that match whatever sheets I have on my bed. I probably need to get a second set just to simplify laundry. They look fine, in a neutral light grey. But that's not important if you are desperate for a cooler pillow at night. Ladies, you feel me? Hot flashes are miserable and these pillowcases help me cope with the hottest of nights. Good product that delivers some relief and that "cool as the other side of the pillow" feeling on either side.
translation: 这些枕套很棒，并且已经永久取代了所有与我床上的床单相匹配的枕套。 我可能需要买第二套来简化洗衣工作。 它们看起来不错，呈中性浅灰色。 但如果你晚上急需一个凉爽的枕头，那这并不重要。 女士们，你们感受到我了吗？ 潮热令人痛苦，这些枕套帮助我应对最热的夜晚。 好的产品，可以缓解压力，并且两侧都有“像枕头的另一面一样凉爽”的感觉。

title: Very comfortable and cool sleep
body: I live in Arizona and would wake up sweating with my original comforter.  This is much lighter and cooler and has helped me sleep better.
translation: 我住在亚利桑那州，醒来时会发现我原来的被子出汗了。 它更轻、更凉爽，帮助我睡得更好。

title: Keeps cool but slides around
body: This pillow case keeps cool on both sides and washes well! It's stretchy and silky so it's easy to put on and take off of the pillow. It's long so it should fit king size pillows. This case is so silky that it slides around the pillow some, especially during the night when you turn your pillow over to the cool side. It gets twisted and the seam can end up in the middle of the pillow where you lay your head. If you don't mind this, then you should get it. It really can help keep you cool.
translation: 这款枕套两面保持凉爽且耐洗！ 它富有弹性且丝滑，因此可以轻松地穿上和取下枕头。 它很长，所以应该适合特大号枕头。 这款保护套非常丝滑，可以在枕头周围滑动，尤其是在晚上，当您将枕头翻到凉爽的一侧时。 它会扭曲，接缝最终可能会出现在你躺着头的枕头中间。 如果你不介意这个，那么你应该得到它。 它确实可以帮助您保持凉爽。

title: Doesn’t cool
body: This doesn’t keep my body cool whatsoever. Have woken up so many times sweating. Does not do as advertised and cannot recommend purchasing.
translation: 这并不能让我的身体保持凉爽。已经醒了很多次了，满头大汗。与宣传的不符，不建议购买。

title: Amazing cooking blanket
body: Bought this blanket for a trip to AZ this summer.  I was amazingly able to use it each night and didn’t sweat at all.  It is the softest and most incredible material I have ever felt.  Also bought one for my daughter who wears a back brace at night and she gets warm quickly.  Loves this blanket too. I highly recommend this blanket.  It is awesome.
translation: 今年夏天买了这条毯子去亚利桑那州旅行。 令人惊讶的是，我每天晚上都能使用它，而且根本不出汗。 这是我所感受过的最柔软、最令人难以置信的材料。 还给我女儿买了一个，她晚上戴着背带，很快就暖和起来。 这条毯子也很喜欢。 我强烈推荐这条毯子。 太棒了。

title: Very comfy and cold.
body: My husband and I are inlove with this blanket and the good thing we got this on a deal so it was really a great price an affordable. I love how smooth and cold it is and very comfortable, it makes my sleep more quality and peacefully. Would definitely buy again, just waiting for the deal again😍
translation: 我和我丈夫都爱上了这条毯子，而且我们通过交易得到了这条毯子，所以它的价格确实很实惠。 我喜欢它的光滑和冰凉，非常舒适，它让我的睡眠质量更高、更安宁。 肯定会再次购买，只是等待再次优惠😍

title: Greatly enjoyed
body: Really nice pillowcase. Did wish it came with 2 pillowcases. Will look into getting more and in different colors.
translation: 真的很漂亮的枕套。 真希望它有 2 个枕套。 将考虑获得更多不同颜色的产品。

title: Maybe my all-time favorite comforter
body: While fairly plain to look at (and at the time, unavailable in white), this is the silkiest, thin but perfectly weighted, noticably cool blanket I've owned. It stretches a little and is slick, but no lie, this is dreamy on a budget. Compared to the cooling sheets I got, this one wins out when I'm too hot. It was such a great nap-on-top option this summer. Tag says it is machine washable but I haven't tried it. It needed a bit of airing out (only a few hours) to vent out the smell when it first arrived. I was able to use it the same night it arrived.
translation:
虽然看起来相当朴素（当时没有白色），但这是我拥有的最丝滑、最薄但重量完美、非常酷的毯子。它伸展了一点，很光滑，但没有谎言，这在预算上是梦幻般的。与我得到的冷却床单相比，当我太热时，这个冷床单会胜出。今年夏天，这是一个很好的小睡选择。
Tag 说它可以机洗，但我没有尝试过。当它第一次到达时，它需要一点通风（只有几个小时）来排出气味。我能够在它到达的同一天晚上使用它。

title: Best cooling blanket ever!
body: I’m obsessed. Sure, if I heat up at night it’s going to retain heat where my body is, but the blanket is so big & I’m a tosser so -when I awaken- I just move & it’s so coooool. Will definitely buy again if it’s available when I need a new one. Plus it doesn’t pill/shed little fuzzies like all the other awful ‘cooling’ blankets I’ve purchased in the past
translation: 我着迷了。当然，如果我在晚上加热，它会在我的身体所在的地方保持热量，但是毯子太大了，我是一个折腾者，所以当我醒来时，我只是移动，它是如此咕噜咕噜。如果我需要一个新的，一定会再次购买。此外，它不会像我过去购买的所有其他可怕的“冷却”毯子那样起球/脱落小毛绒

title: I love this thing
body: If you have to sleep under a blanket regardless of the temperature like me, or have ever searched for the coolest spot under the sheets: this blanket is for you. Soft, not bulky and slick—wasn’t sure I would love it at first, but after the first night I was hooked. Especially if you’re of an age like when you often feel like you’re cooking at nighttime, this thing is a blessing.
translation: 如果您像我一样无论温度如何都必须盖着毯子睡觉，或者曾经寻找过床单下最凉爽的地方：这条毯子适合您。 柔软、不笨重、光滑——一开始我不确定我会喜欢它，但第一晚之后我就迷上了它。 尤其是如果你处于经常感觉自己在晚上做饭的年纪，这件事就是一件幸事。

title: AMAZING!!
body: Love love loveeeee the cool and silky smooth fabric. You can continually move to find a new cool spot. Blanket is thick enough to hold in some body heat so you can be warm enough while still enjoying the cool feel of the material.
translation: 爱爱爱凉爽丝滑的面料。 您可以不断移动以寻找新的酷点。 毯子足够厚，可以容纳一些体温，这样您就可以保持足够温暖，同时仍然享受材料的凉爽感。

title: Love my little blanket 💕
body: Love this thing,  thin, cooling and it has perfect weight to it. Didn't was it yet so I don't know how it will be after. There was no smell when I open the package so I decide to use is right on.
translation: 喜欢这个东西，薄，凉爽，而且重量完美。 还没有，所以不知道以后会怎样。 打开包装后没有任何气味，所以我决定立即使用。

title: daughter likes it
body: it’s my daughter’s favorite blanket . she washes it once a week so it’s always on her bed
translation: 这是我女儿最喜欢的毯子。 她每周洗一次，所以它总是放在她的床上

title: Cool
body: Feeling cool and comfortable
translation: 感觉清凉舒适

title: Cooling comforter
body: I liked how this blanket feels on my body it’s lightweight, it feels cool to the touch and the material it’s made out of is perfect for skin and it’s perfect for the summer months
translation: 我喜欢这条毯子在我身上的感觉，重量轻，触感凉爽，其材质非常适合皮肤，非常适合夏季使用

title: I don't review often, but when I do...
body: ... when I do, it is for usually really great products or really bad products.  In this case, this product is fantastic! Easily one of the lightest, and softest blankets I've ever used, I am very happy with my purchase and would definitely recommend this comforter to anybody.  It's cooling for a while, but if you wrap it around yourself, you get warmed up real quick!  Really pretty color too!
translation:
...当我这样做时，通常是针对非常好的产品或非常糟糕的产品。

在这种情况下，这个产品太棒了！ 这是我用过的最轻、最柔软的毯子之一，我对我的购买感到非常满意，并且肯定会向任何人推荐这款被子。

虽然会暂时冷却，但如果你把它裹在身上，很快就会暖和起来！

真的颜色也很好看！

title: Softest!!
body: My boyfriend and I are very warm people and we started looking into cooling blankets. The first one we got worked but was super thin and we didn't really like the way the fabric felt. This one is amazing though!! It is always cold and very soft and it is a little heavier so it's a great comforter for the warm weather.
translation: 我和我的男朋友都是非常热情的人，我们开始研究降温毯。 我们得到的第一个作品非常薄，而且我们不太喜欢这种面料的感觉。 不过这个太棒了！！ 它总是很冷，非常柔软，而且有点重，所以它是温暖天气的绝佳被子。

title: Nice blanket, slightly cooling, but not cold
body: I like this blanket because it feels like a proper blanket. Has the puffiness of a comforter but is cooler than one. However, I’ve tried other cooling blankets (that are think like sheets) and those keep me ice cold. This blanket is cool to the touch but warms up easily after a few minutes and I end up kicking it off in the middle of the night. Would recommend this for people who only need a bit of cooling off and prefer a puffy blanket experience.
translation: 我喜欢这条毯子，因为它感觉像一条合适的毯子。具有被子的蓬松感，但比被子凉爽。然而，我尝试过其他冷却毯（就像床单一样），它们让我保持冰冷。这条毯子摸起来很凉，但几分钟后就很容易变暖，最后我在半夜把它踢掉了。会推荐给那些只需要一点凉爽并且喜欢蓬松毯子体验的人。

title: Fantastic
body: Worth every penny, so comfortable
translation: 一分钱一分货，很舒服

title: Soft and cooling, but...
body: This item is really nice to sleep under — it really is soft and cooling during summer nights, but after just two three months of use the stitching has started coming undone all over the comforter. It's a nice product, but just three stars because I'm going to have to either get a new one or live with it looking like it's falling apart.
translation: 这个东西睡起来真的很舒服——夏天的夜晚真的很柔软、很凉爽，但仅仅使用了两三个月后，被子上的缝线就开始脱落了。这是一款不错的产品，但只给了三颗星，因为我要么买一个新的，要么忍受它看起来快要散架了。

title: Thin but heavy if that makes sense
body: Bought this for my son who was getting hot sleeping with a generic Target comforter and wanted to try a "cooling" blanket like this. He saw one on Insta for more than 2x the price and we agreed to try this one instead. He says it's much cooler than a normal poly comforter and very soft and comfortable - he really likes it. The material is hard to identify - the blanket is somehow heavy but not lofty, kind of satin-y to the touch and he says it works to keep him cooler and more comfortable at night. We got the queen size which is just slightly smaller than a normal queen comforter. We'll call it a win.
translation: 给我的儿子买了这个，他用通用的塔吉特被子睡觉很热，想尝试像这样的“凉爽”毯子。 他在 Insta 上看到一款价格超过 2 倍，我们同意尝试这款。 他说它比普通的聚酯纤维被子凉爽得多，而且非常柔软舒适——他真的很喜欢它。 材质很难辨认——毯子有点重，但不高，摸起来有丝缎般的感觉，他说这能让他在晚上保持凉爽和舒适。 我们买的是大号床被子，比普通大号被子略小。 我们称之为胜利。

title: Does feel cool
body: This works great as long as it is against your body. You can’t put a sheet under it. Also is slides off bed constantly. Not really impressed with it.
translation: 只要它不利于你的身体，这个方法就很有效。你不能在它下面放一张床单。还不断地从床上滑下来。对此并没有留下深刻的印象。

title: Cooling
body: Love this blanket. It does have a cooling effect, as described. Wish it came in more colors.
translation: 喜欢这条毯子。 正如所描述的，它确实具有冷却效果。 希望它有更多颜色。

title: You will love this comforter.
body: Comforter really does keep you cool on a warm summer night.
translation: 被子确实能让您在温暖的夏夜保持凉爽。

title: Bought these on Prime day
body: Not happy! The blanket is soft and does have a cool touch but BEWARE that you might not notice until it’s too late that the blanket has splotches on it. Don’t know if it was a previous return or not. Too late now to return
translation: 不高兴！毯子很柔软，触感凉爽，但请注意，您可能不会注意到毯子上有斑点，但为时已晚。不知道是不是以前的回归。现在回来太晚了

title: Love it
body: Very comfortable and keeps me cool.
translation: 非常舒适，让我保持凉爽。

title: The stitching needs help
body: The material is good and does the job but the stitching got undone.
translation: 材质很好，做工也不错，但是缝合线松了。

title: Is what it says
body: Works great  Works as advertised
translation:
效果很好

广告宣传的优秀作品

title: Love!!!
body: I Love my blanket! I get very hot at night and it kept me cool. It was the perfect size and I love the way it looks. I’m very happy with it!
translation: 我爱我的毯子！我晚上很热，这让我保持凉爽。它的尺寸很完美，我喜欢它的外观。我对此非常满意！

title: So effective for hot sleepers
body: Loved this. So soft and helps me sleep. Wonderful for hot nights.
translation: 喜欢这个。太软了，帮助我入睡。非常适合炎热的夜晚。

title: Fabric is nice, but the stitching is AWFUL!! Gets caught in your toes! >: {
body: The fabric does keep you cool, I will give it that. BUT it's completely useless if the stitching holding it together comes apart and is cutting your toes off in the middle of the night... Pretty disappointed for the amount of money spent on this.
translation: 这种面料确实能让你保持凉爽，我会这么做的。但如果将其固定在一起的缝线分开并在半夜割断你的脚趾，那么它就完全没有用了……对花在这上面的钱感到非常失望。

title: Worth the Purchase
body: This bedding does exactly as advertised which is provide cool covering which is great for use during summer months or if you’re hot-natured. Very comfortable. Worth the purchase.
translation: 这款床上用品与广告宣传的完全一样，提供凉爽的覆盖物，非常适合在夏季使用，或者如果您性情炎热。很舒服。值得购买。

title: Cooling Pillow Case
body: Decent set of cooling pillow cases.  They're soft but they don't stay cool for long and it does take a little for them to regain the cool feeling.  Nice set for the price and everything helps during the summer months.
translation: 一套不错的冷却枕套。 它们很柔软，但不能长时间保持凉爽，并且需要一点时间才能恢复凉爽的感觉。 价格不错，而且在夏季的几个月里一切都很有帮助。

title: I was skeptical -- but it works!
body: Summers are pretty rough for me, living in the South as we do. I need a bit of weight on me when I sleep -- not so much as a weighted blanket, but definitely more than a sheet -- or I don't sleep well. I was incredibly skeptical of the idea of a cooling blanket, but I figured I'd give this a try.  I have been able to sleep under it all summer long, even in our current stretch of being in the middle of well over a week of excessive heat warnings!  (Yes, we have A/C, but it doesn't keep up well in the height of summer, nor is it financially efficient.)  I was concerned about keeping it clean, since it works best when there's no sheet between me and the blanket. But, I haven't had any trouble tossing it in the wash on a regular basis. It seems to wash well and hold up to regular washings.  It works with any type of bottom sheet, but it seems most effective when paired with a cooling sheet.  The biggest issue I have is the stiching for the quilting. It's a very loose stitching and it pulls and rips very, very easily. I don't think there's a single complete seam at this point. At some point I may try to stitch over it, but so far it hasn't seemed to impact the structure of the blanket badly.  But, being able to sleep under a blanket all summer is worth a few quilt seam tears!
translation:
夏天对我来说挺难熬的，因为我们住在南方。我睡觉时需要一点重量——不是加重毯，但肯定比床单多——否则我睡不好。我对降温毯的想法非常怀疑，但我想试试看。整个

夏天我都能在它下面睡觉，即使我们现在正处于一周多的高温警告期！ （是的，我们有空调，但盛夏时节空调不太稳定，经济效率也不高。）

我担心保持清洁，因为当我和毯子之间没有床单时效果最好。不过，我经常把它扔进洗衣机洗涤时没有遇到任何问题。它洗得很好，也能承受常规洗涤。它

适用于任何类型的底板，但似乎最有效的是搭配冷却板。

我最大的问题是缝被的缝合。缝线非常松散，很容易拉扯和撕裂。我觉得现在没有一条完整的缝隙。以后我可能会尝试缝补，但到目前为止，这似乎并没有严重影响毯子的结构。

不过，能整个夏天都盖着被子睡觉，总值得为几次被子缝线撕裂！

title: So silky
body: Feels like butter, I got it for my daughter and then tried to order again in a king but they didn’t have it. Love the material
translation: 感觉像黄油，我为我的女儿买了它，然后试图再次订购国王，但他们没有。喜欢这种材料

title: Love
body: I love the feel of this blanket, silky texture. I was surprised that it has kept me cool. I ordered the blue and I'm very happy. I would buy again.
translation:
我喜欢这种毯子的感觉，丝滑的质地。
我很惊讶它让我保持冷静。
我订购了蓝色，我很高兴。
我会再次购买。

title: Great blanket
body: A Great blanket really cools and lowers the body temperature by several degrees. Great and fun fabric. Suitable for this year's terrible summer.
translation: 一条大毯子真的可以冷却并将体温降低几度。很棒，很有趣的面料。适合今年可怕的夏天。

title: Thin but cooling
body: With the hot months approaching, I’ve been obsessed with collecting cooling blankets and activewear. I found these cooling pillow cases and just had to try them! They’re made of similar heat-wicking material as many cooling blankets are made from and act in the same way. The only change I’d make for these is to make it a zipper closure instead of a folding one so that my pillows stay in them when I toss and turn through the night. Overall though I’m very happy with these!
translation: 随着炎热月份的临近，我一直痴迷于收集降温毯和运动服。 我发现了这些凉爽的枕套，不得不尝试一下！ 它们由类似的吸热材料制成，就像许多冷却毯的制造材料和作用方式相同。 我对它们所做的唯一改变就是把它改成拉链式而不是折叠式，这样当我整夜翻来覆去时我的枕头就可以留在里面。 总的来说，我对这些非常满意！

title: Perfect cooling blanket!!
body: We used a down comforter but it was always to hot for me which affected my sleep. So I ordered this and have had it now for several nights and couldn’t be happier! It’s material is soft as described and it keeps you cool without allowing you to get cold. I would buy again!
translation: 我们使用了羽绒被，但对我来说总是很热，影响了我的睡眠。 所以我点了这个，现在已经吃了好几个晚上了，高兴极了！ 它的材质如描述的那样柔软，让您保持凉爽而不会让您着凉。 我会再次购买！

title: Great duper, stays chilly cool!
body: Got this for my hubby bc he runs hot while sleeping…totally does the trick and we’re both happy! Stays nice and cool, almost feels wet it’s so cold, but he loves it. Great price point compared to some of the name brand ones.
translation: 给我丈夫买了这个，因为他睡觉时会发热……完全成功了，我们都很高兴！ 保持凉爽，几乎感觉湿漉漉的，太冷了，但他喜欢这样。 与一些名牌产品相比，价格非常优惠。

title: SUper soft and cool
body: This blanket is the most soft  blanket ive ever owned. i will however so that with the silkiness of it it does slide off the bed a lot and does not really seem as big as a normal queen size blanket. how ever this is still an amazing blanket and i would 100% buy again
translation: 这条毯子是我拥有过的最柔软的毯子。 不过，我会这样，因为它的丝滑度确实会从床上滑落很多，而且看起来并不像普通的大号毯子那么大。 不管怎样，这仍然是一条很棒的毯子，我 100% 会再次购买

title: No More Hot Nights
body: I have been a HOT sleeper for the last 10 years, but not any more.  I bought this a month ago and I can't imagine life without it now.  The blanket has the perfect weight, light with just enough weight to give you that comforting feeling. The material is so soft and yes it really does keep you cool. If you get a bit warm, just move your leg, arm or whatever and feel that awesome coolness again and again. 10 out of 10 would buy this again.
translation: 在过去的 10 年里，我一直是一个热睡眠者，但现在不再是了。 我一个月前买了这个，我无法想象现在没有它的生活。 毯子具有完美的重量，重量轻巧，重量刚好足以给您带来舒适的感觉。这种材料非常柔软，是的，它确实让你保持凉爽。如果你有点热，只需移动你的腿、手臂或其他任何东西，一次又一次地感受那种令人敬畏的凉爽。10 人中有 10 人会再次购买。

title: Use every night!
body: I got this case, immediately washed it and put on my pillow. I have not taken off besides for washing since! I love it, it does keep your head and neck cool all night and feel so soft on your skin as well. I would absolutely recommend this product!
translation: 我收到这个箱子后，立即将其清洗并放在枕头上。 从那以后我除了洗衣服就没脱下来过！ 我喜欢它，它确实让您的头部和颈部整夜保持凉爽，而且皮肤也感觉如此柔软。 我绝对会推荐这个产品！

title: Comfortable
body: I love this blanket. It has a cooling effect which comes in handy during the hot humid season
translation: 我喜欢这条毯子。它具有降温效果，在炎热潮湿的季节派上用场

title: Great purchase
body: Super soft, actually cools you down and got it for a great price on sale!!!
translation: 超级柔软，实际上可以让你冷静下来，并以优惠的价格出售!!

title: Cool comforter
body: Very nice texture/feel and definitely works to keep you cooler than most comforters. Great purchase.
translation: 非常好的质地/感觉，绝对可以让你比大多数被子更凉爽。很棒的购买。

title: It actually cools
body: This is the one blanket I’ve found that has a serious and sustained cooling effect. Excellent value too.
translation: 这是我发现的一条毯子，具有严重而持续的冷却效果。物超所值。

title: VERY HAPPY! HIGHLY RECOMMEND!
body: Been using for over a week now.  Lightweight, very soft, adequate size (purchased queen size for our queen bed) and very cool.  Best cooling results when you eliminate your top sheet (because it is so soft, you won't miss the top sheet).  It will get warm from your body heat but that quickly dissipates if you let the underneath get some air....just lift it up, shake lightly and fall back to sleep.  I only have to do that once a night.  My husband and I are both hot sleepers and I suffer from night sweats.  I also bought the $240 competitors brand (which I returned due to poor quality) and the Cozy Bliss is just as cooling and soft.  My husband loves it too.
translation:
到现在已经使用一个多星期了。
重量轻，非常柔软，尺寸合适（为我们的大床购买了大号床）并且非常酷。 当您消除顶片时，可获得最佳冷却效果（因为它非常柔软，您不会错过顶片）。 它会因你的体温而变热，但如果你让下面得到一些空气，它很快就会消散......只需将它举起，轻轻摇晃，然后重新入睡。 我只需每晚做一次。 我和我丈夫都是热睡者，我经常盗汗。 我还买了 240 美元的竞争对手品牌（由于质量差我退货了），Cosy Bliss 也同样凉爽和柔软。 我丈夫也喜欢它。

title: soft and cool
body: It’s very soft and keeps cool at night.  Resistant to pet hair is a great bonus. Great comforter for the summer, highly recommend!
translation: 它非常柔软，晚上保持凉爽。 耐宠物毛发是一个很大的好处。 非常适合夏天的被子，强烈推荐！

title: Best ever!
body: I got this as a gift for my bf and it is hands down the perfect comforter for summer time. It is silky soft, light weight, comforting and gives a perfect cooling effect. I might buy a second one. I am completely sold on the cooling blanket technology! Highly recommended for anyone who gets overheated but still wants the sensory comfort of a blanket. It also helps me with sensory overstimulation.
translation: 我把它作为礼物送给我的男朋友，它是夏天的完美被子。它如丝般柔软，重量轻，舒适，并具有完美的冷却效果。我可能会买第二个。我完全被冷却毯技术所吸引！强烈推荐给任何过热但仍想要毯子感官舒适的人。它还可以帮助我应对感官过度刺激。

title: Cool & Comfy
body: I was skeptical about buying this comforter but after reading reviews here decided to try it. I am so glad I did. I sleep hot and tend to wake up sweating at times. Since using this comforter I no longer have that problem. The comforter keeps me feeling warm but not too much and the fabric is very soft and a perfect weight for all of the year. It looks very elegant on the bed too. Hopefully it will wash well when it is time for that. Great item indeed.
translation: 我对购买这款被子持怀疑态度，但在阅读了这里的评论后决定尝试一下。我很高兴我做到了。我睡得很热，有时会出汗。自从使用这个被子后，我不再有这个问题了。被子让我感觉温暖，但不会太多，面料非常柔软，适合全年。在床上看起来也很优雅。希望到时候它会洗得很好。确实很棒。

title: Cooling and soft
body: Just received it. Very cooling and extremely soft so far! I have other cooling blankets that are heavy and don't cool as well.
translation: 刚刚收到。 到目前为止非常凉爽且非常柔软！ 我还有其他的降温毯，它们很重，而且也不凉爽。

title: The Eternal Search for the Perfect Comforter
body: My dream is to have a high loft comforter where I don’t overheat. I don’t know that I will ever find such a thing, but this one adequately handles the cooling part. It’s very thin and probably does have more weight than you would think but I still use a weighted blanket on top of it. My boyfriends first reaction to feeling it was “That’s basically just a sheet.” He started the night having a down alternative comforter on top of this over himself, but kicked it off during the night. The moral of that story is that, while you may not think so, it does provide just enough weight and warmth to use as a comforter while still not overheating. I still haven’t decided if I’m going to try the Evercool as well to see if it has a little bit more weight but this one is substantially cooling and comfortable to the point where I can recommend it for hot sleepers.
translation: 我的梦想是拥有一条高架的被子，不会过热。我不知道以后能不能找到这样的东西，但这款已经足够处理散热部分了。它很薄，可能比你想象的更有重量，但我还是会在上面加重毯子。我男朋友第一次摸到那种感觉时，反应是“这基本上就是一块床单。”他一开始在自己身上还盖了一条羽绒替代被，但后来在夜里开始了。这个故事的寓意是，虽然你可能不这么认为，但它确实提供了足够的重量和保暖，可以当被子用，同时又不会过热。我还没决定是否也试试Evercool，看看它是否更重，但这款凉爽且舒适，足以推荐给热睡者。

title: Sorcery
body: Not sure what sorcery this is but the blanket really is cool! I'm cold natured so it's too cold for me but it's perfect for my hot natured husband. I was worried it wouldn't be cold after being washed but there was no issues. Best investment ever, especially in the blazing summer heat.
translation: 不知道这是什么魔法，但毯子真的很酷！ 我性子冷，所以对我来说太冷了，但对我性情热的丈夫来说却很完美。 我担心洗完后会不会冷，但没有问题。 有史以来最好的投资，尤其是在炎热的夏季。

title: Very very soft
body: Love the softness! Perfect for summer.
translation: 喜欢温柔！ 非常适合夏天。

title: Love this comforter
body: I love this Cozy Bliss cooling comforter. I have had it for a few months and can definitely attest to the fact that it keeps you cool. Even if you just touch it you can tell how cool it feels. It is also silky soft to the touch and not too heavy. I use this comforter on top of my other one because I like it that much.
translation: 我喜欢这款 Cozy Bliss 降温被。我已经用了几个月了，可以肯定地证明它能让你保持凉爽。即使你只是触摸它，你也能看出它的感觉有多酷。它触感也如丝般柔软，不会太重。我把这个被子放在我的另一条被子上，因为我非常喜欢它。

title: Must have
body: This blanket is exactly what I needed to get by in this summer heat. Must buy this!
translation: 这条毯子正是我在这个炎热的夏天所需要的。一定要买这个！

title: How is something so cold so cozy?!
body: Cozy is a very good word for this blanket. It's also very cooling. If I have my fan on, sometimes it gets TOO cold! But I absolutely love it. Pair it with cooling sheets and pillowcases!
translation: 舒适是这条毯子的一个非常好的词。它也非常凉爽。如果我开着风扇，有时它会变得太冷！但我绝对喜欢它。搭配凉爽的床单和枕套！

title: Wish there were matching sheets
body: I received my blanket and have been using it for a day or two already. This has greatly helped in keeping me cool while my HVAC has been out. I can't sleep well without some type of cover, so I was either too hot before or couldn't sleep due to no covers. However, since I haven't been able to find good cooling sheets it hinders the effectiveness of the comforter. Which means that I won't be able to use the sheet and will need to wash the comforter more often.
translation: 我收到了毯子，已经使用了一两天了。 当我的暖通空调坏了时，这对我保持凉爽有很大帮助。 如果没有某种被子，我就睡不好，所以我要么之前太热，要么因为没有被子而无法入睡。 然而，由于我无法找到好的冷却床单，这阻碍了被子的有效性。 这意味着我将无法使用床单，并且需要更频繁地清洗被子。

title: Best Comforter Ever
body: This comforter checks ALL the boxes! It is truly the first cooling bedding that I’ve found to really work. It’s is SO soft! It’s easy to wash. I’m actually sleeping without waking up soaked in sweat. I’m in love! I want more color options! I’d buy more for sure!
translation: 这款被子符合所有要求！这确实是我发现的第一个真正有效的冷却床上用品。它是如此柔软！它很容易清洗。实际上，我没有醒来就被汗水浸透了。我恋爱了！我想要更多的颜色选择！我肯定会买更多！

title: Softest blanket I've ever used! Kept me cool.
body: I tend to sweat when sleeping at night and was searching for a blanket to keep me cool rather than sleeping with a fan on all night. The first thing I noticed about this blanket is how soft it is. It's thin but gives the right amount of coverage and blanket feel. It kept me cool all night. I haven't sweated since using this blanket.
translation: 我晚上睡觉时容易出汗，所以我想找一条毯子来保持凉爽，而不是整夜开着风扇睡觉。 我注意到这条毯子的第一件事就是它有多柔软。 它很薄，但具有适当的覆盖范围和毯子感。 它让我整个晚上都保持凉爽。 自从用了这条毯子我就没出过汗了。

title: Cold
body: So cold! Really works so happy with this item !
translation: 太冷了！真的对这个项目很满意！

title: Soft and cool feeling light-med weight blanket perfect for the summer heat
body: Hot summer nights in California are an issue when air conditioning costs an arm and a leg. Unfortunately, I am one of those people that need a blanket on me no matter how hot it is. In the heat (no pun intended) of the moment, I bought one of those cooling blankets in the couple hundred dollar range, but canceled it right away cause that money was going to my air conditioning. I started browsing for cheaper options and found this on sale for $40. I felt more comfortable losing out on $40 if it didn't work out. Upon opening the package, the silky cool material felt so nice to touch. Use at night is great as well, and I found it still comfortably on me after I wake up in the morning versus the other times I tend to throw my other blanket haphazardly around at night to get comfortable. The blanket itself is on the thinner side compared to my other blankets, but had some weight to it for its size. I am currently writing this review with the blanket around me in the middle of the morning with a temperature of 80s and the blanket is making this heat bearable and I feel so comfy right now! I personally like this silky material for bed linen, so I am really happy with this purchase.
translation: 在加利福尼亚州炎热的夏夜是一个问题，因为空调的成本很高。 不幸的是，我是那些无论多热都需要盖毯子的人之一。 在炎热的时刻（没有双关语的意思），我买了一条几百美元的冷却毯，但立即取消了它，因为钱都花在了我的空调上。 我开始寻找更便宜的选择，发现它的售价为 40 美元。 如果没有成功，我会更愿意损失 40 美元。 打开包装后，丝滑的材质触感非常好。 晚上使用也很棒，我发现早上醒来后它仍然很舒服，而其他时候我往往会在晚上随意地扔掉另一条毯子以保持舒适。 与我的其他毯子相比，毯子本身较薄，但就其尺寸而言有一定的重量。 我正在写这篇评论，早上的温度是 80 多度，毯子围着我，毯子让这种热度变得可以忍受，我现在感觉很舒服！ 我个人很喜欢这种丝质材质的床单，所以我对这次购买感到非常满意。

title: Does not cool at all.
body: It feels warm. Like most reviewers who gave their honest opinion, it feels silky and that’s all you get. I don’t recommend this oh you are looking to get the cooling effect. It just does not work.
translation: 感觉很温暖。就像大多数给出诚实意见的评论家一样，它感觉很柔滑，这就是你得到的一切。我不推荐这个哦，因为你想要获得冷却效果。它就是行不通。

title: Soft, Cozy & Cool
body: This blanket is AMAZING! I was not expecting to be so impressed because I’m really picky about blankets and textures. I sleep really hot, but I can’t sleep without a blanket, this is the best of both worlds. It’s lightweight, and almost silky, but still has some weight, just enough to feel cozy. I want 12.  Also as an additional positive, I got a paper cut almost immediately after opening the blanket, and was able to completely remove the spot by dabbing it with water.
translation:
这条毯子太棒了！我没想到会给我留下如此深刻的印象，因为我对毯子和质地真的很挑剔。我睡得很热，但没有毯子我就睡不着，这是两全其美的。它很轻，几乎是丝滑的，但仍然有一定的重量，足以让人感到舒适。我想要 12 个。

另外，作为额外的积极因素，我几乎在打开毯子后立即剪了一张纸，并且能够通过用水轻拍它来完全去除斑点。

title: So soft and so cool!
body: We love this blanket! It keeps us warm AND cool and is so soft and comfortable. Easy to wash and dry. We want to buy one for everyone we love.
translation: 我们喜欢这条毯子！它让我们保持温暖和凉爽，非常柔软和舒适。易于清洗和干燥。我们想为我们所爱的每个人买一个。

title: Soft and silky
body: The blanket is lightweight, soft and silky in texture. Very nice!
translation: 毯子质地轻盈、柔软、丝滑。很好！

title: wonderful
body: Best cooling comforter ever! Soft, thin yet heavy and definitely keeps you cool!
translation: 有史以来最好的凉爽被子！柔软、轻薄而厚重，绝对能让你保持凉爽！

title: Light weight
body: I like the light weight and how soft but it does not cool you like it says.
translation: 我喜欢它的重量轻和柔软，但它并不像它说的那样让你凉爽。

title: Cools!!!!
body: This blanket is amazing!!!  I’ve been so hot and sweating every night, but not anymore after laying on this blanket & using it on top!  Wish this company made sheets but I improvised!
translation: 这条毯子太棒了！！！ 我每天晚上都很热出汗，但铺上这条毯子并在上面使用后就不再这样了！ 希望这家公司制作床单，但我即兴创作！

title: Love this blanket!!!
body: This is absolutely a wonderful blanket. So soft & cool to the touch! Like sleeping under a cloud. It is so good, I had to get the smaller size as a throw for the sofa! I highly  recommend it!
translation: 这绝对是一条美妙的毯子。如此柔软和凉爽的触感！就像睡在云下一样。太好了，我不得不买更小的尺寸作为沙发的毯子！我强烈推荐它！

title: soft and cozy cooling pillowcase
body: I loved how soft the pillowcases felt and they washed up well.  I thought they helped keep me cooler at night time.  They are big enough for a queen pillow and would probably fit a king pillow as well.  I would buy again.
translation: 我喜欢枕套的柔软触感，而且很好洗。 我认为它们可以帮助我在夜间保持凉爽。 它们足够大，可以容纳大号枕头，也可能适合特大号枕头。 我会再次购买。

title: Need a cool house
body: I feel like this product is misleading. I bought it thinking it would be a cooling blanket but it only cools you down if your house is cool. My house is quite warm, I don’t have AC or central air and the blanket is not cool to the touch and does not help me stay cool when I sleep. Very dissatisfied
translation: 我觉得这个产品有误导性。我买了它，以为它会是一个降温毯，但只有当你的房子凉爽时它才会给你降温。我的房子很温暖，没有空调或中央空调，毯子摸起来不凉，不能帮助我在睡觉时保持凉爽。非常不满意

title: Love it!
body: Bought these on Prime Day for friends and they love them!
translation: 在 Prime Day 为朋友买了这些，他们很喜欢！

title: The material
body: Softest and coolest blanket.
translation: 最柔软、最凉爽的毯子。

title: Love it!
body: Love this!
translation: 喜欢这个！

title: Best blanket ever!
body: In Florida heat and with hot flashes every night I was tossing and turning and sweating no matter how low the AC was. Read the reviews and decided to order this and my hubby and I loved it! Neither of us even had to kick a foot out during the night. Bought the 90 x 90 for our Queen bed and it’s perfect. Used it without a top sheet. Highly recommend it and I’m never going back to a regular comforter again. Stayed cool all night.
translation: 在佛罗里达州的炎热天气和每晚潮热的天气下，无论空调温度有多低，我都会翻来覆去，出汗。 阅读评论并决定订购这个，我和我的丈夫很喜欢它！ 晚上我们俩甚至都不需要踢出一只脚。 为我们的大床买了 90 x 90，非常完美。 使用时无需顶纸。 强烈推荐它，我再也不会使用普通的被子了。 整个晚上都保持凉爽。

title: Love it!
body: The Cozy Bliss Cooling Pillow Case has been a game-changer for hot sleepers like me. The Q-Max 0.4 double-sided cooling technology keeps me cool and comfortable throughout the night. The envelope closure ensures a secure fit and prevents the pillow from slipping out. The breathable and soft fabric adds to the overall comfort, and the grey color complements any bedroom decor. It's a must-have pillowcase for those seeking relief from night sweats and hot flashes.
translation: 对于像我这样热睡的人来说，Cozy Bliss 降温枕套改变了游戏规则。  Q-Max 0.4 双面散热技术让我整夜保持凉爽舒适。 信封封口确保枕头牢固贴合并防止枕头滑出。 透气柔软的面料增加了整体舒适度，灰色与任何卧室装饰相得益彰。 对于那些寻求缓解盗汗和潮热的人来说，这是一款必备枕套。

title: Dream come true
body: So soft and cool. It’s a dream come true. I need to sleep with a blanket but I get hot and this was a good solution for that.
translation: 如此柔软和凉爽。 这是梦想成真。 我需要盖着毯子睡觉，但我很热，这是一个很好的解决方案。

title: Amazing
body: Best blanket I’ve ever bought
translation: 我买过的最好的毯子

title: Too hot for me
body: I'm in menopause and need something to stay cool when I'm sleeping. These pillowcases were hot to me. I bought queen size and they are too big for my king size pillow and doesn't stay on. Cotton is the best to stay cool.
translation: 我正处于更年期，需要一些东西在睡觉时保持凉爽。 这些枕套对我来说很热。 我买了大号枕头，但对于我的特大号枕头来说太大了，而且不能留在上面。 棉花是保持凉爽的最佳选择。

title: Works great to cool
body: I have bought various of these. This works great. Cool all night. Also feels like a light weighted blanket.
translation: 我买过各种这样的东西。 这很好用。 整个晚上都很凉爽。 感觉就像一条轻质毯子。

title: Quite simply - I felt no "cooling" effect.
body: I genuinely hoped to love this item! Sadly, this blanket feels nothing like advertised. After testing it myself for a few hot nights - I was very much disappointed and felt no cooling effect at all.
