I read many reviews before purchasing this blanket and was hoping to love it myself, seeing how others reported they could literally feel the difference from other similar blankets without this unique fabric technology. I felt hot under this blanket during the night and had to switch back to my old blanket during my tests.  It sure does have a nice feeling to it, comfy material and nice packaging. Yet I can spare only two stars for my review since I had hoped for a much more tangible cooling effect, and as previously stated - felt nothing at all.
translation:
我真诚地希望喜欢这个项目！可悲的是，这条毯子感觉一点也不像广告上说的那样。在我自己测试了几个炎热的夜晚之后 - 我非常失望，完全没有感觉到任何冷却效果。在购买这条毯子之前，我读了很多评论，并希望自己能喜欢它，看看其他人如何报告说，如果没有这种独特的面料技术，他们就能真正感受到与其他类似毯子的区别。晚上我在这条毯子下感到很热，在测试期间不得不换回我的旧毯子。

它确实给人一种很好的感觉，舒适的材料和漂亮的包装。然而，我只能为我的评论留下两颗星，因为我本来希望有更明显的冷却效果，并且如前所述 - 根本没有任何感觉。

title: Great but did not send the right color.
body: So soft but wish the correct color was sent.
translation: 很柔软，但希望发送正确的颜色。

title: Very cooling and breathable for hot sleepers
body: I love this comforter! I was in between getting a cooling blanket or comforter and so glad I got this! I will say that on Amazon the material is labeled as "silk" and on the tag it says polyester and nylon. This disappointed me because that's the only reason I paid so much. However, it's super cooling! If you get hot just move to a different spot or flip it and it's super cool! especially with a fan. My body turns to a heater at night and this thing works wonders if you're used to waking up sweaty! My bf loves it too! it's super smooth and silky. My cat loves it too lol.
translation: 我喜欢这个被子！ 我正在买一条凉爽的毯子或被子，很高兴我得到了这个！ 我想说的是，在亚马逊上，这种材料被标记为“丝绸”，标签上写着聚酯和尼龙。 这让我很失望，因为这是我付出这么多的唯一原因。 不过，真的超级凉快！ 如果你感觉很热，只需移到另一个地方或翻转它，那就太酷了！ 尤其是有风扇的时候。 我的身体在晚上变成了一个加热器，如果你习惯于出汗醒来，这个东西会产生奇迹！ 我的男朋友也喜欢它！ 它超级光滑、丝滑。 我的猫也很喜欢哈哈。

title: This one does keep you cool
body: Happy to report that this product is as advertised-- it keeps me cool all night.
translation: 很高兴地向您报告，该产品正如广告所宣传的那样——它让我整夜保持凉爽。

title: cooling!
body: this is so cold throughout the night! i live in arizona and it’s 110 degrees out so this really helps through the night
translation: 整个晚上都这么冷！ 我住在亚利桑那州，气温为 110 度，所以这对过夜很有帮助

title: It keeps us cooling and helps with my hot flashes.
body: After looking for a cooling blanket and reading how is made here in Amazon I decided for this .I highly recommended to anyone that will love to sleep with a soft and well made blanket  that feel so soft .The packing was beautiful done like a present. I bought another one for one of our sons and wife.I highly recommend this company.It’s so cool and pretty..the best.
translation: 在寻找了一条凉爽的毯子并阅读了亚马逊的制作方法后，我决定买这个。我强烈推荐给那些喜欢用柔软、做工精良、感觉如此柔软的毯子睡觉的人。包装非常漂亮，就像礼物一样。 我为我们的一个儿子和妻子买了另一件。我强烈推荐这家公司。它是如此酷和漂亮......最好的。

title: Why does the material spot? Washed once in cold water and it faded in spots.
body: Love, love, love this blanket.  I do not like that after one wash in cold, delicate cycle, baby detergent it faded in spots.
translation: 爱，爱，爱这条毯子。 我不喜欢用冷洗、细腻的洗涤剂洗一次，婴儿洗衣液在某些地方就褪色了。

title: LOVE IT!!!!
body: I was skeptical, but purchased after reading some of the reviews. It is an amazing comforter! It helps when I have a hot flashes. It’s so silky and cool to the touch. I’ve been sleeping better since. You really need to get it!
translation: 我对此表示怀疑，但在阅读了一些评论后购买了。 这是一个很棒的被子！ 当我潮热时它会有所帮助。 触感如丝般凉爽。 从那以后我睡得更好了。 你真的需要得到它！

title: hot flash approved
body: I'm 45 and menopausal. Que the hot flashes. I will always want cooling everything. Cooling sheets, pillow cases, etc. It's an absolute necessity at this point in life, especially when you live in the south. The quality/stitching of this is excellent. It washes well, and stays cool.
translation: 我今年 45 岁，已绝经。 却潮热。 我总是想冷却一切。 凉爽的床单、枕套等。在这个阶段，这是绝对必需的，尤其是当你住在南方时。 这件衣服的质量/缝线非常好。 它很好洗，而且保持凉爽。

title: They Get the Job Done!
body: These pillowcases are fabulous. They are cool to the touch and keep me from head-sweating at night. They are soft, lightweight and wash up well. Game changer!
translation: 这些枕套棒极了。 它们摸起来很凉爽，让我晚上不会出汗。 它们柔软、轻便且易于清洗。 游戏规则改变者！

title: Only stay cool for a couple minutes
body: Even though these cases only stay cool to the touch for a very brief moment, you can fill your pillow or move your head slightly to get a fresh cool spot. The cases feel slick, smooth and are comfortable. They seem well made. Overall they are nice. I have many "cool fiber" cases and throws and these are good quality. These are the only pillowcases in cool fiber which are tradional sleeve style. All the other ones I have are zippered. I imagine most are zippered because this type of fabric is quite silky and slides/moves easily.
translation: 尽管这些保护套只能在很短的时间内保持凉爽的触感，但您可以填充枕头或稍微移动头部以获得新鲜的凉爽位置。 表壳摸起来光滑、光滑且舒适。 它们看起来做工精良。 总的来说，他们都很好。 我有很多“酷纤维”箱子和休闲毯，质量很好。 这是唯一采用传统袖子风格的凉爽纤维枕套。 我所有其他的都是拉链的。 我想大多数都是带拉链的，因为这种面料非常丝滑并且很容易滑动/移动。

title: It works and is worth the money!
body: This has saved us in these hot summer nights!
translation: 这在炎热的夏夜拯救了我们！

title: Really comfy
body: I bought this for my husband who always feel warm in bed. He tried this one the first night and he loves it. The cover is cool to touch. My dog jumped on it and didn’t want to come down. Now I’m going to buy one for myself.
translation: 我给我丈夫买了这个，他在床上总是感觉温暖。 他第一天晚上就尝试了这个，他很喜欢。 盖子摸起来很凉爽。 我的狗跳到上面不想下来。 现在我要给自己买一个。

title: coooool
body: as a soundtrack to this review, i recommend that you queue your fave song by coolio. it's just that kinda old school goodness. old school new school. so it's no secret that there have been fabrics developed to retain or reflect heat especially for athletic purposes. i previously reviewed a fitted sheet by this brand with the same material and was thrilled to find that, despite not being in menopause, the super smooth super cool non-heat-retaining nature of the lilac purple sheet was the perfect thing for me in intermediate new england trying-to-be-summer-but-just-persistently-muggy weather which is prone to potentially waking up sweaty; no one wants that. super cool solution! so of course after reviewing that sheet, i was very interested in getting a couple super cool pillow cases. as expected, they're the same material. they're super cool and super soft. they wash well and tolerate the dryer, like the sheet. and they're perfect for warmer or otherwise mega humid climates for comfortable sleep. this is notwithstanding the fact that in general, folks do prefer a slightly cooler temperature when dozing off, which has been adapted by various smart bed technologies; no, i do not have one and have yet to try one. low-tech in place of high tech, and no electricity needed. i'm a fan (get it? ha).
translation:
作为本次评论的配乐，我建议您将 Coolio 的您最喜欢的歌曲排队。
这就是那种老派的善良。 老学校新学校。
因此，众所周知，已经开发出可以保留或反射热量的织物，特别是用于运动目的。 我之前评论过该品牌相同材质的床笠，很高兴地发现，尽管我没有处于更年期，但丁香紫色床单的超光滑超凉非保温性质对我来说是中级的完美选择新英格兰试图成为夏天，但天气持续闷热，很容易醒来出汗； 没有人想要这样。 超酷的解决方案！
当然，在看过那张床单后，我对买几个超酷的枕套非常感兴趣。 正如预期的那样，它们是相同的材料。 它们超级酷而且超级柔软。 它们像床单一样耐洗且耐烘干。 它们非常适合温暖或潮湿的气候，提供舒适的睡眠。 尽管如此，一般来说，人们在打瞌睡时确实更喜欢稍微凉爽的温度，各种智能床技术已经适应了这一点； 不，我没有，也还没有尝试过。 用低技术代替高科技，并且不需要电力。 我是一个粉丝（明白吗？哈）。

title: Description is not Accurate
body: Ad says it is silk. It is NOT silk. It's a fancy polyester the tags still claim it keeps you cool. It's cool to the touch but quite heavy. I'm keeping it but not happy about it not being silk.
translation:
广告说这是丝绸。它不是丝绸。这是一种精美的聚酯纤维，标签上仍然声称它可以让你保持凉爽。
摸起来很凉，但很重。
我保留着它，但对它不是丝绸感到不高兴。

title: It's like magic...so far
body: I just got this last week and it has been great for the nights here where its been between 64 F and humid.  It will be interesting to see what happens over the next month where is is hotter.  But its so great so far and actually cool to the touch.  I kind of wished there were some patterns, but oh well.
translation: 我上周刚拿到这个，对于这里温度在 64 华氏度和潮湿之间的夜晚来说，它非常棒。 看看下个月会发生什么更热的地方将会很有趣。 但到目前为止它非常棒，而且摸起来很酷。 我有点希望有一些模式，但是哦，好吧。

title: Super soft and cool!
body: Love this blanket.  Helps keep us cool at night. I would buy another one.
translation: 喜欢这条毯子。 帮助我们在夜间保持凉爽。 我会再买一个。

title: Soft and cooling.
body: These cases are super soft and cooling. I like how silky smooth it is without being satin or silk. It seems more sturdy and I love how cooling it is on my face. This is very nice and I think I may get more.
translation: 这些外壳非常柔软和凉爽。我喜欢它没有缎子或丝绸的丝滑。它似乎更坚固，我喜欢它在我的脸上的凉爽程度。这非常好，我想我可能会得到更多。

title: Soooft like butter…
body: I do believe this is my new favorite blanket… Cools like it says it does and truly does cool even in these crazy Texas summer nights!
translation: 我确实相信这是我最喜欢的新毯子……即使在德克萨斯州这些疯狂的夏夜，它也像它所说的那样凉爽，而且确实很凉爽！

title: Cooling
body: It does keep you cooler. The fabric is very soft & slippery. My cat loves rolling around on it. She’s a hoot.
translation: 它确实让你更凉快。面料非常柔软且滑腻。我的猫喜欢在上面打滚。她真有趣。

title: Not cooling.
body: Thai blanket stay cool to the touch for about 1 minute and then seems to adjust to whatever your body temperature is. If you are warm, then it feels warm. If you prone to hot flashes this not a good blanket.
translation: 泰式毯子触感凉爽约 1 分钟，然后似乎会适应您的体温。如果你是温暖的，那么就会感觉温暖。如果您容易潮热，这不是一个好的毯子。

title: Soft & Warm
body: The material is very soft and smooth feeling fabric.
translation: 材质非常柔软光滑。

title: Very nice blanket
body: Very soft material,beautiful pastel colours,light weight overall very nice but not cool enough for me. I’m still getting hot at night and it’s not helping me but I passed it on to my mother and she loves it.
translation: 材质非常柔软，颜色柔和，整体轻盈，非常不错，但对我来说还不够凉爽。我晚上还是会觉得热，这对我没什么帮助，但我把它传给了我妈妈，她很喜欢。

title: This review is for the cooling pillowcase
body: These pillow cases are very, very soft and stretchy. and slippery...  When I put my head on my pillow the first time I used this pillow case I thought it felt cool, and then the 2nd night I was certain that the pillow felt cooler.  It also appears to have reduced the amount of sweating I do at night.  So for me this is a 5 star pillow case...  I use  a cervical neck support memory foam pillow.  However my wife is not such a big fan, her pillow is an overstuffed shredded memory foam pillow and she says her head is sliding  around on the pillow at night.  She did notice that her pillow felt cooler when she went to bed but the slipperiness is too much for her so for her it is 3.5 stars.  There is no question that for both of us we can notice the pillow feels cooler at night and for me has helped with sweating.  But if you use an overstuffed pillow this pillow case may not be for you?
translation:
这些枕套非常非常柔软且有弹性。 而且很滑...

当我第一次使用这个枕套时，当我把头放在枕头上时，我觉得它感觉很凉，然后第二天晚上，我确信枕头感觉很凉。 它似乎还减少了我晚上的出汗量。 所以对我来说，这是一个五星级枕套......我使用颈椎支撑记忆海绵枕头。

然而我的妻子不太喜欢，她的枕头是一个填充过多的记忆海绵碎片枕头，她说她的头晚上在枕头上滑动。 她确实注意到，当她上床睡觉时，她的枕头感觉凉爽，但太滑了，对她来说太滑了，所以对她来说，这是 3.5 颗星。

毫无疑问，对于我们俩来说，我们都可以注意到枕头在晚上感觉凉爽，对我来说有助于出汗。 但如果您使用过大的枕头，那么这款枕套可能不适合您？

title: Buy It!!!
body: As an almost 52 yo woman I have had terrible night sweats for years. Not matter what I used for sheets or clothing, even no clothing, I would soak through my bedding almost every night. This comforter is amazing! It's baby soft. I find myself just rubbing my hand over it repeatedly because of the softness. I have 2 small pups and caught them "scratching" the comforter to fluff it and they did snag anything on it!!! Now, when I wake up in the middle of the night, instead of needing to move on the bed because it's soaked, I now feel cold spots on this comforter and I'm perfectly dry. I've paired this with the Miracle Brand sheets and I am no longer uncomfortable sleeping! Just buy it. It's absolutely worth it!!!
translation: 作为一名快 52 岁的女性，多年来我一直盗汗。 无论我用什么床单或衣服，甚至不穿衣服，我几乎每天晚上都会湿透我的被褥。 这被子太棒了！ 真是婴儿般的柔软。 我发现自己只是用手反复摩擦它，因为它很柔软。 我有两只小狗，发现它们“抓挠”被子，让被子变得蓬松，它们确实抓住了上面的任何东西！ 现在，当我半夜醒来时，我不再需要在床上移动，因为它已经湿透了，我现在感觉被子上有冷点，而且我完全干燥了。 我将其与 Miracle Brand 床单搭配使用，我不再感到睡眠不舒服！ 就买吧。 绝对值得！！！

title: Pretty good
body: This does have the cooling material, which I really like. However, it does not seem too cooling long term. It is extra cool at first touch, but, like other pillow cases, it gets warm eventually and you have to flip it or something. The material feels spandex-y: it’s stretching and somewhat thin, but it feels nice and soft/almost silky. It’s a nice case, but I’m not too sure if it’s particularly better than a normal one.
translation: 这确实有冷却材料，我真的很喜欢。 然而，从长远来看，它似乎并不太冷却。 第一次接触时感觉特别凉爽，但是，像其他枕套一样，它最终会变热，你必须翻转它或进行其他操作。 这种材料摸起来像氨纶：它有弹性，有点薄，但感觉很好，很柔软/几乎如丝般柔滑。 这是一个很好的案例，但我不太确定它是否比普通案例特别好。

title: NOT cooling
body: I was excited but timid to try this as nothing has really helped with the night sweats, and the reviews were mostly good. I don’t think I could even use this in winter. I sweated so much. I tried it for a week just in case it was other variables, but it was definitely the blanket. I even tried with different sheets and then just the blanket. Sweated horribly each time.
translation: 我很兴奋但又不敢尝试这个，因为没有什么能真正帮助缓解盗汗，而且评论大多都很好。我想我冬天都不能用这个。我出了很多汗。我试了一周，以防万一有其他变量，但它绝对是毯子。我什至尝试过用不同的床单，然后只用毯子。每次都大汗淋漓。

title: Nice
body: These pillowcases are the bomb! So soft and silky. The wife loves them for not messing up her hair too much during the night. She said they need a zipper though, as they have a tendency to slide off the pillow if you move around too much. Would recommend.
translation: 这些枕套是炸弹！ 如此柔软丝滑。 妻子很喜欢它们，因为它们不会在晚上把她的头发弄乱太多。 她说他们需要一个拉链，因为如果你走动太多，他们很容易从枕头上滑落。 会推荐。

title: Cool pillow case
body: This is a great buy,cools my head at night and I sweat at night with this soft pillow cases you will enjoy your day nap or your nightly rest.
translation: 这是一个很好的选择，晚上让我的头凉爽，晚上我出汗，有了这个柔软的枕套，你会享受你的白天小睡或晚上休息。

title: Very soft and comfortable
body: Love the feel of the fabric and it's very cooling
translation: 喜欢面料的感觉，而且很凉爽

title: Great material
body: It is absolutely beautiful and soft.
translation: 它绝对美丽而柔软。

title: wow!
body: its so cold!  to the touch all day, and soft and perfect. we are all fighting over it will have to buy one for everyone. I bought 4 and told my mom to get one and she did and then thanked me after a night sleep with it.
translation: 好冷！ 整天摸起来，柔软完美。我们都在为它而战，将不得不为每个人买一个。我买了4个，告诉我妈妈买一个，她做到了，然后在晚上睡觉后感谢我。

title: Loving the pillowcases so much I am ordering the comforter too!
body: Review for Pillowcase-grey | Size: 20"x30"  I mostly picked these up for the pillowcases but I am seriously loving them way better than expected.  They are very well made.  The material for the pillowcases feel somewhat similar to a swimshirt and are VERY chilly to the touch.  While I have owned cooling pillows and that sort of stuff, the material they used for the pillowcases are super cool and confortable.  I'm very happy I picked these up and considering purchasing the matching conforter for the summer, because these pillowcases are just that awesome if youre someone who is hot at night like me!
translation:
枕套灰色评论 |尺寸：20“x30”

我主要是为枕套挑选这些，但我真的很喜欢它们，比预期的要好。 它们制作精良。 枕套的材料感觉有点类似于泳衣，摸起来非常寒冷。 虽然我拥有冷却枕头之类的东西，但他们用于枕套的材料超级凉爽舒适。 我很高兴我拿起了这些，并考虑在夏天购买匹配的舒适，因为如果你是像我这样晚上很热的人，这些枕套真是太棒了！

title: Lightweight and cool
body: Great summer blanket. It is comfortable and cool. I have been very happy with this purchase. I have pillowcases from same company on the way and am hoping they will be similar to the blanket in the cooling texture
translation: 很棒的夏季毯子。它既舒适又凉爽。我对这次购买非常满意。我在路上有同一家公司的枕套，希望它们在凉爽的质地上与毯子相似

title: Cozy Bliss Cooling Pillow Case
body: Good pillowcase. Fits my pillow well. Cools when I sleep on it and you can tell the difference. Soft but not overly soft like a lot of pillowcases I have had before.
translation: 很好的枕套。 很适合我的枕头。 当我睡在上面时很凉爽，你可以看出区别。 柔软但不像我以前用过的很多枕套那样太软。

title: Envelope closure gaps open on large pillows
body: These pillowcases feel great to the touch, smooth and a noticable cooling quality.  However, I found that my very poofy queen pillows aren't enclosed well with the envelope closure. It gaps open, partially exposing the pillow end. Admittedly these pillows are overstuffed and larger than the average queen sized pillow, so the envelope closure probably works fine for the average pillow, but if your pillows are very poofy, you might have the same issue.
translation: 这些枕套触感极佳、光滑且具有明显的清凉效果。 然而，我发现我的大号枕头没有用信封封口很好地封闭。 它张开，部分暴露枕头端。 诚然，这些枕头填充过多，并且比普通大号枕头大，因此信封封口可能适合普通枕头，但如果您的枕头非常蓬松，您可能会遇到同样的问题。

title: Silky, oh so amazing!!
body: Wow. Beyond impressed! Thankfully these have the “envelope” closure or they would slide right off your pillow!!! Like sleeping on a cloud!!!
translation:
哇。超越印象深刻！
值得庆幸的是，这些有“信封”关闭，否则它们会直接从你的枕头上滑落!!
就像睡在云上一样!!

title: A must if you live in Texas
body: My husband and I were looking for something lightweight and cool to cover ourselves up with during the brutal Texas summer. My husband is like a space heater at night and insists on wrapping himself up like a sweaty burrito at night so I thought this would at least be cooler than our heavy thick cotton comforter. He absolutely loves it and so do I . I want to buy another one just because.
translation: 我丈夫和我正在寻找一些轻巧而酷的东西来掩盖自己在残酷的德克萨斯州夏天。我丈夫晚上就像一个空间加热器，晚上坚持把自己裹得像一个汗流浃背的卷饼，所以我想这至少会比我们厚厚的棉被更凉爽。他绝对喜欢它，我也是。我想再买一个，只是因为。

title: Cool pillow case. Literally!
body: I really like this pillow case. I don't know how they do it, but when you first lay on it it feels cold, not just cool. Of course, it settles down to a very comfortable temperature, but when you move your head to another spot, it feels cool again. For me, this is a great feature and it keeps me cool through the night. Also, it is made of a soft and smooth material which is very comfortable. The size is great for even larger pillows. I have not tried washing it yet, but if there are any issues I will update my review.
translation: 我真的很喜欢这个枕套。我不知道他们是怎么做到的，但是当你第一次躺在上面时，感觉很冷，而不仅仅是凉爽。当然，它会降到非常舒适的温度，但是当您将头移到另一个地方时，它会再次感到凉爽。对我来说，这是一个很棒的功能，它让我整夜保持凉爽。此外，它由柔软光滑的材料制成，非常舒适。尺寸非常适合更大的枕头。我还没有尝试洗它，但如果有任何问题，我会更新我的评论。

title: Nice
body: These pillowcases are absolutely wonderful. They stay super cool. They keep you cool throughout the night exactly what I needed
translation: 这些枕套绝对很棒。他们保持超级酷。他们让你整晚保持凉爽，正是我需要的

title: Tight Weave (Nylon)
body: This fabric feelsl very COOL to the touch.. I suspec it might be a good cooling fabric to sleep on.  If that's NOT the case, I'll come back and report later, but just FEELING it and seeing how TIGHTLY WOVEN it is, all signs point to comfort.  It's called "Cozy Bliss" for a reason, eh? Makes sense  : )
translation:
这种面料摸起来很酷。我怀疑它可能是一个很好的冷却面料睡觉。

如果不是这样，我稍后会回来报告，但只是感受它，看看它有多紧密，所有迹象都指向舒适。

它被称为“舒适的幸福”是有原因的，嗯？
有道理：）

title: Amazing Cooling Effect
body: I’ve been buying a new bed set every single week trying to find the perfect cooling combo. We live in Florida and I am a hot sleeper. I’ve bought everything from cheap to super expensive sets and this blanket is the best BY FAR! I have the matching cooling sheets coming tomorrow and I am excited to finally experience a comfortable sleep🥰
translation: 我每周都会买一套新床，试图找到完美的冷却组合。我们住在佛罗里达，我是一个热睡者。我买了从便宜到超级昂贵的套装的所有东西，这条毯子是迄今为止最好的！我明天有匹配的冷却床单，我很高兴终于体验到舒适的睡眠🥰

title: Very soft, airy, and keeps from overheating
body: The comforter itself was pretty soft in material, very comfortable, and actually felt 'cooling'. It was light and kept you from overheating, especially in the hot summer like it is for me. This is a great comforter for those who get really hot at night or for those summer months of 90 degree plus weather.
translation: 被子本身的材质相当柔软，非常舒适，实际上感觉很“凉爽”。它很轻，可以防止你过热，尤其是在炎热的夏天，就像我一样。对于那些晚上或90度以上的夏季天气非常炎热的人来说，这是一个很好的被子。

title: Excellent product
body: Great product, I'd highly recommend!
translation: 很棒的产品，我强烈推荐！

title: Nice.
body: I was think is give more cold feeling
translation: 我以为是给更多冷的感觉

title: Product as described
body: Beautiful and soft, lightweight perfect!
translation: 美丽柔软，轻巧完美！

title: Great for hot sleepers!
body: I bought a queen sized for my boyfriends bed. He is such a hot sleeper that I literally can not sleep in the bed all night with him. I end up having to move to my own bed. This blanket is extremely light weight and super soft so was an instant favorite of ours. That isn't even the best part though. It cool him down enough that I can actually stay in the same bed with him! I no longer feel like I am going to stick to him or suffocate under the blanket with him. It has been a game changer! It is lightweight, soft, easy to clean and very well made! Definitely recommend it!
translation: 我买了一张大号床，适合我男朋友的床。他睡得很热，我真的不能和他整晚睡在床上。我最终不得不搬到自己的床上。这条毯子重量极轻，超级柔软，所以我们立即成为我们的最爱。不过，这甚至不是最好的部分。这让他冷静下来，我居然可以和他呆在同一张床上！我不再觉得我会粘着他或和他一起在毯子下窒息。它改变了游戏规则！它重量轻，柔软，易于清洁，制作精良！绝对推荐它！

title: Really works!
body: This blanket is just what I needed for hot flashes!
translation: 这条毯子正是我潮热所需要的！

title: Miracle
body: This blanket is fanatic! My husband didn’t believe me when I told him about it, but I shared with him and he loves it. I bought a twin first to try it.  I will be buying a king and use it as our top sheet. Only issue I had  had was a shipping error.  I actually received dog treats so I had to return them, the blanket came two days later.
translation:
这条毯子很狂热！当我告诉他这件事时，我丈夫不相信我，但我和他分享了，他喜欢它。
我先买了一对双胞胎试试。 我将买一个国王并用它作为我们的顶板。
我遇到的唯一问题是运输错误。 我实际上收到了狗零食，所以我不得不归还它们，毯子两天后来了。

title: Unbelievable
body: Well, I waited to write my review in case it was a fluke that I wasn’t waking up sweating and throwing my blankets off a couple nights in a row. I am still not waking up in the middle of the night at all!  The blanket provides warmth, yet keeps you from overheating, and is cold to the touch. I don’t know what kind of magic this is, but I wish I found it a few years ago when all of this started for me. It is also very soft, provides a little bit of weight on top of you, and feels nice to the touch.  My husband (who has come within an inch of his life for trying to cuddle with me during the night as he is a human furnace) is also happy with the blanket. He says he is just more comfortable during the night and he has even snuck in a cuddle or two and lived to tell me about it!  Can’t wait to see what happens when we turn on the AC this summer. Hoping this will be warm enough, but, if not I will be looking for this brand to come to the rescue again.
translation:
好吧，我等着写我的评论，以防万一我连续几个晚上没有醒来出汗并扔掉毯子是侥幸。我仍然没有在半夜醒来！ 毯子提供温暖，但不会让您过热，并且摸起来很冷。我不知道这是什么魔力，但我希望几年前我能找到它，当时这一切对我来说都是开始的。它也非常柔软，在您身上提供一点重量，触感很好。

我的丈夫（他因为晚上试图拥抱我而来到了他生命的一英寸之内，因为他是一个人类的熔炉）也对毯子感到满意。他说他只是晚上更舒服，他甚至偷偷溜进一两个拥抱，活着告诉我这件事！

迫不及待地想看看今年夏天当我们打开空调时会发生什么。希望这会足够温暖，但是，如果没有，我会寻找这个品牌再次来救援。

title: Not really "cooling"
body: Although the fabric is cool to the touch, since it is plastic, it heats up and stays hot once it is in contact with your body. It's sort of like having a giant piece of plastic wrap over you while you're sleeping, although you can grab a "new" part of it (that hasn't been touching your body) that will be cool for a couple of minutes. I will be returning this in favor of something natural like bamboo or silk.
translation: 尽管这种织物摸起来很凉，但由于它是塑料的，一旦与您的身体接触，它就会升温并保持高温。这有点像你睡觉时身上盖了一块巨大的保鲜膜，尽管你可以抓住它的“新”部分（没有接触到你的身体），它会凉爽几分钟。我会用竹子或丝绸等天然材料来回报它。

title: Amazing blanket !!
body: Very soft and smoothy  I bought for my son who sweats a lot at night and he loves it very much.
translation:
非常柔软光滑
我给我儿子买的，他晚上出汗很多，他非常喜欢。

title: Got Overheated
body: Im a really hot sleeper and I sweat in the summer. I got a thin cooling blanket which has been nice but its very small on my queen size mattress. I got this blanket based off of positive reviews. 1st night I have used it, I woke up in the middle of the night just drenched in sweat and very overheated, that I had to turn my ceiling fan on high setting and get my thin cooling blanket back out to cool me down. Sad to say I am not impressed. I am returning it.
translation: 我是一个睡眠很热的人，夏天我会出汗。我买了一条薄薄的凉毯，很好，但在我的大号床垫上它很小。我根据积极的评论得到了这条毯子。第一天晚上我用了它，我半夜醒来，浑身是汗，而且非常热，我不得不把吊扇调到高档，然后把薄薄的冷却毯拿出来让我凉快下来。遗憾的是我没有留下深刻的印象。我正在退货。

title: This blanket is black magic
body: I had noticed that I had started waking up in the morning sweating since the temperatures had started to go up. I live in VA and it gets hot pretty early here. I love my comforter but I realized that it was just way too thick for summer. I looked around at different comforter brands that claimed they were cooling and meant for hot sleepers. I ALMOST bought the Rest comforter which was like almost $200, and that was on sale. I'm glad I decided to try this one first. It's so soft and it's just genuinely cool to the touch. I sleep so well last night and no sweating at all. This is a great alternative to buying one of the super expensive brands.
translation: 我注意到，由于气温开始升高，我早上醒来时开始出汗。 我住在弗吉尼亚州，这里很早就很热。 我喜欢我的被子，但我意识到它对于夏天来说太厚了。 我环顾了不同的被子品牌，这些品牌声称它们具有凉爽作用，适合热睡的人。 我差点就买了 Rest 被子，差不多 200 美元，而且正在打折。 我很高兴我决定先尝试这个。 它非常柔软，触感非常凉爽。 昨晚我睡得很好，没有出汗。 这是购买超级昂贵品牌之一的绝佳选择。

title: COMFORTABLE & WELL MADE
body: I love this double sided cooling comforter. My night sweats and hot flashes have been horrible and this comforter has definitely been helping. It is super soft. You can have either side on your body. It is a perfect thickness and a great size. The 4 sides are all edged and the sewing is very professional. It came out of the washer and dryer very nice. I even took it on vacation with me. It is great quality and very well made.
translation: 我喜欢这款双面凉爽被子。 我的盗汗和潮热非常可怕，而这款被子确实有帮助。 它非常柔软。 您可以选择身体的任何一侧。 它具有完美的厚度和巨大的尺寸。  4个边都是包边的，缝制非常专业。 用洗衣机和烘干机洗出来的效果非常好。 我什至带着它去度假。 它质量上乘，做工精良。

title: Coolest
body: This is pretty much the coolest blanket my wife feels she has ever had. She loves it.
translation: 这几乎是我妻子觉得她拥有过的最酷的毯子。 她喜欢它。

title: Excellent!!
body: Love love this blanket ! Cool and soft ! Great presents to someone !
translation: 爱爱这条毯子！ 又凉又软！ 送给某人的好礼物！

title: Cozy and cooling
body: What a wonderful comforter for living in Arizona. It is cooling and will cited and silky smooth. This works great because we get kinda hot at night even year round. This can be washed and it still maintains its cooling factors. Definitely a great way to stay cooler at night.
translation: 对于住在亚利桑那州来说，这是多么美妙的被子啊。 它凉爽、会引、如丝般光滑。 这非常有效，因为我们甚至全年晚上都会有点热。 它可以清洗并且仍然保持其冷却系数。 绝对是夜间保持凉爽的好方法。

title: Awesome Blanket
body: This blanket is awesome. I have a temper pedic and it gets kinda hot. I got this cooling blanket and I was really surprised at how cooling it actually is! The fabric is incredibly soft and the blanket always feels almost cold to the touch. I don’t know how it works but I was really impressed with it and love it! I’ve actually never left a review for the 100’s of items I’ve bought on Amazon but I am so impressed with this blanket I felt compelled to leave an excellent review! I’m definitely going to purchase the sheets from the same company!
translation: 这条毯子太棒了。 我有一个脾气暴躁的医生，它变得有点热。 我得到了这条冷却毯，我真的很惊讶它实际上有多凉爽！ 面料非常柔软，毯子摸起来总是感觉冷。 我不知道它是如何工作的，但我对它印象深刻并且喜欢它！ 事实上，我从未对我在亚马逊上购买的 100 多种商品留下过评论，但这条毯子给我留下了深刻的印象，我觉得有必要留下一篇精彩的评论！ 我肯定会从同一家公司购买床单！

title: Give cool feeling at night
body: Very nice and comfortable
translation: 非常舒适舒适

title: Best Blacket I'v ever had
body: Cool, soft and fluffy
translation: 凉爽、柔软、蓬松

title: Cool,cool,cool!!!
body: As someone who has begun walking in the middle of the night due to hot flashes, this blanket has improved my quality of sleep many times over!!!  I considered a more expensive brand, so glad I didn't.  I appreciate the size, box stitching, piping, fabric, texture, weight and cooling effects!!!
translation:
作为一个因为潮热而开始半夜走路的人，这条毯子让我的睡眠质量提高了很多倍！

我考虑过一个更贵的品牌，很高兴我没有这么做。

我很欣赏它的尺寸、盒式缝合、滚边、面料、质地、重量和冷却效果！

title: Not really cooling
body: It's a nice blanket, not especially warm, and quite cozy, but also not really cooling and not as nice to the feel (for me) as a cotton sheet.
translation: 这是一条不错的毯子，不是特别温暖，但很舒适，但也不是很凉爽，而且（对我来说）感觉不如棉床单那么好。

title: Its worth it
body: It kept me cool and did the job , it'll never leave my side again probably gonna get a bigger size
translation: 它让我保持冷静并完成了工作，它永远不会再离开我的身边，可能会变得更大的尺寸

title: Just buy it
body: This comforter is very cooling to the touch and it doesn’t trap body heat in! I can finally sleep without waking up covered in sweat.
translation: 这款被子摸起来非常凉爽，而且不会滞留身体热量！ 我终于可以睡觉了，不用满身大汗地醒来。

title: For sweaty sleeper, menopause or hot flash sufferers this blanket is a MUST !!!!
body: This blanket is cool to the touch it actually does what they advertise!!!!!
translation: 这条毯子摸起来很凉，它确实达到了他们广告的效果！！！！

title: Love this blanket! 5/5
body: I needed something to help me cool down at night besides fans and AC. This blanket is awesome! 5/5 would recommend. It’s not too heavy like a comforter yet not thin like a sheet. I love it.
translation: 除了风扇和空调之外，我还需要一些东西来帮助我在晚上降温。 这毯子太棒了！  5/5会推荐。 它不像被子那样重，但也不像床单那样薄。 我喜欢它。

title: Nice cooling blanket
body: I love blanket and help with hot flashes.
translation: 我喜欢毯子，它能帮助缓解潮热。

title: Cooling!
body: It is really cooling. I need that at night. No more night sweats! It is soft and comfortable. I love the blue color.
translation: 真的很凉爽。 我晚上需要那个。 不再盗汗！ 它柔软舒适。 我喜欢蓝色。

title: Amazing
body: Comforter was cool right out of the box. The comforter is extremely light weight and perfect for the spring and summer. My dog even loves laying on the comforter because of how cool it is!
translation: 被子从盒子里拿出来就很酷。 这款被子重量极轻，非常适合春季和夏季。 我的狗甚至喜欢躺在被子上，因为它太酷了！

title: Super soft and cool!
body: So glad I purchased this blanket. Perfect for spring /summer nights to keep you cool!
translation: 很高兴我买了这条毯子。 非常适合春夏之夜，让您保持凉爽！

title: Highly Recommended
body: Exceeds my expectations.It is so lightweight, soft and silky to touch, breathable. I love the two sides with cooling for hot nights and warm cotton for chilly nights. Material and looks high end. Highly recommended.
translation: 超出了我的预期。它非常轻，触感柔软，丝滑，透气。 我喜欢两侧有凉爽的炎热夜晚和温暖的棉质寒冷的夜晚。 材质和外观都很高端。 强烈推荐。

title: It's cool AND warm, lol
body: I am loving this blanket.  It is quite warm enough with a sheet, but adds so little weight.  It is extremely cool to the touch, but of course, it warms up.  I have it on the bed with bamboo sheets and it is really warm, but not sweaty and suffocating.  I have used just the blanket, no sheet, in order to test the "moisture wicking" part, and I must say that I did not get sweaty; I did not sleep all night with it like that, but it was totally fine for a nap.  The fabric is very silky, cool to the touch, and oddly stretchy.  It doesn't stretch when you are moving it around, but if you grab just one layer of fabric, it stretches.  The blue color is very fetching and I think it enhances the "cool feeling".
translation: 我很喜欢这条毯子。 盖上床单就足够温暖了，但增加的重量却很少。 摸起来非常凉爽，但当然，它会变暖。 我把它放在床上，铺着竹床单，真的很暖和，但不会出汗和窒息。 为了测试“吸湿排汗”部分，我只使用了毯子，没有使用床单，我必须说我没有出汗； 我没有像这样整夜睡觉，但小睡一下完全没问题。 这种面料非常丝滑，触感凉爽，并且具有奇特的弹性。 当您移动它时，它不会拉伸，但如果您只抓住一层织物，它就会拉伸。 蓝色非常迷人，我认为它增强了“酷感”。

title: Coolest Blanket Ever
body: I cannot say enough good things about this blanket.  It is called a cooling blanket and I thought it couldn't work that good, but I was so pleasantly surprised. Being menopausal and in Texas in the summer, anything that helps keep you cool is much appreciated. This blanket not only works to cool you off when hot, it works to keep you cool. I cannot believe how well this worked.  If the cooling part isn't enough, this blanket is soft and stylish. I ordered the light gray blanket with white trim. It is also light weight. This would work as a long term blanket on your bed or to cover with while lounging around.
translation:
我对这条毯子赞不绝口。

它被称为冷却毯，我认为它的作用不太好，但我感到非常惊喜。 在更年期和德克萨斯州的夏天，任何能让你保持凉爽的东西都会受到欢迎。 这条毯子不仅可以在炎热时为您降温，还可以让您保持凉爽。 我简直不敢相信这效果有多好。

如果冷却部分不够，这款毯子柔软又时尚。 我订购了带有白色镶边的浅灰色毯子。 它的重量也很轻。 这可以作为您床上的长期毯子或闲逛时盖上的毯子。

title: a cloud.
body: I got this for my husband because he's usually hot at night. I had been suffering from night sweats and he gave it to me. I never gave it back and I don't plan on it. It's so soft and cool. Eventually you may get hot just like any other blanket, but this one is so fluffy and usually it's cool to the touch. I love getting under it every night and it really gives me a level of added comfort. It's a beautiful color and I'm so happy with this product.
translation: 我给我丈夫买了这个，因为他晚上通常很热。 我一直盗汗，他把它给了我。 我从未归还过它，而且我也不打算这样做。 它是如此柔软和凉爽。 最终，您可能会像其他毯子一样感到很热，但这条毯子非常蓬松，通常摸起来很凉爽。 我喜欢每天晚上都躲在它下面，它确实给我带来了一定程度的额外舒适感。 这是一种美丽的颜色，我对这个产品非常满意。

title: Best Blanket!!
body: Menopause women rejoice....This blanket is AMAZING and has been the only one I will use now. It not only keeps me cool and keeps my body temp regulated but it also keeps me warm. Now the weight of the blanket is okay as it does have weight to it yet isnt heavy. I do find this to be a must have in just about every household. The size of the blanket is also a huge selling point for me as i love a blanket to wrap around me and this is perfect for that. Now as for washing, I have tossed it in the wash on a cold load and let it tumble on air dry. The blanket held up super well. I highly recommend this as the quality is amazing and the price is fantastic.
translation:
更年期妇女欢欣鼓舞......这条毯子太棒了，是我现在唯一会使用的毯子。 它不仅让我保持凉爽并调节体温，而且还让我保持温暖。 现在毯子的重量还可以，因为它确实有重量但并不重。
我确实发现这是几乎每个家庭的必备品。
毯子的尺寸对我来说也是一个巨大的卖点，因为我喜欢一条毯子包裹着我，这非常适合。
现在说到洗涤，我已将其放入冷水中洗涤，然后将其风干。 毯子支撑得非常好。
我强烈推荐这个，因为质量很棒而且价格也很优惠。

title: Cool, Comfortable Blanket! Great for Summer Nights!
body: Do you like the feel of a blanket but don't want the heat? This comforter definitely provides a cooling effect.  This will be great on hot summer nights, even with the air on.  The comforter fit our queen size bed accurately and there were no wrinkles in the comforter straight out of the packaging.  It's a very plain design and the blue shade is a pale blue just as in my photos, not like the darker blue shown in the ad so make sure the color is what your want.  The blanket is heavier than expected at over 5 pounds and it's machine washable.  It's designed to draw heat away from your body, so if you're too hot at night, this may help.
translation:
您喜欢毯子的感觉但又不想要温暖吗？ 这款被子绝对能提供凉爽的效果。 在炎热的夏夜，即使开着空调，这也会很棒。

被子非常适合我们的大号床，从包装中取出的被子没有任何皱纹。 这是一个非常简单的设计，蓝色阴影是淡蓝色，就像我的照片中一样，而不是像广告中显示的深蓝色，所以请确保颜色是您想要的颜色。 毯子比预期重，超过 5 磅，并且可以机洗。 它旨在将热量从您的身体中带走，因此如果您晚上太热，这可能会有所帮助。

title: Cooling is in the name and cooling is what it does. UPDATE
body: The stitching is weak. I now have several areas where it’s coming undone. Comfortable but doesn’t last long.  This blanket is perfection in every way. It's so soft and cool.  I am in menapause and if you don't know, it's like a heating pad is inside of your body working its way out. It's not fun waking up to your body on fire and sweating. I did not wake up as often when I slept with this blanket as it didn't hold the heat in like all other blankets. It's cool to the touch and such a relief!
translation:
缝合很弱。 我现在有几个方面的工作尚未完成。 舒适但不会持续很长时间。

这条毯子在各方面都很完美。 它是如此柔软和凉爽。 我正处于更年期，如果你不知道的话，就像你体内的一个加热垫正在逐渐消失一样。 醒来时发现身体着火、出汗，这可不是什么有趣的事情。
当我用这条毯子睡觉时，我没有经常醒来，因为它不像所有其他毯子那样能保持热量。 摸起来很凉，真是一种解脱！

title: Very beautiful.
body: Well made and truly does help keep u cool while sleeping
translation: 制作精良，确实可以帮助您在睡眠时保持凉爽

title: Well Made Blanket
body: I was pleasantly surprised by the quality of this blanket.  Two tone.  I didn't love the fabric feel - more satin feeling than cotton, but does keep cool.  Worth the price.
translation: 我对这条毯子的质量感到惊喜。两声。我不喜欢这种面料的感觉——比棉质更有缎子的感觉，但确实保持凉爽。值得这个价格。

title: Game changer for hot sleepers
body: My wife gets hot while sleeping at night, and this blanket is perfect. She is totally in love with it! I get in trouble if I move the thermostat one degree at night, typically from 67 to 68, and now she can sleep under a blanket and be comfortable. She is usually half uncovered throughout the night, but this has changed how she sleeps. The blanket is very soft and looks really nice. Recommend for you hot sleepers out there.
translation: 我的妻子晚上睡觉时会感到很热，这条毯子非常适合。 她完全爱上了它！ 如果我晚上把恒温器调高一度，通常是从 67 度调到 68 度，我就会遇到麻烦，现在她可以盖着毯子睡得很舒服了。 她通常整晚都半裸着，但这改变了她的睡眠方式。 毯子非常柔软，看起来非常漂亮。 推荐给那些热睡的人。

title: midweight comforter with noticeable cooling properties
body: I have another cooling blanket that I bought a year ago. It was double layered, but quite thin and it kept slithering off my bed, so I've been looking for another one to try. This may just be it. It felt cold even as I was removing it from its attractive packaging. It feels cool as I huddle under it. It's a medium weight with stitching to keep the fiberfill from moving around too much, so I don't think it will slither off the bed like my other one does. For my purposes it might be best used in spring and fall, but I'm willing to give it a try during the summer months!  As with all cooling sheets and blankets, do be careful to follow laundering instructions. In this case, it states that a cold water wash is recommended, and minimal heat tumble drying, although I'd be inclined to put it on air fluff and then hang it outside. I don't understand how these fabrics feel so cool, but apparently heat of any kind can make their cooling properties less effective.  I recommend this as a great gift, though you'll want to keep it for yourself.
translation:
我还有另一条凉毯，是一年前买的。 它是双层的，但很薄，而且总是从我的床上滑落，所以我一直在寻找另一件来尝试。 也许就是这样。 即使当我将它从精美的包装中取出时，它仍然感觉很冷。 当我蜷缩在它下面时，感觉很酷。 它的重量适中，带有缝线，可防止纤维填充物移动太多，所以我认为它不会像我的另一个那样从床上滑落。 就我的目的而言，它可能最好在春季和秋季使用，但我愿意在夏季尝试一下！

与所有冷却床单和毯子一样，请务必遵守洗涤说明。 在这种情况下，它指出建议冷水洗涤，并尽量减少热滚筒干燥，尽管我倾向于将其放在空气绒毛上，然后挂在外面。 我不明白这些织物为何感觉如此凉爽，但显然任何形式的热量都会使其冷却性能降低。

我推荐将此作为一份很棒的礼物，但您可能会想自己保留。

title: Cooling indeed!
body: I like this blanket. It's so super soft to the touch. It's thin and not heavy at all. It stays cool and it's the perfect summer blanket. I love mine in the icy cool blue color. I definitely recommend this for a summer blanket.
translation: 我喜欢这条毯子。它的触感非常柔软。它很薄而且一点也不重。它保持凉爽，是完美的夏季毯子。我喜欢我的冰冷蓝色。我绝对推荐这款作为夏季毯子。

title: Cooling and Comfortable
body: This cooling blanket is silk smooth and extremely comfortable. It is made from lightweight and breathable cooling fabric filling. This indeed makes your body feel cool by absorbing the body heat. Once you try thing blanket you will never want to let go of it. It’s a must buy.
translation: 这款冷却毯如丝绸般光滑，非常舒适。它由轻质透气的凉爽织物填充物制成。这确实会让你的身体通过吸收身体热量而感到凉爽。一旦你尝试了毯子，你就永远不想放开它。这是必须买的。

title: Let me tell ya 'bout my BEEEEST BLANKET EVER
body: I've never felt a blanket that actually is cool to the touch and doesn't heat up crazy fast with body heat. I flippin love this blanket so much, I am a sweaty sleeper. so it's been burrito-ing me for a few days and now I, apparently, refuse to share it when I'm asleep lol so thank this blanket for my cranky husband who gets none of the blanket haha
translation: 我从来没有感觉到过一条毯子摸起来很凉，而且不会因体温而快速升温。 我非常喜欢这条毯子，我睡觉时会出汗。 所以这几天我一直在吃墨西哥卷饼，现在我显然拒绝在我睡着的时候分享它，哈哈，所以感谢我的暴躁丈夫这条毯子，他没有得到毯子哈哈

title: this is the right comforter for the summer or spring- the material is great
body: During the summer, i often encounter the problem of waking up with an overheating, caused from using a blanket or comforter that is not properly designed in relation to thickness. This issue has now been amplified; because of my cat all of a sudden wanting to dominate the space where i sleep. This will naturally add heat to an already over heated sleeping setting. This summer i wanted a comforter that will allow me to have the option of waking up in the night with a slight chill and then be able to not over bundle myself. This proper regulation of the body temperature will also help me save money with the air conditioning not being on constantly.  With this top notch comforter from the Cozy Bliss brand, i have found just what i was imagining. The first thing i noticed with this was how soft it was. The brand name is accurately themed, because this comforter is truly a cozy blissful sleep aid. You can tell this company cares about the customer; because they go the extra mile with the packaging presentation. This comforter arrives wrapped in a white silky bow and tied like a bundle of papers. The material this is made from is the complete opposite of the other traditional variations i own. I am the kind of person who is always bundling up in a blanket then automatically removing it during sleep n a cyclical pattern. This blanket allows for an easier auto movement of that sleep activity, which then makes it not a chore to be working with a super thick material. That additional blanket mass can bunch up and leave lots of excess thickness that is unnecessary. I feel this design is indicative of a well thought out plan to make a great thin style comforter that really has cooling effect. I have always though i have an over heated residual body temperature with my ability to heat up the area i have been laying down in. This blanket seems to absorb the extra heat and then send it somewhere away from your body. To conclude, i am super excited to use this in the hotter days of the summer and i totally recommend this.
translation:
在夏天，我经常会遇到起床过热的问题，这是由于使用的毯子或被子的厚度设计不当造成的。 这个问题现在已经被放大了； 因为我的猫突然想要主宰我睡觉的空间。 这自然会给已经过热的睡眠环境增加热量。 今年夏天，我想要一件被子，让我可以在半夜醒来时感到轻微的寒冷，然后又不会把自己裹得太紧。 这种对体温的适当调节也将帮助我在不经常开空调的情况下省钱。
有了这款来自 Cosy Bliss 品牌的顶级被子，我找到了我所想象的。 我注意到的第一件事就是它有多柔软。 该品牌名称的主题准确，因为这款被子确实是一种舒适、幸福的睡眠辅助品。 你可以看出这家公司关心客户； 因为他们在包装展示上付出了额外的努力。 这款被子送达时包裹着白色丝质蝴蝶结，并像一捆纸一样捆扎起来。
它所用的材料与我拥有的其他传统变体完全相反。 我是那种总是裹着毯子，然后在睡觉时自动把它拿走的人，循环往复。 这条毯子可以让睡眠活动更容易地自动移动，这样使用超厚的材料就不再是一件苦差事。 额外的毯子质量可能会堆积起来并留下大量不必要的多余厚度。
我觉得这个设计表明了一个深思熟虑的计划，旨在制作出真正具有凉爽效果的薄型被子。
我一直认为我的残余体温过热，我有能力加热我躺下的区域。这条毯子似乎吸收了多余的热量，然后将其发送到远离您身体的地方。
总而言之，我非常高兴能在夏天炎热的日子里使用它，我完全推荐它。

title: Great!
body: This is so great!! I get so hot when i sleep and this keeps me nice and cool!
translation: 这太棒了！！ 我睡觉时会很热，但这让我保持凉爽！

title: Yes silky, stitching not holding up
body: I like how this blanket arrived. It was not vacuumed packed and it is very well made. Even the packing as in the ribbon and the tags are of high standards. It has been keeping me cooler at night and no more sweating. I am very satisfied with this item and defiantly recommend this blanket.  UPDATE. I lowered my rating as some of the stitching started to come undone.
translation:
我喜欢这条毯子的抵达方式。它不是真空包装的，而且做工非常好。即使是丝带和标签等包装也是高标准的。它让我晚上保持凉爽，不再出汗。我对这个产品非常满意，并强烈推荐这条毯子。

更新。由于一些缝合开始松开，我降低了评级。

title: Super Cool Comforter!
body: This blanket from Cozy Bliss arrives secured in an attractive ribbon tied into a bow knot and provides a super cooling surface during the night if you're tossing and turning due to heat. Both sides just suck the heat away! Haven't had a chance to use it during the hot humid days of summer yet, but I anticipate that this comforter will provide some much welcome relief before having to turn on the AC.  And it’s so thin! I like having something covering me while sleeping. This blanket offers that comfort without any unwelcome bulkiness. Despite it being so thin, it still adds a little weight as an additional layer without trapping additional heat.  The blanket had an odd smell to my nose when I first took it out of the packaging. The smell wasn’t strong or offensive, but I ran the comforter through the washer (delicate, cold) and dryer (delicate, low heat) as recommended and the smell was gone.  More color options would be nice, but I’m looking forward to many nights of comfort with this blanket.  RECOMMENDED
translation:
这款来自 Cozy Bliss 的毯子采用一条漂亮的丝带固定在蝴蝶结上，如果您因炎热而翻来覆去，可以在夜间提供超凉爽的表面。 双方都把热量吸走了！ 还没有机会在炎热潮湿的夏季使用它，但我预计这款被子将在打开空调之前提供一些令人欣喜的缓解。

而且还这么薄！ 我喜欢睡觉时有东西盖住我。 这款毯子既舒适又没有任何不受欢迎的笨重感。 尽管它很薄，但作为附加层，它仍然增加了一点重量，而不会捕获额外的热量。

当我第一次从包装中取出毯子时，我的鼻子里有一股奇怪的气味。 气味并不强烈或令人反感，但我按照建议将被子放入洗衣机（温和、冷水）和烘干机（温和、低热）中，气味消失了。

有更多颜色选择就更好了，但我期待着这条毯子让我度过许多个舒适的夜晚。

受到推崇的

title: Super Soft
body: Very lightweight for its size! Ultra soft to the touch and it really does feel nice and cool. My wife likes it warm at night and I like it cold. For the longest time I had to be the one to sacrifice my comfort. Now I have this and she has a heated blanket! Super happy with this product!
translation: 就其尺寸而言非常轻巧！ 触感超柔软，感觉确实很好很凉爽。 我的妻子喜欢晚上温暖，而我喜欢寒冷。 在很长一段时间里，我不得不牺牲自己的舒适度。 现在我有了这个，她也有了电热毯！ 对这个产品超级满意！

title: Cooling indeed
body: This mid weight cooling blanket feels cold right out of the packaging. It washes great and air dries quickly. The queen size is large enough for full size bed as well. Most blankets that claim to be cooling but aren’t and this one really delivers. Just be careful when the temperature dips because you will wake up cold.
translation: 这款中等重量的冷却毯从包装中取出后感觉很冷。它非常好洗，而且风干得很快。大号床也足够大，可以容纳全尺寸床。大多数毯子都声称可以降温，但事实并非如此，而这款确实能做到这一点。气温下降时要小心，因为你会醒来很冷。

title: Obsessed!!!
body: This is seriously the softest most comfortable blanket ever! It stays cool all night and it’s the perfect weight. Fits fine on my queen bed and I now want one for every room! Also the color is so beautiful and looks just like the pictures. If you are a hot sleeper then you need this!! Highly , highly recommend!!
translation: 这确实是有史以来最柔软、最舒适的毯子！ 它整夜保持凉爽，重量恰到好处。 非常适合我的大床，我现在想要每个房间都有一张！ 而且颜色非常漂亮，看起来就像图片一样。 如果你是一个热睡者那么你需要这个！ 强烈、强烈推荐！！
